--!nonstrict
-- Lightweight paged text controls. This module only sends intents and renders snapshots.
local UI = {}
local function statText(stats) return "Farming " .. stats.Farming .. " · Hauling " .. stats.Hauling .. " · Brewing " .. stats.Brewing end
local function sortedKeys(map) local result = {}; for key in pairs(map) do table.insert(result, key) end; table.sort(result); return result end
local function workplace(state, petId)
	for id, station in pairs(state.stations) do if station.workerId == petId then return id end end
	return nil
end
function UI.new(config)
	local self = { mode = "inventory", page = 1, sort = "rarity", freeOnly = false, query = "", target = "cauldron", chosen = {}, detailsSeen = false, confirmSummon = nil, confirmOffer = nil }
	function self.signature(state)
		local fields = { tostring(state.collection.sequence), tostring(state.writable), state.collectionPolicy.status, state.fusePreview and state.fusePreview.token or "" }
		for _, id in ipairs(config.stationOrder) do
			table.insert(fields, (state.stations[id].workerId or "") .. ":" .. state.stations[id].level)
		end
		return table.concat(fields, "|")
	end
	function self.draw(ctx)
		local state, text, action, redraw, send = ctx.state, ctx.text, ctx.action, ctx.redraw, ctx.send
		for id in pairs(self.chosen) do if not state.pets[id] then self.chosen[id] = nil end end
		text("Фамильяры · " .. #sortedKeys(state.pets) .. "/" .. config.maxPets .. " · " .. (state.writable and "Готово" or "Сохранение / ожидание"), 44)
		if state.collection.lastResult then text("Сохранено: " .. state.collection.lastResult.message, 48) end
		for _, tab in ipairs({ {"inventory", "Коллекция"}, {"summon", "Призыв / Шансы"}, {"shop", "Гарантированный магазин"}, {"fuse", "Fuse / Эволюция"} }) do
			action((self.mode == tab[1] and "• " or "") .. tab[2], function() self.mode, self.confirmSummon, self.confirmOffer = tab[1], nil, nil; redraw() end)
		end
		if self.mode == "inventory" then
			action("Свободные: " .. (self.freeOnly and "ДА" or "ВСЕ"), function() self.freeOnly = not self.freeOnly; self.page = 1; redraw() end)
			for _, order in ipairs({ "rarity", "Farming", "Hauling", "Brewing" }) do
				action("Сортировка: " .. order .. (self.sort == order and " ✓" or ""), function() self.sort, self.page = order, 1; redraw() end)
			end
			local search = Instance.new("TextBox")
			search.Size, search.TextSize, search.ClearTextOnFocus = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 44), 16, false
			search.Text, search.PlaceholderText = self.query, "Поиск по имени, виду или ID"
			search.TextColor3, search.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(237,239,246), Color3.fromRGB(42,48,61)
			ctx.mount(search)
			search.FocusLost:Connect(function() self.query = string.sub(search.Text, 1, 80); self.page = 1; redraw() end)
			action("Место для назначения: " .. config.stations[self.target].name, function()
				local index = table.find(config.stationOrder, self.target) or 1
				self.target = config.stationOrder[index % #config.stationOrder + 1]; redraw()
			end)
			local ids = {}
			for id, pet in pairs(state.pets) do
				if (not self.freeOnly or not workplace(state, id)) and string.find(string.lower(pet.name .. " " .. pet.species .. " " .. id), string.lower(self.query), 1, true) then table.insert(ids, id) end
			end
			table.sort(ids, function(a, b)
				local pa, pb = state.pets[a], state.pets[b]
				local va = self.sort == "rarity" and config.rarityOrder[pa.rarity] or pa.stats[self.sort]
				local vb = self.sort == "rarity" and config.rarityOrder[pb.rarity] or pb.stats[self.sort]
				return va == vb and a < b or va > vb
			end)
			local pages = math.max(1, math.ceil(#ids / config.collection.pageSize))
			self.page = math.clamp(self.page, 1, pages)
			text("Страница " .. self.page .. "/" .. pages .. " · найдено " .. #ids, 36)
			action("Предыдущая страница", function() self.page = math.max(1, self.page - 1); redraw() end)
			action("Следующая страница", function() self.page = math.min(pages, self.page + 1); redraw() end)
			for index = (self.page - 1) * config.collection.pageSize + 1, math.min(#ids, self.page * config.collection.pageSize) do
				local id = ids[index]
				local pet, assigned = state.pets[id], workplace(state, id)
				local definition, station = config.stations[self.target], state.stations[self.target]
				local effective = math.min(pet.stats[definition.skill], definition.statCaps[station.level] or 0)
				text(pet.name .. " · " .. pet.rarity .. " · ступень " .. pet.evolution .. "\nID: " .. id .. "\nБаза: " .. statText(pet.stats)
					.. "\n" .. definition.name .. ": " .. definition.skill .. " " .. pet.stats[definition.skill] .. " → " .. effective
					.. "\n" .. (assigned and ("Занят: " .. config.stations[assigned].name) or "Свободен") .. (pet.locked and " · Защищён" or "")
					.. "\nИсточник: " .. pet.provenance.source .. (pet.provenance.paidDerived and " · платное происхождение" or ""), 152)
				action(pet.locked and "Снять защиту" or "Защитить от Fuse", function() send("petLock", { petId = id, locked = not pet.locked }) end)
				action(assigned and "Снять с рабочего места" or ("Назначить: " .. definition.name), function()
					send("assign", { stationId = assigned or self.target, petId = assigned and "" or id })
				end)
				action(self.chosen[id] and "Убрать из Fuse" or "Выбрать для Fuse", function()
					if self.chosen[id] then self.chosen[id] = nil
					elseif not pet.locked and not assigned and #sortedKeys(self.chosen) < 5 then self.chosen[id] = true end
					redraw()
				end)
			end
			text("Для защиты и Fuse подойди к своему алтарю. Для назначения/снятия — к нужному рабочему месту. Защищённых и занятых нельзя расходовать.", 88)
		elseif self.mode == "summon" then
			local details, access = state.summonDetails, state.collectionPolicy
			text("Призыв: " .. details.cost .. " Essence за питомца. Случайный вид и три случайных стата.", 64)
			action("Details / Шансы видов и характеристик", function() self.detailsSeen = true; redraw() end)
			if self.detailsSeen then
				local tiers = {}
				for _, outcome in ipairs(details.outcomes) do tiers[outcome.rarity] = (tiers[outcome.rarity] or 0) + outcome.percent end
				local tierLines = {}
				for _, rarity in ipairs({ "Common", "Rare", "Legendary", "Secret" }) do table.insert(tierLines, rarity .. " " .. string.format("%.2f%%", tiers[rarity] or 0)) end
				text(table.concat(tierLines, " · "), 60)
				text("Все значения каждого стата в указанном диапазоне равновероятны и независимы. Шанс точной тройки = шанс вида / число сочетаний. Десятичные проценты округлены; дроби задают точное значение.", 112)
				for _, outcome in ipairs(details.outcomes) do
					local lines = { outcome.name .. " · " .. outcome.rarity .. " · " .. string.format("%.2f%%", outcome.percent) }
					for _, skill in ipairs({ "Farming", "Hauling", "Brewing" }) do
						local range = outcome.ranges[skill]; local n = range[2] - range[1] + 1
						table.insert(lines, skill .. " " .. range[1] .. "…" .. range[2] .. ": каждое число 1/" .. n .. " = " .. string.format("%.10f%%", 100 / n))
					end
					table.insert(lines, "Любая точная тройка: " .. string.format("%.10f%%", outcome.tuplePercent) .. " (" .. outcome.weight .. "/" .. details.totalWeight .. "/" .. outcome.combinations .. ")")
					text(table.concat(lines, "\n"), 168)
				end
			end
			if not access.randomAllowed or access.status ~= "unrestricted" then
				text(access.status == "restricted" and "Случайный призыв недоступен для этого аккаунта. Выбери конкретного питомца в магазине." or "Доступность призыва не подтверждена. Гарантированный магазин работает.", 88)
				action("Открыть гарантированный магазин", function() self.mode = "shop"; redraw() end)
				action("Обновить доступность призыва", function() send("refreshPolicy", {}) end)
			elseif self.detailsSeen then
				for _, n in ipairs({ 1, 5 }) do action("Призвать " .. n .. " · " .. n * details.cost .. " Essence", function() self.confirmSummon = n; redraw() end) end
				if self.confirmSummon then
					local n = self.confirmSummon
					text("Подтверди расход " .. n * details.cost .. " Essence за " .. n .. " случайных питомцев. Сведения о шансах приведены выше.", 72)
					action("Подтверждаю призыв", function() self.confirmSummon = nil; send("summon", { poolId = details.id, count = n }) end)
				end
			else text("Открой Details / Шансы перед подтверждением призыва.", 52) end
		elseif self.mode == "shop" then
			text("Каждый вид и все статы известны заранее. Магазин доступен и при ограничении случайных наград.", 72)
			for _, offerId in ipairs(sortedKeys(state.familiarShop)) do
				local offer = state.familiarShop[offerId]
				local def = config.petSpecies[offer.species]
				text(def.name .. " · " .. def.rarity .. "\n" .. statText(offer.stats) .. "\nЦена: " .. offer.cost .. " " .. offer.currency, 100)
				action("Выбрать " .. def.name, function() self.confirmOffer = offerId; redraw() end)
				if self.confirmOffer == offerId then action("Подтверждаю: " .. offer.cost .. " " .. offer.currency, function() self.confirmOffer = nil; send("shopFamiliar", { offerId = offerId }) end) end
			end
		elseif self.mode == "fuse" then
			local ids = sortedKeys(self.chosen)
			text("5 одинаковых видов одной ступени → 1 следующая форма. Результат гарантирован. Выбирай родителей в коллекции; стартеры тоже расходуются только после подтверждения.", 104)
			for _, id in ipairs(ids) do text(state.pets[id].name .. "\nID: " .. id .. "\n" .. statText(state.pets[id].stats), 84) end
			action("Очистить выбор", function() self.chosen = {}; redraw() end)
			if #ids == 5 then action("Рассчитать точный результат", function() send("previewFuse", { petIds = ids }) end) end
			local preview = state.fusePreview
			if preview and table.concat(preview.parentIds, "|") == table.concat(ids, "|") then
				text("Будут удалены ровно эти 5 ID:\n" .. table.concat(preview.parentIds, "\n"), 144)
				text("Получишь: " .. preview.name .. " · " .. preview.rarity .. "\n" .. statText(preview.stats) .. "\nУспех: 100%" .. (preview.paidDerived and " · платное происхождение сохраняется" or ""), 100)
				action("Подтверждаю удаление 5 и создание 1", function() send("fuse", { petIds = ids, previewToken = preview.token, confirmed = true }) end)
			end
		end
	end
	return self
end
return UI

--!nonstrict
local Controller=require(script.Parent.EnvironmentController)
local View=require(script.Parent.EnvironmentView)
local root=workspace:WaitForChild("PotionTycoonWorld")
local function reconcile()
	if root:GetAttribute("EnvironmentArtEnabled")==true then
		if not Controller.view and root:FindFirstChild("EnvironmentArt") then
			Controller.view=View.start(root,{quality=Controller.quality}); Controller.view.setReduceMotion(Controller.reduceMotion)
		end
	elseif Controller.view then Controller.view.stop(); Controller.view=nil end
end
root:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EnvironmentArtEnabled"):Connect(reconcile)
root.ChildAdded:Connect(reconcile)
reconcile()

--!nonstrict
-- Shared local controller, used by the UI and bootstrap. No save or server call.
local Controller={view=nil,quality="reduced",reduceMotion=false}
function Controller.setQuality(name)
	if not ({full=true,reduced=true,minimal=true})[name] then return end
	Controller.quality=name; if Controller.view then Controller.view.setQuality(name) end
end
function Controller.setReduceMotion(value)
	Controller.reduceMotion=value==true; if Controller.view then Controller.view.setReduceMotion(Controller.reduceMotion) end
end
return Controller

--!nonstrict
-- One owner of environment lighting while enabled. No remotes or profile mutation.
local Lighting=game:GetService("Lighting")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local ContentProvider=game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local Shared=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PotionTycoon.Shared
local Config=require(Shared.EnvironmentConfig)
local State=require(Shared.EnvironmentState)
local Transition=require(Shared.EnvironmentTransition)
local Labels=require(Shared.EnvironmentLabels)
local View={}
local active=nil
local function color(v) return Color3.fromRGB(v[1],v[2],v[3]) end
function View.start(root,settings)
	assert(not active,"Environment lighting already has an owner")
	local self={quality=settings and settings.quality or "reduced",reduceMotion=false,pose=settings and settings.pose,root=root,parts={},rain={}}
	active=self
	local saved={}; local savedWind=workspace.GlobalWind
	for _,key in ipairs({"ClockTime","Brightness","Ambient","OutdoorAmbient","GlobalShadows","ExposureCompensation","GeographicLatitude","ColorShift_Top","ColorShift_Bottom","EnvironmentDiffuseScale","EnvironmentSpecularScale","ShadowSoftness"}) do saved[key]=Lighting[key] end
	local displaced={}
	for _,parent in ipairs({Lighting,workspace.Terrain}) do for _,v in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Sky") or v:IsA("Atmosphere") or v:IsA("Clouds") or v:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or v:IsA("ColorGradingEffect") or v:IsA("BloomEffect") or v:IsA("SunRaysEffect") then
			table.insert(displaced,{object=v,parent=parent}); v.Parent=nil
		end
	end end
	local function effect(class,name,parent)
		local v=Instance.new(class); v.Name=name; v.Parent=parent; return v
	end
	local atmosphere=effect("Atmosphere","M7Atmosphere",Lighting)
	local sky=effect("Sky","M7Sky",nil)
	local assets={}
	for property,face in pairs({SkyboxBk="bk",SkyboxDn="dn",SkyboxFt="ft",SkyboxLf="lf",SkyboxRt="rt",SkyboxUp="up"}) do
		local uri=Config.skyPrefix..face..".png"; sky[property]=uri; table.insert(assets,uri)
	end
	sky.SunTextureId=Config.skyPrefix.."sun.png"; sky.MoonTextureId=Config.skyPrefix.."moon.png"
	for _,name in ipairs({"sun","moon","mist","rainbow"}) do table.insert(assets,Config.skyPrefix..name..".png") end
	for _,name in ipairs({"meadow","star"}) do table.insert(assets,Config.polishPrefix..name..".png") end
	-- The sky retains its sun; a single owned celestial rig supplies a low moon
	-- and legible stars. Native zenith moon/stars are disabled, never duplicated.
	sky.CelestialBodiesShown=true; sky.StarCount=0; sky.SunAngularSize=7; sky.MoonAngularSize=0
	-- A single asset set for the entire session. No texture swaps at time/weather keys.
	sky.Parent=Lighting
	self.assetFailures=0
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok=pcall(function() ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(assets,function(_,status)
			if status~=Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then self.assetFailures+=1 end
		end) end)
		if not ok then self.assetFailures+=1 end
		if active==self and RunService:IsStudio() then print("M7_A2C_ASSETS failures="..self.assetFailures.." source=original-CC0-local permissions=LOCAL_ONLY") end
	end)
	local clouds=effect("Clouds","M7Clouds",workspace.Terrain)
	local correction=effect("ColorCorrectionEffect","M7Color",Lighting)
	local bloom=effect("BloomEffect","M7Bloom",Lighting); bloom.Size=18; bloom.Threshold=2.3
	local rays=effect("SunRaysEffect","M7SunRays",Lighting); rays.Spread=.35
	local folder=effect("Folder","M7ClientWeather",workspace)
	local function localPart(name,size)
		local p=effect("Part",name,folder); p.Size=size
		p.Anchored,p.CanCollide,p.CanTouch,p.CanQuery,p.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,false
		p.Transparency=1; return p
	end
	local ground=RaycastParams.new(); ground.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	ground.FilterDescendantsInstances={workspace.Terrain,root.ForestFloor,root.Plot_1.Floor}
	local function surface(x,z)
		local hit=workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x,70,z),Vector3.new(0,-120,0),ground)
		return hit and hit.Position.Y or .5
	end
	local function sprite(name,texture,size,position)
		local p=localPart(name,Vector3.new(.1,.1,.1)); p.Position=position
		local gui=effect("BillboardGui",name.."Sprite",p); gui.Size=UDim2.fromScale(size.X,size.Y); gui.LightInfluence=0; gui.AlwaysOnTop=false
		local img=effect("ImageLabel","Image",gui); img.BackgroundTransparency=1; img.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); img.Image=Config.skyPrefix..texture..".png"; img.ImageTransparency=1
		return {part=p,gui=gui,image=img}
	end
	local fog={}
	for i,pos in ipairs({{-169,-112},{-115,-106},{-184,-58}}) do
		fog[i]=sprite("GroundMist_"..i,"mist",Vector2.new(42,6.5),Vector3.new(pos[1],surface(pos[1],pos[2])+1.7,pos[2]))
	end
	local glints={}
	for i=1,Config.budgets.glints do
		local x=-142.5+(i%2==0 and -1 or 1)*(14+i*2); local z=-46-i*9
		local p=localPart("DewAndGlow_"..i,Vector3.new(.3,.04,.18)); p.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball; p.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
		p.Position=Vector3.new(x,surface(x,z)+.2,z); p.Color=Color3.fromRGB(129,218,224); glints[i]=p
	end
	local rainbow=sprite("AfterRainArc","rainbow",Vector2.new(95,48),Vector3.new(-140,50,-160))
	-- One non-rendering anchor, no per-star Parts/lights/emitters. The rig follows
	-- camera translation only so celestial bearings remain fixed in the world.
	local celestialAnchor=localPart("CelestialAnchor",Vector3.new(.1,.1,.1))
	local function celestialSprite(name,uri,size,direction)
		local attachment=effect("Attachment",name,celestialAnchor); attachment.Position=direction*Config.celestial.distance
		local gui=effect("BillboardGui",name.."Sprite",attachment); gui.Adornee=attachment
		gui.Size=UDim2.fromScale(size,size); gui.LightInfluence=0; gui.AlwaysOnTop=false
		local img=effect("ImageLabel","Image",gui); img.BackgroundTransparency=1; img.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); img.Image=uri; img.ImageTransparency=1
		return {attachment=attachment,gui=gui,image=img}
	end
	local moon=celestialSprite("Moon",Config.skyPrefix.."moon.png",Config.celestial.moonSize,Vector3.new(0,1,0))
	local stars={}
	for i=1,Config.celestial.stars do
		local d=State.star(i); stars[i]=celestialSprite("Star_"..i,Config.polishPrefix.."star.png",d.size,Vector3.new(d.x,d.y,d.z)); stars[i].alpha=d.alpha
	end
	local lights={}; local wind={}; local registered={}; local wetSurfaces={}
	local labels={}; local annotations=true; local labelsDirty=0
	local function registerLabel(gui)
		if gui:IsA("BillboardGui") then table.insert(labels,{gui=gui,enabled=gui.Enabled}) end
	end
	for _,gui in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do registerLabel(gui) end
	local labelAdded=root.DescendantAdded:Connect(registerLabel)
	local function register(p)
		if registered[p] then return end
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			registered[p]=true
			table.insert(self.parts,p)
			if string.find(p.Name,"RockPath") then table.insert(wetSurfaces,{part=p,color=p.Color,wet=Color3.new(p.Color.R*.70,p.Color.G*.75,p.Color.B*.78)}) end
			if p:GetAttribute("EnvironmentLight") then
				local l=effect("PointLight","M7LocalLantern",p); l.Color=color(Config.palette.amber); l.Range=14; l.Shadows=false; table.insert(lights,l)
			end
			-- Reviewed templates name leaf meshes *_2 and trunks *_1. Reading
			-- SurfaceAppearance maps requires Plugin capability, unavailable here.
			local leaf=string.match(p.Name,"Tree.*_2$") or string.match(p.Name,"Pine.*_2$")
			local plant=string.find(p.Name,"Grass") or string.find(p.Name,"Fern") or leaf
			if plant then table.insert(wind,{part=p,base=p.CFrame,pivot=p.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,-p.Size.Y/2,0),height=p.Size.Y}) end
		end
	end
	-- Children can replicate after the enable attribute. Do not miss late lanterns.
	local added=root.EnvironmentArt.DescendantAdded:Connect(register)
	for _,p in ipairs(root.EnvironmentArt:GetDescendants()) do register(p) end
	for i=1,Config.budgets.rain do
		local p=effect("Part","LocalRain_"..i,folder); p.Size=Vector3.new(.035,.9,.035)
		p.Anchored,p.CanCollide,p.CanTouch,p.CanQuery,p.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,false
		p.Color=Color3.fromRGB(189,211,214); p.Transparency=1; table.insert(self.rain,p)
	end
	local motes={}
	for i=1,Config.budgets.motes do
		local p=effect("Part","AmbientMote_"..i,folder); p.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball; p.Size=Vector3.new(.15,.15,.15)
		p.Anchored,p.CanCollide,p.CanTouch,p.CanQuery,p.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,false
		p.Material=i%3~=0 and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.Color=i%3~=0 and Color3.fromRGB(238,226,140) or Color3.fromRGB(242,222,184); p.Transparency=1; motes[i]=p
	end
	local function apply(sample,q)
		Lighting.ClockTime=sample.clock; Lighting.Brightness=sample.brightness; Lighting.Ambient=color(sample.ambient)
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=color(sample.outdoor); Lighting.GlobalShadows=q.shadows; Lighting.ExposureCompensation=sample.exposure
		Lighting.GeographicLatitude=26; Lighting.ShadowSoftness=.7
		Lighting.ColorShift_Top=color(sample.sun):Lerp(Color3.new(),.65); Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom=Color3.fromRGB(8,12,22)
		Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale=.35; Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale=.1
		atmosphere.Color=color(sample.sky); atmosphere.Decay=color(sample.decay); atmosphere.Density=sample.density; atmosphere.Haze=sample.haze*q.haze; atmosphere.Glare=.08*(1-sample.rain); atmosphere.Offset=.15
		clouds.Cover=sample.cover; clouds.Density=sample.cloudDensity; clouds.Color=color(sample.cloudColor)
		correction.TintColor=color(sample.tint); correction.Saturation=.04-.12*sample.cloud; correction.Contrast=.025
		workspace.GlobalWind=self.reduceMotion and Vector3.zero or Vector3.new(4+sample.wind*8,0,2+sample.wind*3)
		bloom.Intensity=q.bloom; bloom.Enabled=q.bloom>0
		rays.Intensity=q.rays*(1-sample.rain)*(1-sample.night); rays.Enabled=q.rays>0
	end
	local lod=0; local step=0; local connection
	local transition=Transition.new()
	function self.setQuality(name) if Config.quality[name] then self.quality=name; lod=1 end end
	function self.setReduceMotion(enabled) self.reduceMotion=enabled==true; lod=1 end
	function self.setPose(name)
		if RunService:IsStudio() and (name==nil or Config.poses[name]) then
			transition.begin(os.clock()); self.pose=name; self.previewStart=nil
		end
	end
	function self.setPreview(enabled)
		if RunService:IsStudio() then transition.begin(os.clock()); self.previewStart=enabled and os.clock() or nil end
	end
	function self.stats()
		local counts={lights=0,rain=0,motes=0,wind=0,emitters=0,fog=0,glints=0,rainbow=0,stars=0,moon=0,assetFailures=self.assetFailures}
		for _,l in ipairs(lights) do if l.Enabled then counts.lights+=1 end end
		for _,p in ipairs(self.rain) do if p.Transparency<1 then counts.rain+=1 end end
		for _,p in ipairs(motes) do if p.Transparency<1 then counts.motes+=1 end end
		for _,w in ipairs(wind) do if w.moving then counts.wind+=1 end end
		for _,v in ipairs(fog) do if v.image.ImageTransparency<1 then counts.fog+=1 end end
		for _,p in ipairs(glints) do if p.Transparency<1 then counts.glints+=1 end end
		counts.rainbow=rainbow.image.ImageTransparency<1 and 1 or 0
		for _,v in ipairs(stars) do if v.image.ImageTransparency<1 then counts.stars+=1 end end
		counts.moon=moon.image.ImageTransparency<1 and 1 or 0
		return counts
	end
	function self.setAnnotationsEnabled(enabled) annotations=enabled~=false; labelsDirty=1 end
	function self.update(dt)
		step+=dt; lod+=dt; labelsDirty+=dt; if step<1/30 then return end; local elapsed=step; step=0
		local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera; if not camera then return end
		local time=workspace:GetServerTimeNow(); local now=os.clock()
		local target=self.previewStart and State.preview(Config,now-self.previewStart) or State.sample(Config,time,self.pose)
		local sample=transition.sample(target,now); local q=State.quality(Config,self.quality,self.reduceMotion)
		apply(sample,q)
		celestialAnchor.Position=camera.CFrame.Position
		moon.attachment.Position=Vector3.new(table.unpack(State.moon(sample.phase)))*Config.celestial.distance
		moon.image.ImageTransparency=1-sample.celestial*.94
		for i,v in ipairs(stars) do v.image.ImageTransparency=1-(i<=q.stars and sample.celestial*v.alpha or 0) end
		for _,v in ipairs(wetSurfaces) do v.part.Color=v.color:Lerp(v.wet,sample.wetStone*.35) end
		if labelsDirty>=.25 then
			labelsDirty=0
			local entries={}
			if annotations then
				for id,l in ipairs(labels) do
					local gui=l.gui; local anchor=gui.Adornee or gui.Parent
					if anchor and anchor:IsA("BasePart") then
						local p=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(anchor.Position+camera.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(gui.StudsOffset)+gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace)
						table.insert(entries,{id=id,x=p.X,y=p.Y,z=p.Z,distance=(anchor.Position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude,
							w=gui.Size.X.Offset,h=gui.Size.Y.Offset,enabled=l.enabled})
					end
				end
			end
			local selected=Labels.select(entries,camera.ViewportSize.X,camera.ViewportSize.Y)
			-- Issue #18 owns gameplay context independently of art/quality. The
			-- historical annotation selector is retained only in the art harness.
			if not root:GetAttribute("WorldContextOwned") then
				for id,l in ipairs(labels) do l.gui.Enabled=selected[id]==true end
			end
		end
		if lod>=.5 then
			lod=0
			for _,p in ipairs(self.parts) do
				local detail=p:GetAttribute("EnvironmentDetail") or 1
				-- Preserve the scene silhouette at all tiers; only small decorative detail gets culled.
				if detail>q.detail or (detail>1 and (p.Position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude>q.distance) then p.LocalTransparencyModifier=1 else p.LocalTransparencyModifier=0 end
			end
			table.sort(lights,function(a,b) return (a.Parent.Position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude<(b.Parent.Position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude end)
			for i,l in ipairs(lights) do l.Enabled=i<=q.lights and (l.Parent.Position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude<q.distance end
			table.sort(wind,function(a,b) return (a.base.Position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude<(b.base.Position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude end)
			local center=camera.CFrame.Position
			for i,p in ipairs(self.rain) do
				local x=math.clamp(center.X,-181,-104)+(i*17%47)-23; local z=math.clamp(center.Z,-109,-36)+(i*29%43)-21
				p:SetAttribute("GroundY",surface(x,z)); p:SetAttribute("RainX",x); p:SetAttribute("RainZ",z)
			end
		end
		for _,l in ipairs(lights) do l.Brightness=.18+sample.night*1.45 end
		-- Fading OUT still consumes a slot. New nearby foliage waits for a free
		-- slot, so camera movement cannot double the motion budget during fades.
		local occupied=0
		for i,w in ipairs(wind) do
			w.wanted=i<=q.motion and w.part.LocalTransparencyModifier==0 and (w.base.Position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude<q.distance
			w.weight=w.weight or 0
			if w.weight>0 then
				if occupied>=q.motion then w.weight=0
				elseif w.wanted then w.weight=math.min(1,w.weight+elapsed*1.5)
				else w.weight=math.max(0,w.weight-elapsed*1.5) end
				if w.weight>0 then occupied+=1 end
			end
		end
		for _,w in ipairs(wind) do
			if w.wanted and w.weight==0 and occupied<q.motion then w.weight=math.min(1,elapsed*1.5); occupied+=1 end
			w.moving=w.weight>0
			w.part.CFrame=w.pivot*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.sin(time*.65+w.base.Position.X)*(.007+.007*sample.wind)*w.weight)*CFrame.new(0,w.height/2,0)
		end
		for i,p in ipairs(motes) do
			local m=State.mote(i,time,sample.night,sample.rain); local position=Vector3.new(m.x,m.y,m.z)
			local visible=i<=q.motes and (position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude<q.distance
			p.Transparency=visible and 1-m.alpha or 1; if visible then p.Position=position end
			p.Color=m.firefly and color({168+70*sample.warm,224,181-50*sample.warm}) or color({235,229-33*sample.warm,213-55*sample.warm})
		end
		for i,p in ipairs(self.rain) do
			local pilotDistance=(camera.CFrame.Position-Vector3.new(-142.5,5,-65)).Magnitude
			local visible=i<=q.rain and sample.rain>0 and pilotDistance<q.distance
			p.Transparency=visible and (1-sample.rain*.52) or 1
			if visible then
				local fall=(time*1.15+i*.173)%1; local y=p:GetAttribute("GroundY") or .5
				local x,z=p:GetAttribute("RainX") or -142.5,p:GetAttribute("RainZ") or -65
				-- Splashes reuse the same rain slots; no emitters or additional pool.
				if fall>.91 then
					local radius=.08+(fall-.91)*3; p.Size=Vector3.new(radius,.025,radius)
					p.CFrame=CFrame.new(x,y+.06,z); p.Transparency=1-sample.rain*.38*(1-(fall-.91)/.09)
				else
					p.Size=Vector3.new(.045,.85,.045); p.CFrame=CFrame.new(x+(1-fall)*1.8,y+.2+(1-fall)*24,z)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,-.09)
				end
			end
		end
		for i,v in ipairs(fog) do
			local distance=(v.part.Position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
			local fade=math.clamp((q.distance-distance)/20,0,1)
			v.image.ImageTransparency=1-(i<=q.fog and sample.fog*.85*fade or 0)
			v.image.ImageColor3=Color3.fromRGB(214,229,239):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(228,249,241),sample.dawn)
		end
		for i,p in ipairs(glints) do
			local distance=(p.Position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude; local fade=math.clamp((q.distance-distance)/20,0,1)
			p.Transparency=1-(i<=q.glints and math.max(sample.night*.6,sample.glint*.65)*fade or 0)
			p.Color=color({195-66*sample.night,231-13*sample.night,219+5*sample.night})
		end
		local sun=Lighting:GetSunDirection(); local horizontal=Vector3.new(-sun.X,0,-sun.Z)
		local eligible=sun.Y>.08 and sun.Y<.88 and horizontal.Magnitude>.01
		local arc=eligible and sample.rainbow*.45 or 0
		if eligible then
			local direction=horizontal.Unit; local facing=math.clamp((camera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(direction)-.1)/.4,0,1)
			local elevation=math.clamp((sun.Y-.08)/.08,0,1)*math.clamp((.88-sun.Y)/.08,0,1)
			arc*=facing*elevation; rainbow.part.Position=Vector3.new(-142.5,23,-65)+direction*105
		end
		local nearPilot=(camera.CFrame.Position-Vector3.new(-142.5,5,-65)).Magnitude<q.distance
		rainbow.image.ImageTransparency=1-(q.rainbow>0 and nearPilot and arc or 0)
	end
	function self.stop()
		if active~=self then return end; active=nil
		if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
		added:Disconnect()
		labelAdded:Disconnect()
		if not root:GetAttribute("WorldContextOwned") then
			for _,l in ipairs(labels) do l.gui.Enabled=l.enabled end
		end
		for k,v in pairs(saved) do Lighting[k]=v end
		workspace.GlobalWind=savedWind
		for _,p in ipairs(self.parts) do p.LocalTransparencyModifier=0 end
		for _,w in ipairs(wind) do w.part.CFrame=w.base end
		for _,v in ipairs(wetSurfaces) do v.part.Color=v.color end
		for _,l in ipairs(lights) do l:Destroy() end
		atmosphere:Destroy(); sky:Destroy(); clouds:Destroy(); correction:Destroy(); bloom:Destroy(); rays:Destroy(); folder:Destroy()
		for _,v in ipairs(displaced) do v.object.Parent=v.parent end
	end
	self.update(1); connection=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(self.update)
	return self
end
return View

--!nonstrict
-- Cosmetic client-side worker proxies. Never used as proof of delivery or ownership.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local world = workspace:WaitForChild("PotionTycoonWorld")
local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name, folder.Parent = "LocalFamiliarVisuals", workspace
local proxies = {}
local crates = {}
local colors = { slime = Color3.fromRGB(112, 222, 149), brewer = Color3.fromRGB(200, 151, 239), farmer = Color3.fromRGB(235, 203, 141) }

local function discover(anchor)
	if not anchor:IsA("BasePart") or not anchor:GetAttribute("StationId") then return end
	if proxies[anchor] then return end
	local pet = Instance.new("Part")
	pet.Name, pet.Shape, pet.Size = "WorkerProxy", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(2.4, 2.4, 2.4)
	pet.Anchored, pet.CanCollide, pet.CanTouch, pet.CanQuery, pet.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
	pet.Material, pet.Transparency, pet.Parent = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 1, folder
	local a,b=Instance.new("Attachment"),Instance.new("Attachment"); a.Position,b.Position=Vector3.new(0,0.6,0),Vector3.new(0,-0.6,0); a.Parent,b.Parent=pet,pet
	local trail=Instance.new("Trail"); trail.Name="GhostTrail"; trail.Attachment0,trail.Attachment1=a,b; trail.Lifetime=0.6
	trail.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(120,234,247),Color3.fromRGB(165,116,240)); trail.LightEmission=0.6; trail.Enabled=false; trail.Parent=pet
	proxies[anchor] = pet
	local crate = Instance.new("Part")
	crate.Name, crate.Size = "QuestCrate", Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	crate.Anchored, crate.CanCollide, crate.CanTouch, crate.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
	crate.Color, crate.Material = Color3.fromRGB(173, 128, 72), Enum.Material.Wood
	crate.Transparency, crate.Parent = 1, folder
	crates[anchor] = crate
end
for _, descendant in ipairs(world:GetDescendants()) do discover(descendant) end
world.DescendantAdded:Connect(discover)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local time = os.clock()
	for anchor, pet in pairs(proxies) do
		if not anchor.Parent then
			pet:Destroy()
			crates[anchor]:Destroy()
			crates[anchor] = nil
			proxies[anchor] = nil
		elseif anchor:GetAttribute("WorkerId") then
			pet.Transparency = 0
			pet.Color = colors[anchor:GetAttribute("WorkerSpecies")] or Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 210)
			local species=anchor:GetAttribute("WorkerSpecies"); local ghost=species=="ghost_wolf" or species=="ghost_alpha"
			pet.GhostTrail.Enabled=ghost; pet.Material=ghost and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			if ghost then pet.Color=Color3.fromRGB(120,234,247); pet.Transparency=0.2 end
			local position = anchor.Position + Vector3.new(5, 1.5 + math.sin(time * 2) * 0.2, 0)
			local from, destination, progress = anchor:GetAttribute("HaulFrom"), anchor:GetAttribute("HaulTo"), anchor:GetAttribute("HaulProgress")
			if from and destination and progress then position = from:Lerp(destination, progress) + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) end
			pet.CFrame = pet.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.new(position), 0.2)
		else pet.Transparency = 1; pet.GhostTrail.Enabled=false end
		local crate = crates[anchor]
		if crate then
			local item = anchor:GetAttribute("CargoItem")
			local cargo = anchor:GetAttribute("CargoAmount") or 0
			local queued = anchor:GetAttribute("QueuedCrates") or 0
			if cargo > 0 and (item == "healing" or item == "rage") then
				local from, target = anchor:GetAttribute("HaulFrom"), anchor:GetAttribute("HaulTo")
				-- Replicated attributes may arrive separately within a frame.
				crate.Transparency = from and target and 0 or 1
				if from and target then crate.Position = from:Lerp(target, anchor:GetAttribute("HaulProgress") or 0) + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0) end
			elseif queued > 0 then
				crate.Transparency = 0
				crate.Position = anchor.Position + Vector3.new(-5, 1, 0)
			else crate.Transparency = 1 end
		end
	end
end)

--!nonstrict
-- Server snapshots only; review/continue never grant rewards locally.
local UI={}
function UI.new(config)
	local ui={}; local reviewed,choice,dismissed=nil,nil,nil
	local function rewardText(reward)
		local result={}; for _,key in ipairs({"gold","essence"}) do if reward[key] then table.insert(result,reward[key].." "..(key=="gold" and "Gold" or "Essence")) end end
		return table.concat(result," + ")
	end
	function ui.draw(ctx)
		local p,s=ctx.state,ctx.state.longTerm
		ctx.text(s.epoch.." · цикл "..s.rebirths.."\nTime Shards: "..s.shards,70)
		ctx.text("Действия — у площадки развития на своём участке. Коллекция и награды подтверждаются сервером.",64)
		if ctx.mode=="rebirth" then
			if s.last and s.last.action=="rebirth" and dismissed~=s.rebirths then
				local result=s.last.result
				ctx.text("Добро пожаловать в новую эпоху!\n"..result.epoch.." · получен 1 Time Shard\nСохранены: "..result.petsKept.." фамильяров, "..result.cauldronsKept.." редких котлов. Постоянные улучшения действуют.",140)
				ctx.action("Продолжить новую фабрику",function() dismissed=s.rebirths; reviewed=nil; ctx.redraw() end); return
			end
			ctx.text("Следующая эпоха: "..s.nextEpoch.."\nНаграда: ровно 1 Time Shard",72)
			local function resetText()
				local current=ctx.currentState and ctx.currentState() or p
				return "Будут удалены: весь Gold (сейчас "..current.gold.."), вся Essence ("..current.essence.."), ингредиенты, полуфабрикаты, партии, грузы и текущий заказ. Постройки, склад, трубы и улучшения начнутся с фазы 1."
			end
			local resetLabel=ctx.text(resetText(),150)
			if ctx.bindText then ctx.bindText(resetLabel,resetText) end
			ctx.text("Сохранятся все фамильяры и редкие котлы, их статы и защита, архив рецептов, постоянные права, Time Shards, перки, обучение и ежедневные награды. Работники и котлы будут сняты с оборудования.",140)
			ctx.text(#s.reasons==0 and "Текущий финальный рецепт произведён. Можно проверить и подтвердить Rebirth." or table.concat(s.reasons,"\n"),96)
			if s.available then
				if not reviewed or reviewed.cycle~=s.rebirths or reviewed.requestId~=s.requestId then
					ctx.action("Я прочитал: проверить перерождение",function() reviewed={cycle=s.rebirths,requestId=s.requestId}; ctx.redraw() end)
				else
					ctx.text("Подтверди сброс всего текущего Gold, Essence и фабрики. Коллекция сохранится. Это начало нового цикла.",100)
					ctx.action("Подтвердить Rebirth и сброс фабрики",function() ctx.send("rebirth",{expectedRebirthCount=reviewed.cycle,confirmed=true,requestId=reviewed.requestId}) end)
					ctx.action("Отмена",function() reviewed=nil; ctx.redraw() end)
				end
			end
		elseif ctx.mode=="dailies" then
			ctx.text("Ежедневные задания · общий день UTC "..s.day.."\nУчитываются ручные действия и завершённые ручные варки онлайн. Офлайн и автоварка не считаются. Неполученные задания сменятся в 00:00 UTC.",130)
			for _,quest in ipairs(s.daily) do
				ctx.text(quest.name.." · "..quest.progress.."/"..quest.target.."\nНаграда: "..rewardText(quest.reward)..(quest.claimed and " · получена" or ""),70)
				if not quest.claimed and quest.progress>=quest.target then ctx.action("Получить: "..quest.name,function() ctx.send("claimDaily",{questId=quest.id,expectedDay=s.day,requestId=s.requestId}) end) end
			end
			local reward=s.calendarSpecial and "титул Летописец + фиксированный Moon Cat (F6/H5/B36)" or rewardText(s.calendarReward)
			ctx.text("Календарь · день "..s.calendarStep.."/7\n"..reward.."\nОдин явный claim в день UTC. Пропуск начинает серию с дня 1; после дня 7 — новая серия. Особая награда выдаётся один раз.",130)
			if s.calendarClaimed then ctx.text("Сегодня награда календаря уже получена.",45)
			else ctx.action("Получить награду календаря",function() ctx.send("claimCalendar",{expectedDay=s.day,requestId=s.requestId}) end) end
			if s.calendarPending then
				ctx.text("Moon Cat ждёт доставки: Farming 6 / Hauling 5 / Brewing 36. Право сохраняется без срока. При 128 питомцах освободи места через Fuse; получить можно позже.",108)
				ctx.action("Получить Moon Cat в коллекцию",function() ctx.send("deliverCalendarPet",{requestId=s.requestId}) end)
			end
		else
			ctx.text("Постоянные улучшения · каждый Rebirth даёт 1 Time Shard. Случайного призыва за осколки нет: ниже можно выбрать точного питомца.",100)
			for _,key in ipairs(config.longTerm.perkOrder) do
				local def=config.longTerm.perks[key]
				ctx.text(def.name.." · "..s.perks[key].."/"..def.max.."\n"..def.description.."\nЦена: "..def.cost.." Time Shard",100)
				if s.perks[key]<def.max then ctx.action("Купить: "..def.name,function() ctx.send("buyRebirthPerk",{perkId=key,expectedLevel=s.perks[key],requestId=s.requestId}) end) end
			end
			for _,key in ipairs(config.longTerm.choiceOrder) do
				local def=config.familiarShop[key]; local species=config.petSpecies[key]
				ctx.text(species.name.." · "..species.rarity.."\nFarming "..def.stats.Farming.." / Hauling "..def.stats.Hauling.." / Brewing "..def.stats.Brewing.."\nФиксированно: "..config.longTerm.choiceCost.." Time Shard; без случайности",105)
				if choice==key then ctx.action("Подтвердить покупку: "..species.name,function() ctx.send("chooseRebirthPet",{offerId=key,confirmed=true,requestId=s.requestId}); choice=nil end)
				else ctx.action("Выбрать: "..species.name,function() choice=key; ctx.redraw() end) end
			end
		end
	end
	return ui
end
return UI

		action = "build"
	end
	if collectionActions[action] or progressionActions[action] or LongTerm.isAction(action) or Monetization.isAction(action) then

		collectionPending = true

	end

end

local function shopPrice(card)

	local cached=prices[card.offerId]; local now=os.clock()
	if cached and cached.sku==card.sku and now<cached.untilTime then return cached.price end

	task.spawn(function()
		local ok,info=pcall(MarketplaceService.GetProductInfoAsync,MarketplaceService,card.sku,card.platformKind=="product" and Enum.InfoType.Product or Enum.InfoType.GamePass)
		if prices[card.offerId]~=entry then return end
		if ok and info and info.IsForSale==true and type(info.PriceInRobux)=="number" and info.PriceInRobux>=0 then entry.price=info.PriceInRobux end
		if selected=="shop" then draw() end

	return nil

local function readChat()
	local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return end
	local viewport=camera.ViewportSize
	local ok,active,size,position=pcall(function()
		return StarterGui:GetCore("ChatActive"),StarterGui:GetCore("ChatWindowSize"),StarterGui:GetCore("ChatWindowPosition")
	end)
	-- Read native chat bounds, never change CoreGui visibility or position. Core
	-- scripts can register late; reserve the current legacy chat's default region.
	local right,rect
	if not ok or active~=false then
		local p=typeof(position)=="UDim2" and Vector2.new(position.X.Scale*viewport.X+position.X.Offset,position.Y.Scale*viewport.Y+position.Y.Offset) or Vector2.zero
		local s=typeof(size)=="UDim2" and Vector2.new(size.X.Scale*viewport.X+size.X.Offset,size.Y.Scale*viewport.Y+size.Y.Offset) or Vector2.new(viewport.X*.4,viewport.Y*.335)
		right=p.X+s.X; rect={x=p.X,y=p.Y,w=s.X,h=s.Y+40}
	end
	local changed=right~=chatRight
	chatRight,chatRect=right,rect
	return changed

		local definition = Config.stations[stationId]
		title.Text = definition.name
		local production = text("", 76)
		bindText(production, function()
			local info = state.production[stationId]
			return info.text .. "\nЦикл: " .. math.floor(info.progress * 100) .. "% · не хватает: " .. names(info.missingInputs)
		end)
		local info = text("", 70)
		bindText(info, function()
			local station = getStation()
			local pet = station.workerId and state.pets[station.workerId]
			local cap = definition.statCaps[station.level] or 0
			local work = pet and (pet.name .. " · " .. definition.skill .. " " .. pet.stats[definition.skill] .. " → " .. math.min(pet.stats[definition.skill], cap)) or "Не назначен"
			return "Уровень: " .. station.level .. "\nРабочий: " .. work
		end)
		if stationId == "crystal" then
			local click=action("",function() send("click",{}) end)
			bindText(click,function() return "Собрать эссенцию +"..state.longTerm.manualClickEssence end)
		elseif definition.outputItem then
			local output = text("", 44)
			bindText(output, function() return "У источника: " .. names(getStation().output) end)
			action("Собрать вручную", function() send("harvest", { stationId = stationId }) end)
			action("Забрать выращенное / добытое", function() send("collect", { stationId = stationId }) end)
		elseif stationId == "logistics" then
			local cargo = text("", 76)
			bindText(cargo, function()
				local job = getStation().job
				if not job then return "Груза нет. Перевозчик доставляет сырьё и квестовые ящики; жидкости идут по трубам." end
				local source = job.sourceStationId and Config.stations[job.sourceStationId].name or "Склад"
				local target = job.destinationKind == "questStock" and "Квестовый склад" or (job.destinationStationId and Config.stations[job.destinationStationId].name or "Склад")
				return Config.items[job.itemId].name .. " × " .. job.amount .. "\n" .. source .. " → " .. target .. "\nСнятие рабочего приостанавливает груз."
			end)
		elseif definition.defaultRecipe then
			local recipe = text("", 48)
			bindText(recipe, function()
				local station = getStation()
				local def = Config.recipes[station.recipeId]
				return def and (def.name .. " · " .. names(def.inputs) .. " · Essence: " .. def.essenceCost
					.. " · Выпуск: " .. def.quantity .. " · Продажа: " .. state.recipes[stationId][station.recipeId].saleValue .. " Gold") or "Рецепт не выбран"
			end)
			local recipeIds={}; for id in pairs(state.recipes[stationId]) do table.insert(recipeIds,id) end; table.sort(recipeIds)
			for _,recipeId in ipairs(recipeIds) do
				local def,availability=Config.recipes[recipeId],state.recipes[stationId][recipeId]
				action("Рецепт: "..def.name..(availability.available and "" or (" · "..availability.reason)),function() send("setRecipe",{stationId=stationId,recipeId=recipeId}) end)
			end
			action("Загрузить ингредиенты и Essence", function() send("load", { stationId = stationId }) end)
			action("Сварить одну партию", function() send("brew", { stationId = stationId }) end)
			local auto = action("", function() send("setAuto", { stationId = stationId, enabled = not getStation().auto }) end)
			bindText(auto, function() return "Автоварка: " .. (getStation().auto and "ВКЛ" or "ВЫКЛ") end)
			action("Забрать полуфабрикаты", function() send("collect", { stationId = stationId }) end)
			local buffers = text("", 108)
			bindText(buffers, function()
				local station = getStation()
				local progress = station.job and (" · работа: " .. math.floor(station.progress or 0) .. " / " .. tostring(station.job.duration)) or " · ожидание"
				return "Бак Essence: " .. station.essence .. "/" .. Config.essenceBufferCapacity
					.. "\nВход: " .. names(station.input) .. "\nВыход: " .. names(station.output) .. progress
					.. "\nЯщики у котла: " .. state.production[stationId].queued .. "/" .. Config.questQueueCapacity
			end)
		end
		if definition.archetype=="cauldron" then
			text("Установленный редкий котёл: "..tostring(getStation().cauldronId or "базовый")..". Сначала заверши оплаченную партию.",76)
			for id,item in pairs(state.cauldrons) do
				action("Установить "..Config.cauldronTypes[item.type].name.." · "..id,function() send("equipCauldron",{slotId=stationId,cauldronId=id}) end)
			end
			action("Снять редкий котёл",function() send("equipCauldron",{slotId=stationId,cauldronId=""}) end)
		end
		action("Снабдить этот слот следующим",function() send("prioritize",{stationId=stationId}) end)
		action("Назначить фамильяра", function() petPicker = true; draw() end)
		local upgrade = action("", function() send("buy", { upgradeId = stationId }) end)
		bindText(upgrade, function() return "Улучшить · " .. tostring(upgradePrice(stationId) or "MAX") .. " Gold · " .. state.builds[stationId].reason end)
		text("Действия доступны рядом с этим объектом на твоём участке. Питомца можно снять и назначить на другое место.", 58)
	end
	refresh()
end

refresh = function()
	if not state then return end
	balance.Text = "Gold: " .. math.floor(state.gold) .. "  |  Essence: " .. math.floor(state.essence)
	guide.Text = not state.writable and "Сохранение приостановлено" or (state.tutorial.complete and ("Моя ферма · "..state.phase.name) or ("Шаг "..state.tutorial.step.."/"..state.tutorial.total.." · "..ContextPolicy.description({station=state.tutorial.target},Config)))
	for _, update in ipairs(bindings) do update() end
end

local tabList={{"blueprint","Развитие"},{"shop","Событие"},{"rebirth","Rebirth"},{"dailies","Daily"},{"shards","Осколки"},{"bazaar","Обмен"},{"quality","Качество"}}
for _,id in ipairs(Config.stationOrder) do table.insert(tabList,{id,Config.stations[id].name}) end
for _,tab in ipairs({{"warehouse","Склад"},{"orders","Заказы"},{"altar","Фамильяры"}}) do table.insert(tabList,tab) end
for _, tab in ipairs(tabList) do
	local tabButton = button(tabs, tab[2], function() selected, petPicker, selectedUpgrade = tab[1], false, false; draw() end)
	tabButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(104, 44)
end

local toastGeneration = 0
local function showToast(message, duration)
	toastGeneration += 1
	local generation = toastGeneration
	toast.Text, toast.Visible = message, true
	task.delay(duration or 4, function() if generation == toastGeneration then toast.Visible = false end end)
end

State.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(value)
	local first = state == nil
	local shopChanged=state and Codec.encode(state.shop)~=Codec.encode(value.shop)
	local longTermChanged=state and (state.longTerm.requestId~=value.longTerm.requestId or state.longTerm.day~=value.longTerm.day)
	local longTermPanel=selected=="rebirth" or selected=="dailies" or selected=="shards"
	local longTermViewChanged=longTermPanel and state and Codec.encode(state.longTerm)~=Codec.encode(value.longTerm)
	if (state and state.rebirths~=value.rebirths) or (first and value.longTerm.last and value.longTerm.last.action=="rebirth") then selected,petPicker,panel.Visible="rebirth",false,true; selectedUpgrade=false end
	local collectionChanged = state and collectionUI.signature(state) ~= collectionUI.signature(value)
	local progressionChanged = state and (state.progression.sequence~=value.progression.sequence or state.phase.complete~=value.phase.complete
		or table.concat(state.orderOffers,"|")~=table.concat(value.orderOffers,"|"))
	if state and (state.collection.sequence ~= value.collection.sequence or state.progression.sequence~=value.progression.sequence or state.shop.sequence~=value.shop.sequence or longTermChanged) then collectionPending = false end
	state = value
	if first or progressionChanged or longTermChanged or longTermViewChanged or (selected=="shop" and shopChanged) or (selected == "altar" and collectionChanged) then draw() else refresh() end
	if not hasReport and value.offlineReport and value.offlineReport.processedSeconds > 5 then
		hasReport = true
		showToast("С возвращением! Учтено " .. value.offlineReport.processedSeconds .. " сек. работы. Gold: +" .. math.floor(value.offlineReport.goldEarned or 0) .. ". Уже сохранено.", 8)
	end
end)
PurchasePrompt.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(value)
	if not state then return end
	for _,card in ipairs(state.shop.cards) do
		if card.offerId==value.offerId and card.sku==value.sku and card.platformKind==value.kind and card.robuxAvailable then
			local ok=pcall(function()
				if value.kind=="product" then MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player,value.sku)
				else MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player,value.sku) end
			end)
			if not ok then showToast("Окно Roblox недоступно. Покупка не подтверждена; повтори позже.",5) end
			return
		end
	end
end)
TradeState.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(value)
	local previous=tradeState and tradeState.session
	tradeState=value
	local current=value.session
	if current and (not previous or previous.id~=current.id or previous.state~=current.state) then
		selected,petPicker,panel.Visible="bazaar",false,true
		selectedUpgrade=false
	end
	if value.blocked then selected,petPicker,panel.Visible="bazaar",false,true; selectedUpgrade=false end
	if selected=="bazaar" then draw() end
end)
Notice.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(value)
	collectionPending = false
	showToast(value.text)
end)
Focus.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(stationId)
	if Config.stations[stationId] or stationId == "warehouse" or stationId == "orders" or stationId == "altar" or stationId == "blueprint" or stationId=="bazaar" then
		selected, petPicker, panel.Visible = stationId, false, true
		selectedUpgrade=false
		draw()
	end
end)
draw()
task.spawn(function()
	context=require(script.Parent.WorldContext).start(updateContext,function() return panel.Visible or not gui.Enabled end,function()
		local inset=GuiService:GetGuiInset(); local rectangles={}
		if chatRect then table.insert(rectangles,chatRect) end
		for _,widget in ipairs({hud,guide,rail,toggle}) do
			local p,s=widget.AbsolutePosition,widget.AbsoluteSize
			table.insert(rectangles,{x=p.X+inset.X,y=p.Y+inset.Y,w=s.X,h=s.Y})
		end
		return rectangles
	end)
end)
Ready:FireServer()
task.spawn(function()
	while not state do task.wait(3); Ready:FireServer() end
end)

--!nonstrict
-- Local primitives only: illustrative greybox, never an inventory or reward object.
local Preview={}
function Preview.create(parent,style)
	local view=Instance.new("ViewportFrame"); view.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,120); view.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(24,31,43)
	view.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(200,220,235); view.LightColor=Color3.new(1,1,1); view.Parent=parent
	local camera=Instance.new("Camera"); camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(7,5,8),Vector3.new(0,0.6,0)); camera.Parent=view; view.CurrentCamera=camera
	local function block(size,position,color,shape)
		local p=Instance.new("Part"); p.Size=size; p.Position=position; p.Color=color; p.Anchored=true; p.CanCollide=false
		p.Material=Enum.Material.Neon; p.Shape=shape or Enum.PartType.Block; p.Parent=view; return p
	end
	local cyan=Color3.fromRGB(116,235,246); local violet=Color3.fromRGB(163,116,243)
	if style=="ghost" then
		block(Vector3.new(3,1.2,1.2),Vector3.new(0,0.6,0),cyan,Enum.PartType.Ball)
		block(Vector3.new(1.4,1.3,1.1),Vector3.new(1.6,1.2,0),cyan,Enum.PartType.Ball)
		for _,z in ipairs({-0.4,0.4}) do block(Vector3.new(0.35,0.8,0.3),Vector3.new(1.4,2,z),violet) end
		for _,x in ipairs({-1,1}) do for _,z in ipairs({-0.4,0.4}) do block(Vector3.new(0.35,0.8,0.35),Vector3.new(x,-0.2,z),cyan) end end
		block(Vector3.new(1.5,0.5,0.5),Vector3.new(-2,1,0),violet)
	elseif style=="spectral" then
		block(Vector3.new(3.2,2.4,3.2),Vector3.new(0,0.3,0),violet,Enum.PartType.Ball)
		block(Vector3.new(2.8,0.25,2.8),Vector3.new(0,1.3,0),cyan)
	else
		block(Vector3.new(5,0.3,3),Vector3.new(0,0,0),violet)
		for _,x in ipairs({-2,2}) do block(Vector3.new(0.35,2.6,0.35),Vector3.new(x,1.2,0),cyan) end
		block(Vector3.new(4.5,0.3,0.3),Vector3.new(0,2.6,0),cyan)
	end
	return view
end
return Preview

--!nonstrict
-- Fixed outcomes and separate Gold/native-payment intents; no local grant method.
local UI={}
function UI.new()
	local ui={}; local reviewed
	local status={available="Доступно",upcoming="Событие ещё не началось",ended="Событие завершено",owned="Право уже получено",unavailable="Недоступно",epoch_unavailable="Недоступно в этой эпохе"}
	function ui.draw(ctx)
		local s=ctx.state.shop
		ctx.text("Событие / Магазин\nТочные предметы за заработанный Gold или отдельную покупку Roblox. Gold, Essence и Time Shards не продаются.",108)
		ctx.text("Покупки — рядом с алтарём на своём участке. Характеристики Gold- и Robux-экземпляров одинаковы. Срок события не удаляет полученные предметы.",96)
		for _,card in ipairs(s.cards) do
			ctx.text(card.name.." · "..(status[card.status] or card.status),48)
			if ctx.preview then ctx.preview(card.visual) end
			if card.stats then ctx.text("Farming "..card.stats.Farming.." / Hauling "..card.stats.Hauling.." / Brewing "..card.stats.Brewing,54) end
			ctx.text(card.effect,90)
			if card.event then ctx.text("Окно UTC: "..ctx.utc(card.event.startAtUtc).." → "..ctx.utc(card.event.endAtUtc)..". После окончания новые покупки закрываются; предмет остаётся навсегда.",108)
			else ctx.text("Постоянное предложение. Право привязано к аккаунту и не передаётся.",64) end
			ctx.text("В коллекции: "..card.owned.." · Оплачено, ждёт места: "..card.queued.." · Доставленных покупок: "..card.delivered,68)
			if card.delivered>0 then ctx.text("Уже обработанные чеки не создают копию после обмена или Fuse.",60) end
			ctx.text("Цена за заработанный Gold: "..card.goldCost,44)
			if card.available and card.room then
				if reviewed and reviewed.offerId==card.offerId and reviewed.sequence==s.sequence then
					local request=s.sequence+1
					ctx.action("Подтвердить "..card.goldCost.." Gold: "..card.name,function() ctx.send("buyEventGold",{offerId=card.offerId,confirmed=true,requestId=request}) end)
					ctx.action("Отменить покупку за Gold",function() reviewed=nil; ctx.redraw() end)
				else ctx.action("Купить за Gold: "..card.name,function() reviewed={offerId=card.offerId,sequence=s.sequence}; ctx.redraw() end) end
			elseif not card.room then ctx.text("Коллекция заполнена: новые покупки закрыты. Освободи место через подходящий Fuse или разрешённый обмен; оплаченные права остаются.",100) end
			local price=ctx.price and ctx.price(card)
			if card.robuxAvailable and price~=nil then
				ctx.action("Купить за Robux: "..price.." · "..card.name,function() ctx.send("requestPurchase",{offerId=card.offerId}) end)
				ctx.text("Цена получена от Roblox. Окончательная цена и подтверждение — в окне платформы.",65)
			else ctx.text("Robux: недоступно или цена не подтверждена. Бесплатный путь за Gold сохраняется.",64) end
		end
		if s.queued>0 then ctx.action("Доставить оплаченные предметы ("..s.queued..")",function() ctx.send("deliverPurchases",{requestId=s.sequence+1}) end) end
		ctx.action("Обновить права и доставки",function() ctx.send("refreshPurchases",{}) end)
	end
	return ui
end
return UI

--!nonstrict
-- Two-column review and explicit intents; server snapshots are the only item data.
local TradeUI={}
function TradeUI.new(config)
	local ui={}; local page,reviewHash,dismissed=1,nil,nil
	local status={invited="Приглашение",negotiating="Выбор предметов",both_ready="Оба готовы: проверь итог",frozen="Сохранение обмена",recovering="Восстановление обмена",settled="Обмен завершён",aborted="Обмен безопасно отменён",cancelled="Обмен отменён",declined="Приглашение отклонено"}
	local terminal={settled=true,aborted=true,cancelled=true,declined=true}
	local function description(entry)
		local item=entry.data; local origin=item.provenance
		local text=(entry.kind=="pet" and item.name or config.cauldronTypes[item.type].name).."\nID: "..entry.id
		if entry.kind=="pet" then
			text..="\n"..item.rarity.." · эволюция "..item.evolution
			for _,skill in ipairs({"Farming","Hauling","Brewing"}) do text..="\n"..skill..": "..item.stats[skill].." → "..((entry.effective or {})[skill] or 0) end
			text..="\nСправа — предел на твоих текущих станциях; назначение отдельно."
		else text..="\nТип: "..item.type.." · скорость варки +"..((item.brewSpeedBonus or 0)*100).."% · x2 +"..(item.bonus*100).." п.п. (общий предел "..(config.maxDoubleChance*100).."%)" end
		text..="\n"..(item.locked and "Защищён" or "Не защищён").." · источник: "..tostring(origin and origin.source or "неизвестен")
		text..="\nПлатное происхождение: "..(origin and origin.paidDerived and "да" or "нет")
		if origin and origin.parents and #origin.parents>0 then text..="\nFuse: "..table.concat(origin.parents,", ") end
		return text
	end
	function ui.draw(ctx)
		local value=ctx.value
		if not value then ctx.text("Ожидаем серверное состояние обмена…",60); return end
		if not value.enabled then ctx.text("Публичная торговля выключена. Доступ появится после живой проверки обменов и сохранений.",100); return end
		local t=value.session
		if t and dismissed==t.id and terminal[t.state] then t=nil end
		if value.blocked and not t then ctx.text(value.message or "Восстанавливаем обмен. Повторной выдачи предметов нет.",100); return end
		if not t then
			ctx.text("Подойдите вдвоём к стойке базара. Обмениваются только свободные фамильяры и редкие котлы, до 6 предметов с каждой стороны. Стартовые рабочие защищены.",110)
			for _,peer in ipairs(value.peers) do ctx.action("Пригласить: "..peer.name,function() ctx.send("tradeInvite",{targetToken=peer.token}) end) end
			if #value.peers==0 then ctx.text("Рядом нет доступных игроков. Оба участника должны находиться у стойки базара.",70) end
			return
		end
		ctx.text(status[t.state] or t.state,42)
		if t.reason then ctx.text(t.reason,60) end
		if terminal[t.state] then ctx.action("Новый обмен",function() dismissed=t.id; reviewHash=nil; ctx.redraw() end); return end
		local function send(action,extra)
			local payload=extra or {}; payload.tradeId=t.id; payload.version=t.version; ctx.send(action,payload)
		end
		if t.state=="invited" then
			ctx.text(t.sides[1].name.." → "..t.sides[2].name,56)
			if t.sides[2].mine then ctx.action("Принять приглашение",function() send("tradeAccept") end) end
			ctx.action("Отказать / отменить",function() send("tradeCancel") end); return
		end
		if t.state=="frozen" or t.state=="recovering" then
			ctx.text("Предметы временно недоступны. Сервер проверяет сохранённый результат. После подтверждённой передачи отмена не вернёт старое владение.",120)
			ctx.action("Запросить отмену до решения",function() send("tradeCancel") end); return
		end
		ctx.text("Предложение v"..t.version.." · готовность обеих сторон сбрасывается при любом изменении.",72)
		local row=ctx.text("",1)
		for i,side in ipairs(t.sides) do
			local column=Instance.new("Frame")
			column.BackgroundTransparency=1; column.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-5,0,0); column.Position=UDim2.new((i-1)*0.5,(i-1)*5,0,0)
			column.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; column.Parent=row
			local layout=Instance.new("UIListLayout"); layout.Padding=UDim.new(0,8); layout.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; layout.Parent=column
			local function label(text,order)
				local l=Instance.new("TextLabel"); l.BackgroundTransparency=1; l.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(237,239,246)
				l.TextWrapped=true; l.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; l.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham; l.TextSize=13
				l.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,30); l.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; l.LayoutOrder=order; l.Text=text; l.Parent=column
			end
			label((side.mine and "ТЫ: " or "ПАРТНЁР: ")..side.name.."\n"..(t.ready[tostring(i)] and "Готов" or "Выбирает"),0)
			for n,entry in ipairs(side.items) do label(description(entry),n) end
			if #side.items==0 then label("Ничего не передаёт (подарок)",1) end
		end
		local mine=t.sides[1].mine and t.sides[1] or t.sides[2]
		local mineIndex=t.sides[1].mine and "1" or "2"
		ctx.action("Отменить обмен",function() send("tradeCancel") end)
		if t.hash then ctx.text("Точный итог · v"..t.version.."\nSHA-256: "..t.hash,100) end
		ctx.action(t.ready[mineIndex] and "Снять готовность" or "Предложение готово",function() reviewHash=nil; send("tradeReady",{ready=not t.ready[mineIndex]}) end)
		if t.state=="both_ready" then
			if reviewHash~=t.hash then
				ctx.action("Проверил обе колонки — открыть подтверждение",function() reviewHash=t.hash; ctx.redraw() end)
			elseif not t.confirmed[mineIndex] then
				ctx.action("Подтвердить именно v"..t.version.." · "..string.sub(t.hash,1,12),function() send("tradeConfirm",{offerHash=t.hash}) end)
			else ctx.text("Твоё подтверждение принято. Ожидаем вторую сторону.",60) end
		end
		ctx.text("Твой инвентарь · выбор предметов",42)
		local maxPage=math.max(1,math.ceil(#value.inventory/6)); page=math.clamp(page,1,maxPage)
		for i=(page-1)*6+1,math.min(#value.inventory,page*6) do
			local entry=value.inventory[i]; local included=false
			for _,item in ipairs(mine.items) do if item.id==entry.id then included=true end end
			ctx.text(description(entry).."\n"..(entry.available and "Доступен для обмена" or (entry.reason or "Недоступен")),200)
			if entry.available or included then
				ctx.action((included and "Убрать: " or "Предложить: ")..(entry.data.name or config.cauldronTypes[entry.data.type].name),function()
					local items={}; for _,item in ipairs(mine.items) do if item.id~=entry.id then table.insert(items,{kind=item.kind,id=item.id}) end end
					if not included then table.insert(items,{kind=entry.kind,id=entry.id}) end
					reviewHash=nil; send("tradeOffer",{items=items})
				end)
			end
		end
		ctx.text("Страница "..page.." / "..maxPage,36)
		if page>1 then ctx.action("Предыдущие 6",function() page-=1; ctx.redraw() end) end
		if page<maxPage then ctx.action("Следующие 6",function() page+=1; ctx.redraw() end) end
	end
	return ui
end

--!nonstrict
-- One local presentation owner. Never sends an economic intent or changes a callback.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local Input=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService=game:GetService("GuiService")
local Shared=game.ReplicatedStorage.PotionTycoon.Shared
local Policy=require(Shared.ContextUI)
local Config=require(Shared.Config)
local Context={}
function Context.start(onChanged,isPanelOpen,blockedRects)
	local player=Players.LocalPlayer
	local root=workspace:WaitForChild("PotionTycoonWorld")
	assert(not root:GetAttribute("WorldContextOwned"),"Duplicate world context owner")
	root:SetAttribute("WorldContextOwned",true)
	local prompts,labels,pads,signs={},{},{},{}
	local current,candidates=nil,{}
	local pinned,pinnedUntil=nil,0
	local stopped=false
	local highlight=Instance.new("Highlight")
	highlight.Name="ContextFocus"; highlight.FillTransparency=1; highlight.OutlineTransparency=.25
	highlight.OutlineColor=Color3.fromRGB(229,211,157); highlight.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
	highlight.Parent=player.PlayerGui
	local function register(object)
		if object:IsA("BillboardGui") then
			labels[object]=object.Enabled; object.Enabled=false
		elseif object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and object.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
			local anchor=object.Parent; local plot=anchor.Parent
			prompts[object]={enabled=object.Enabled,objectText=object.ObjectText,actionText=object.ActionText,
				anchor=anchor,plot=plot,id=anchor:GetFullName(),station=anchor:GetAttribute("StationId") or string.gsub(anchor.Name,"^Buy_",""),
				upgrade=string.sub(anchor.Name,1,4)=="Buy_",public=anchor.Name=="TradePost"}
			object.Enabled=false
		elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
			if string.sub(object.Name,1,4)=="Buy_" then
				pads[object]={color=object.Color,material=object.Material}
				object.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic; object.Color=Color3.fromRGB(123,143,122)
			elseif object.Name=="Sign" and object.Parent:GetAttribute("PlotIndex") then
				signs[object]=object.LocalTransparencyModifier; object.LocalTransparencyModifier=1
			end
		end
	end
	for _,object in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do register(object) end
	local added=root.DescendantAdded:Connect(register)
	local ray=RaycastParams.new(); ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local elapsed=0
	local function update(cycle)
		local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera; local character=player.Character
		local hrp=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local entries={}
		local region=nil
		if hrp then
			for _,plot in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
				local floor=plot:FindFirstChild("Floor")
				if plot:GetAttribute("PlotIndex") and floor then
					local p=floor.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(hrp.Position)
					if math.abs(p.X)<=floor.Size.X/2 and math.abs(p.Z)<=floor.Size.Z/2 then
						local owner=plot:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
						region=owner==player.UserId and "Моя ферма" or (owner and "Чужая ферма · только осмотр" or "Свободный участок")
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if cam and hrp and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and not isPanelOpen() and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen and not Input:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			local ignored={character}
			for sign in pairs(signs) do if sign.Parent then table.insert(ignored,sign) end end
			ray.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignored
			for prompt,record in pairs(prompts) do
				local anchor=record.anchor
				if prompt.Parent and anchor:IsDescendantOf(root) then
					local distance=(anchor.Position-hrp.Position).Magnitude
					local point,visible=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(anchor.Position)
					local clear=false
					if distance<=prompt.MaxActivationDistance and visible then
						local hit=workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position,anchor.Position-cam.CFrame.Position,ray)
						clear=not hit or hit.Instance==anchor
					end
					table.insert(entries,{id=record.id,station=record.station,upgrade=record.upgrade,public=record.public,
						owner=record.plot:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId"),enabled=record.enabled,visible=visible,clear=clear,
						distance=distance,maximum=prompt.MaxActivationDistance,x=point.X,y=point.Y,z=point.Z,
						aim=math.abs(point.X/cam.ViewportSize.X-.5),prompt=prompt,anchor=anchor})
				end
			end
			candidates=Policy.candidates(entries,player.UserId,cam.ViewportSize.X,cam.ViewportSize.Y,blockedRects and blockedRects())
		else candidates={} end
		current=Policy.choose(candidates,current and current.id,cycle)
		if cycle and current then pinned,pinnedUntil=current.id,os.clock()+8 end
		if pinned and os.clock()<pinnedUntil then
			for _,entry in ipairs(candidates) do if entry.id==pinned then current=entry; break end end
		end
		for prompt,record in pairs(prompts) do
			if prompt.Parent then
				prompt.Enabled=current~=nil and current.prompt==prompt
				-- Keep Roblox's native keyboard/gamepad/touch control and hold semantics.
				prompt.ObjectText=Policy.description(record,Config)
				prompt.ActionText=record.upgrade and "Улучшить" or (record.station=="crystal" and "Собрать" or "Открыть")
			end
		end
		for gui in pairs(labels) do if gui.Parent then gui.Enabled=false end end
		highlight.Adornee=current and current.anchor or nil
		onChanged(current,#candidates,region)
	end
	local heartbeat=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) elapsed+=dt; if elapsed>=.1 then elapsed=0; update(false) end end)
	local input=Input.InputBegan:Connect(function(key,handled)
		if not handled and not Input:GetFocusedTextBox() and (key.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.X or key.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1) then update(true) end
	end)
	local self={}
	function self.next() update(true) end
	function self.current() return current end
	function self.refresh() update(false) end
	function self.stop()
		if stopped then return end; stopped=true; heartbeat:Disconnect(); added:Disconnect(); input:Disconnect(); highlight:Destroy()
		for prompt,record in pairs(prompts) do if prompt.Parent then prompt.Enabled=record.enabled; prompt.ObjectText=record.objectText; prompt.ActionText=record.actionText end end
		for gui,enabled in pairs(labels) do if gui.Parent then gui.Enabled=enabled end end
		for pad,record in pairs(pads) do if pad.Parent then pad.Color=record.color; pad.Material=record.material end end
		for sign,transparency in pairs(signs) do if sign.Parent then sign.LocalTransparencyModifier=transparency end end
		root:SetAttribute("WorldContextOwned",nil)
	end
	update(false)
	return self
end
return Context

-- Server-only recovery; no remotes, profile writes, rewards or interaction grants.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local Recovery=require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PotionTycoon.Shared.CharacterRecovery)

local elapsed=0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	elapsed+=dt

	elapsed=0
	for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character=player.Character
		local hrp=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

--!nonstrict
local Shared=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PotionTycoon.Shared
local Config=require(Shared.EnvironmentConfig)
local Plan=require(Shared.EnvironmentPlan)
local Field=require(Shared.EnvironmentTerrain)
local State=require(Shared.EnvironmentState)
local Art={}
local function meadow(floor,enabled)
	-- Preserve the existing collision/friction contract while replacing only
	-- native Grass shading. Local PBR packs fail Studio's TexturePack loader;
	-- an immutable, low-frequency top Texture works at graphics 5 and 10.
	if floor.CustomPhysicalProperties==nil then floor.CustomPhysicalProperties=PhysicalProperties.new(floor.Material) end
	local texture=floor:FindFirstChild("M7Meadow")
	if not texture then
		texture=Instance.new("Texture"); texture.Name="M7Meadow"; texture.Face=Enum.NormalId.Top
		texture.Texture=Config.polishPrefix.."meadow.png"; texture.StudsPerTileU=14; texture.StudsPerTileV=14; texture.Parent=floor
	end
	texture.Color3=floor.Color; texture.Transparency=enabled and 0 or 1
	if enabled then floor.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic end
end
local function landscape()
	local terrain=workspace.Terrain; local b=Field.bounds; local r=Field.resolution
	local region=Region3.new(Vector3.new(table.unpack(b.min)),Vector3.new(table.unpack(b.max)))
	local materials,occupancy=terrain:ReadVoxels(region,r)
	-- Fill only empty voxels of the reserved pilot region; never clear existing terrain.
	for ix=1,#materials do for iy=1,#materials[ix] do for iz=1,#materials[ix][iy] do
		if occupancy[ix][iy][iz]==0 then
			local x,y,z=b.min[1]+(ix-.5)*r,b.min[2]+(iy-.5)*r,b.min[3]+(iz-.5)*r
			-- Keep the smoothed voxel skin below the original work floor. Studio
			-- raycast assertions cover this boundary; descriptor height alone cannot.
			local h=Field.reserved(x,z) and -2.4 or Field.height(x,z)-2.2
			local solid=math.clamp((h-y+r/2)/r,0,1)
			if solid>0 then
				materials[ix][iy][iz]=Field.height(x,z)<-.5 and Enum.Material.Sand or (y<h-5 and Enum.Material.Rock or Enum.Material.Grass)
				occupancy[ix][iy][iz]=solid
			elseif y< -2 then materials[ix][iy][iz]=Enum.Material.Water; occupancy[ix][iy][iz]=math.clamp((-2-y+r/2)/r,0,1) end
		end
	end end end
	terrain:WriteVoxels(region,r,materials,occupancy)
	terrain:SetMaterialColor(Enum.Material.Grass,Color3.fromRGB(141,166,107))
	terrain:SetMaterialColor(Enum.Material.Rock,Color3.fromRGB(135,137,129))
	terrain:SetMaterialColor(Enum.Material.Sand,Color3.fromRGB(190,177,143))
	terrain.WaterColor=Color3.fromRGB(96,149,156); terrain.WaterTransparency=.35; terrain.WaterReflectance=.12
end
function Art.attach(world)
	assert(not world.root:FindFirstChild("EnvironmentArt"),"Environment already attached")
	local templates=game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild("M7NatureTemplates")
	assert(templates,"Reviewed nature templates missing from build")
	landscape()
	-- Terrain collision data becomes queryable on the following simulation step.
	game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait()
	local ground=RaycastParams.new(); ground.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	ground.FilterDescendantsInstances={workspace.Terrain,world.root.ForestFloor,world.plots[Config.pilotPlot].model.Floor}
	local folder=Instance.new("Folder"); folder.Name="EnvironmentArt"; folder.Parent=world.root
	for _,d in ipairs(Plan.build(Config,Config.pilotPlot).parts) do
		local position=Vector3.new(table.unpack(d.position))
		if d.template then
			local hit=workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(position.X,60,position.Z),Vector3.new(0,-110,0),ground)
			assert(hit,"Decoration has no supporting ground: "..d.id.." / "..d.template)
			position=Vector3.new(position.X,hit.Position.Y+(d.flatten~=1 and (.16+(tonumber(string.match(d.id,"%d+"))%7)*.045) or -.08),position.Z)
		end
		local cf=CFrame.new(position)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(d.rotation[1]),math.rad(d.rotation[2]),math.rad(d.rotation[3]))
		local model
		if d.template then
			local source=templates:FindFirstChild(d.template); assert(source and source:IsA("Model"),"Unknown nature template")
			model=source:Clone(); model.Name=d.id
			if string.find(d.template,"Grass") then for _,p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then p.Color=Color3.fromRGB(138,195,112) end
			end end
			-- The original fern atlas has pale edge pixels. A stable leaf tint limits
			-- their contrast without removing alpha or changing the reviewed mesh.
			if d.template=="Fern_1" then for _,p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then p.Color=Color3.fromRGB(143,190,107) end
			end end
			if d.template=="RockPath_Round_Small_1" then for _,p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				-- The heavily flattened stones use a quiet native surface; retain the
				-- reviewed geometry without magnifying the source atlas's dark seams.
				if p:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then p:Destroy()
				elseif p:IsA("MeshPart") then p.TextureID=""; p.Color=Color3.fromRGB(186,176,149); p.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic; p.CastShadow=false end
			end end
			if d.flatten~=1 then for _,p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then
				p.Size=Vector3.new(p.Size.X,p.Size.Y*d.flatten,p.Size.Z)
				p.Position=Vector3.new(p.Position.X,p.Position.Y*d.flatten,p.Position.Z)
			end end end
			model.WorldPivot=CFrame.identity; model:ScaleTo(d.scale); model:PivotTo(cf)
		else
			model=Instance.new("Part"); model.Name=d.id; model.Size=Vector3.new(table.unpack(d.size)); model.CFrame=cf
			model.Color=Color3.fromRGB(table.unpack(Config.palette[d.color])); model.Material=Enum.Material[d.material]
		end
		local objects=model:IsA("BasePart") and {model} or model:GetDescendants()
		for _,p in ipairs(objects) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			p.Anchored,p.CanCollide,p.CanTouch,p.CanQuery=true,d.barrier==true,false,d.barrier==true
			p:SetAttribute("PhysicalBarrier",d.barrier==true)
			p:SetAttribute("EnvironmentDetail",d.detail); p:SetAttribute("EnvironmentWind",false); p:SetAttribute("EnvironmentLight",d.light==true)
		end end
		model.Parent=folder
	end
	require(script.Parent.FenceBarriers).attach(folder)
	world.root.ForestFloor.Color=Color3.fromRGB(table.unpack(Config.palette.grass)); world.root.ForestFloor.Material=Enum.Material.Grass
	meadow(world.root.ForestFloor,true)
	world.root.Bazaar.Color=Color3.fromRGB(table.unpack(Config.palette.stone)); world.root.Bazaar.Material=Enum.Material.Sandstone
	world.root:SetAttribute("EnvironmentArtEnabled",true); world.root:SetAttribute("EnvironmentPilotPlot",Config.pilotPlot)
	Art.update(world.plots[Config.pilotPlot],0,false)
end
function Art.update(plot,rebirths,aurora)
	if plot.index~=Config.pilotPlot then return end
	local surface=State.surface(Config,rebirths,aurora)
	plot.model.Floor.Color=Color3.fromRGB(table.unpack(surface.color)); plot.model.Floor.Material=Enum.Material[surface.material]
	meadow(plot.model.Floor,surface.material=="Grass")
end
return Art

--!nonstrict
local Barriers={}
function Barriers.attach(art)
	local folder=Instance.new("Folder"); folder.Name="FenceCollisions"; folder.Parent=art.Parent
	for _,rail in ipairs(art:GetChildren()) do
		if rail:IsA("BasePart") and rail:GetAttribute("PhysicalBarrier") and rail.Size.X>1 then
			-- Thin rails alone let the Humanoid step/slide through. Fill the fence
			-- opening up to the existing post tops (3.2); never span the entrance.
			local p=Instance.new("Part"); p.Name=rail.Name.."Collision"
			p.Size=Vector3.new(rail.Size.X,3,.5)
			p.CFrame=CFrame.new(rail.Position.X,1.7,rail.Position.Z)
			p.Anchored=true; p.CanCollide=true; p.CanTouch=false; p.CanQuery=true
			p.Transparency=1; p.CastShadow=false; p.Parent=folder
		end
	end
end
return Barriers
