--!nonstrict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PotionTycoon"):WaitForChild("Shared")
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Factory = require(Shared.Factory).new(Config)
local Protocol = require(Shared.Protocol).new()
local CollectionModule = require(Shared.Collection)
local Collection = CollectionModule.new(Config)
local ProgressionModule = require(Shared.Progression)
local Progression = ProgressionModule.new(Config)
local LongTermModule = require(Shared.LongTerm)
local LongTerm = LongTermModule.new(Config)
local MonetizationModule = require(Shared.Monetization)
local Monetization = MonetizationModule.new(Config)
local PurchaseRuntime = require(script.Parent.PurchaseRuntime)
local Policy = require(Shared.Policy)
local PolicyService = game:GetService("PolicyService")
local summonRandom = Random.new() -- Separate server-only RNG; never seeded from production/profile/client.
local ProfileStore = require(script.Parent.ProfileStore)
local Settings = require(script.Parent.ServerSettings)
local World = require(script.Parent.World)
local TradeRuntime = require(script.Parent.TradeRuntime)
local TradeSession = require(Shared.TradeSession)

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name, folder.Parent = "Remotes", ReplicatedStorage.PotionTycoon
local function remote(name)
	local value = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	value.Name, value.Parent = name, folder
	return value
end
local Action, State, Notice, Focus, Ready = remote("Action"), remote("State"), remote("Notice"), remote("Focus"), remote("Ready")
local TradeState = remote("TradeState")
local PurchasePrompt = remote("PurchasePrompt")
local memoryMode = RunService:IsStudio() and Settings.UseMemoryInStudio

local function copy(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
	local result = {}
	for key, child in pairs(value) do result[key] = copy(child) end
	return result
end

local dataStore
if memoryMode then
	-- Explicit Studio mode only. A real backend failure NEVER selects this backend.
	local records = {}
	dataStore = { UpdateAsync = function(_, key, transform)
		local updated = transform(copy(records[key]))
		if updated ~= nil then records[key] = copy(updated) end
		return copy(updated)
	end }
	function dataStore:RemoveAsync(key) records[key]=nil end
else
	dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Settings.DataStoreName)
end

local store = ProfileStore.new({
	dataStore = dataStore,
	now = os.time,
	owner = game.JobId .. ":" .. HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
	validate = Factory.validate,
	migrate = Factory.migrate,
	sleep = task.wait,
	leaseSeconds = Settings.LeaseSeconds,
})
local sessions, offlineReports, readyAt, noticesAt = {}, {}, {}, {}
local closing = false
local world
local trade
local purchases
local policy = Policy.new({ now = os.time, ttl = Config.collection.policyTTL, lookup = function(player)
	local finished, ok, result, abandoned = false, false, nil, false
	task.spawn(function()
		local success, value = pcall(PolicyService.GetPolicyInfoForPlayerAsync, PolicyService, player)
		if not abandoned then ok, result, finished = success, value, true end
	end)
	local deadline = os.clock() + Config.collection.policyTimeout
	while not finished and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait(0.05) end
	abandoned = true
	if not finished or not ok then error("policy_unavailable") end
	return result
end })

local function active(player)
	local session = sessions[player.UserId]
	return session and session.player == player and session.phase == "active"
end

local function notice(player, text, code)
	if player.Parent ~= Players then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (noticesAt[player.UserId] or -10) < 0.2 then return end
	noticesAt[player.UserId] = now
	Notice:FireClient(player, { text = text, code = code })
end

local function snapshot(player)
	local profile = store:get(player.UserId)
	if not active(player) or not profile or player.Parent ~= Players then return end
	if trade then trade.send(player) end
	if profile.trade.pending then return end -- Never expose a partially applied inventory.
	local builds, recipes = {}, {}
	for _, id in ipairs(Config.stationOrder) do
		builds[id] = Progression.buildState(profile, id)
		if Config.stations[id].defaultRecipe then
			recipes[id] = {}
			for recipeId, recipe in pairs(Config.recipes) do
				if recipe.station == Config.stations[id].archetype then recipes[id][recipeId] = Factory.recipeState(profile, id, recipeId) end
			end
		end
	end
	builds.warehouse, builds.pipes = Progression.buildState(profile,"warehouse"), Progression.buildState(profile,"pipes")
	local longTerm=LongTerm.state(profile,os.time())
	if trade.activeTrade(player.UserId) then longTerm.available=false; table.insert(longTerm.reasons,"Заверши активный обмен") end
	local orderAvailability = {}
	for id in pairs(Config.orders) do
		local available, reason = Factory.orderEligible(profile,id)
		orderAvailability[id] = { available=available, reason=reason or "" }
	end
	-- Explicit allowlist: no PRNG state, receipts, session leases or future private metadata.
	State:FireClient(player, {
		gold = profile.gold, essence = profile.essence,
		pets = copy(profile.pets), stations = copy(profile.stations),
		inventory = copy(profile.inventory), questStock = copy(profile.questStock),
		order = copy(profile.order), rebirths = profile.rebirths,
		longTerm=longTerm,
		shop=purchases.decorate(profile,Monetization.state(profile,os.time())),
		discoveredRecipes = copy(profile.discoveredRecipes),
		warehouseLevel = profile.warehouseLevel, pipes = profile.pipes,
		production = Factory.productionState(profile), tutorial = Factory.tutorialState(profile),
		orderProgress = Factory.orderState(profile), serverTime = profile.lastSimulatedAt,
		storage = Factory.storageState(profile),
		collection = { sequence = profile.collection.sequence, lastResult = profile.collection.last and copy(profile.collection.last.result) },
		progression = { sequence = profile.progression.sequence, lastResult = profile.progression.last and copy(profile.progression.last.result) },
		phase = Progression.phaseState(profile), builds = builds, recipes = recipes, orderOffers = Factory.orderOffers(profile), orderAvailability=orderAvailability, cauldrons = copy(profile.cauldrons),
		collectionPolicy = copy(policy.peek(player)), summonDetails = Collection.details("forest"), familiarShop = copy(Config.familiarShop),
		fusePreview = copy(sessions[player.UserId].fusePreview),
		offlineReport = offlineReports[player.UserId],
		writable = store:isWritable(player.UserId) and not sessions[player.UserId].collectionBusy and not (trade and trade.busy(player.UserId)),
		mode = memoryMode and "STUDIO_MEMORY" or "DATASTORE",
	})
end

local function handleDurable(player, action, payload)
	local session = sessions[player.UserId]
	session.collectionBusy = true
	snapshot(player)
	local ok, committed, result = pcall(function()
		local access = action == "summon" and policy.get(player) or policy.peek(player)
		-- Policy and a queued save can yield. Recheck identity, position and session.
		if sessions[player.UserId] ~= session or not active(player) or closing or not store:isWritable(player.UserId)
			or not world:inRange(player, action, payload, Settings.InteractDistance) then return false, "Session or position changed" end
		return store:transact(player.UserId, function(candidate)
			if sessions[player.UserId] ~= session or not active(player) or closing
				or not world:inRange(player, action, payload, Settings.InteractDistance) then return false, "Session or position changed" end
			local now = os.time()
			if MonetizationModule.isAction(action) then
				return Monetization.apply(candidate,action,payload,Factory,{now=now,tradeActive=trade.activeTrade(player.UserId),
					guard=function() return active(player) and not closing and not trade.activeTrade(player.UserId) and world:inRange(player,action,payload,Settings.InteractDistance) end})
			end
			if LongTermModule.isAction(action) then
				return LongTerm.apply(candidate,action,payload,Factory,{now=now,tradeActive=trade.activeTrade(player.UserId),
					guard=function() return active(player) and not closing and not trade.activeTrade(player.UserId) and world:inRange(player,action,payload,Settings.InteractDistance) end})
			end
			local report = Factory.advance(candidate, now, false)
			assert(report.ok, report.error)
			if ProgressionModule.isAction(action) then return Progression.apply(candidate,action,payload,Factory,now) end
			return Collection.apply(candidate, action, payload, { now = now, policy = access, preview = session.fusePreview,
				nextInteger = function(lo, hi) return summonRandom:NextInteger(lo, hi) end })
		end)
	end)
	session.collectionBusy = false
	if sessions[player.UserId] ~= session or not active(player) then return end
	if not ok or (not committed and not store:isWritable(player.UserId)) then
		store:invalidate(player.UserId)
		session.quarantined, session.phase = true, "blocked"
		player:Kick("Не удалось подтвердить сохранение операции. Войдите снова: сохранённая операция будет восстановлена без повторной выдачи.")
		return
	end
	if committed then
		if action == "fuse" then session.fusePreview = nil end
		if action == "rebirth" then session.fusePreview=nil; offlineReports[player.UserId]=nil end
		notice(player, result.message, "collection_committed")
		world:update(player, store:get(player.UserId))
	else notice(player, tostring(result), "collection_rejected") end
	snapshot(player)
end

local function handleAction(player, action, payload)
	local allowed, reason = Protocol:check(player.UserId, action, payload, os.clock())
	if not allowed then
		if reason ~= "rate_limited" then notice(player, "Запрос отклонён: " .. tostring(reason), "rejected") end
		return
	end
	-- Legacy pure-domain buy remains for regression/migration fixtures only.
	if action == "buy" then notice(player, "Обнови клиент: покупки требуют подтверждённого сохранения.", "obsolete_intent"); return end
	if TradeSession.isAction(action) then
		local ok,accepted,message=pcall(trade.handle,player,action,payload)
		if not ok then notice(player,"Обмен ожидает безопасного восстановления.","trade_pending")
		elseif not accepted then notice(player,tostring(message),"trade_rejected") end
		return
	end
	if closing or not active(player) or not store:isWritable(player.UserId) then
		notice(player, "Профиль загружается или ожидает безопасного сохранения.", "profile_locked")
		return
	end
	if sessions[player.UserId].collectionBusy then notice(player, "Коллекция сохраняется. Дождись результата.", "collection_busy"); return end
	if trade.busy(player.UserId) then notice(player,"Обмен сохраняется. Дождись результата.","trade_pending"); return end
	if not world:inRange(player, action, payload, Settings.InteractDistance) then
		notice(player, "Подойди к нужному объекту на своём участке.", "out_of_range")
		return
	end
	if CollectionModule.isAction(action) or ProgressionModule.isAction(action) or LongTermModule.isAction(action) or MonetizationModule.isAction(action) then handleDurable(player, action, payload); return end
	if action=="requestPurchase" then
		local _,message=purchases.prompt(player,payload.offerId); notice(player,tostring(message),"purchase_prompt"); return
	end
	if action=="refreshPurchases" then
		local session=sessions[player.UserId]; if session.purchaseRefreshing then return end
		session.purchaseRefreshing=true; local ok=pcall(purchases.refresh,player); session.purchaseRefreshing=false
		if not ok then notice(player,"Права пока не подтверждены; повтори позже.","purchase_pending") end
		snapshot(player); return
	end
	if action == "refreshPolicy" then
		local session = sessions[player.UserId]
		if session.policyRefreshing then return end
		session.policyRefreshing = true
		policy.get(player)
		session.policyRefreshing = false
		if sessions[player.UserId] == session and active(player) then snapshot(player) end
		return
	end
	local profile = store:get(player.UserId)
	if action == "previewFuse" then
		local preview, reason = Collection.preview(profile, payload.petIds)
		if preview then
			preview.token, preview.expiresAt = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), os.time() + Config.collection.policyTTL
			sessions[player.UserId].fusePreview = preview
		else
			sessions[player.UserId].fusePreview = nil
			notice(player, reason, "fuse_preview_rejected")
		end
		snapshot(player)
		return
	end
	local ok, success, message = pcall(function()
		local result = Factory.advance(profile, os.time(), false)
		assert(result.ok ~= false, result.error or "simulation_failed")
		local success, message = Factory.act(profile, action, payload, os.time())
		local valid, reason = Factory.validate(profile)
		assert(valid, reason or "invalid_action_result")
		return success, message
	end)
	if not ok then
		store:invalidate(player.UserId)
		sessions[player.UserId].quarantined = true
		sessions[player.UserId].phase = "blocked"
		warn("Factory action failed; profile disabled", player.UserId, success)
		player:Kick("Внутренняя ошибка фабрики. Профиль остановлен, попробуйте войти снова.")
		return
	end
	if not success then notice(player, tostring(message), "action_failed")
	elseif action ~= "click" then
		notice(player, tostring(message or "Готово"), "ok")
		snapshot(player)
		world:update(player, profile)
	end
end

local function purchaseTransaction(userId,transform)
	local session=sessions[userId]; local player=session and session.player
	if not player or closing or not active(player) or session.collectionBusy or trade.activeTrade(userId) or not store:isWritable(userId) then return false,"Profile unavailable; paid right waits" end
	session.collectionBusy=true
	local ok,committed,result=pcall(function()
		return store:transact(userId,function(candidate)
			local function guard() return sessions[userId]==session and active(player) and not closing and not trade.activeTrade(userId) end
			if not guard() then return false,"Player session changed" end
			return transform(candidate,{now=os.time(),tradeActive=trade.activeTrade(userId),guard=guard})
		end)
	end)
	session.collectionBusy=false
	if not ok or (not committed and not store:isWritable(userId)) then
		store:invalidate(userId); session.quarantined=true
		if active(player) then player:Kick("Покупка ожидает подтверждения сохранения. Повтори вход; оплаченные права не выдаются повторно.") end
		return false,"Profile purchase outcome unconfirmed"
	end
	if committed and active(player) then world:update(player,store:get(userId)); snapshot(player) end
	return committed,result
end

world = World.new(Config, Settings.PlotCount, {
	production = Factory.productionState,
	buildState = Progression.buildState,
	phaseState = Progression.phaseState,
	orderProgress = Factory.orderState,
	action = handleAction,
	focus = function(player, stationId)
		if active(player) then Focus:FireClient(player, stationId) end
	end,
}, Settings.EnvironmentArtEnabled)
trade = TradeRuntime.new({config=Config,settings=Settings,store=store,backend=dataStore,engine=Factory,policy=policy,
	memoryMode=memoryMode,remote=TradeState,active=active,closing=function() return closing end,
	inBazaar=function(player) return world:inBazaar(player) end,
	valueBusy=function(player) return sessions[player.UserId] and sessions[player.UserId].collectionBusy end,
	updated=function(player) if active(player) then world:update(player,store:get(player.UserId)); snapshot(player) end end,
})
purchases = PurchaseRuntime.new({config=Config,settings=Settings,store=store,backend=dataStore,engine=Factory,model=Monetization,
	memoryMode=memoryMode,active=active,profile=function(uid) return store:get(uid) end,
	writable=function(uid) return store:isWritable(uid) end,
	busy=function(uid) return closing or not sessions[uid] or sessions[uid].collectionBusy or trade.activeTrade(uid) end,
	inRange=function(player) return world:inRange(player,"requestPurchase",{},Settings.InteractDistance) end,
	transact=purchaseTransaction,promptRemote=PurchasePrompt})
Action.OnServerEvent:Connect(handleAction)
Ready.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (readyAt[player.UserId] or -10) < 2 then return end
	readyAt[player.UserId] = now
	snapshot(player)
end)

local function placeCharacter(player, character)
	local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	local plot = world.owners[player.UserId]
	if hrp and plot and plot.owner == player and player.Parent == Players then
		character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(plot.spawn.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)))
	end
end

local function clearPresentation(session)
	local player, userId = session.player, session.player.UserId
	trade.leave(player)
	purchases.leave(player)
	world:release(player)
	policy.forget(player)
	if sessions[userId] ~= session then return end
	Protocol:forget(userId)
	offlineReports[userId], readyAt[userId], noticesAt[userId] = nil, nil, nil
end

local function closeSession(session)
	if session.closeRunning then return end
	trade.leave(session.player)
	if session.phase == "loading" then
		session.cancelled = true
		return -- The in-flight load owns cleanup until it returns.
	end
	session.closeRunning = true
	local player, userId = session.player, session.player.UserId
	local wasActive = session.phase == "active"
	session.phase = "closing"
	if wasActive and store:isWritable(userId) and not trade.busy(userId) then
		local ok, result = pcall(Factory.advance, store:get(userId), os.time(), false)
		if not ok or result.ok == false then
			session.quarantined = true
			store:invalidate(userId)
		end
	end
	local released = store:get(userId) == nil
	local deadline = os.clock() + 22
	local attempts = 0
	while not released and not session.quarantined and os.clock() < deadline and attempts < 5 do
		attempts += 1
		local ok, result, err = pcall(store.release, store, userId)
		released = ok and result
		if not released then
			warn("Profile release pending", userId, err or result)
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end
	clearPresentation(session)
	if sessions[userId] == session then
		if released then sessions[userId] = nil
		else session.phase = "blocked" end
	end
	session.closeRunning = false
end

local function onPlayer(player)
	local userId = player.UserId
	if closing then player:Kick("Сервер завершает работу."); return end
	if sessions[userId] then
		player:Kick("Предыдущая сессия ещё завершается. Повторите вход или выберите другой сервер.")
		return
	end
	local session = { player = player, phase = "loading", cancelled = false }
	sessions[userId] = session
	local plot = world:claim(player)
	if not plot then
		sessions[userId] = nil
		player:Kick("Все участки заняты. Выберите другой сервер.")
		return
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character) placeCharacter(player, character) end)
	if player.Character then task.spawn(placeCharacter, player, player.Character) end
	local profile, errorCode = store:load(player.UserId, function()
		return Factory.newProfile(player.UserId, os.time())
	end)
	if not profile then
		clearPresentation(session)
		if sessions[userId] == session then sessions[userId] = nil end
		warn("Profile load denied", player.UserId, errorCode)
		if player.Parent == Players then player:Kick("Не удалось безопасно загрузить прогресс. Попробуйте позже.") end
		return
	end
	if closing or session.cancelled or player.Parent ~= Players then
		session.phase = "closing"
		closeSession(session)
		return
	end
	if profile.trade.pending then
		local recovered=trade.recoverPlayer(player)
		profile=store:get(userId)
		if not recovered or not profile or profile.trade.pending then
			session.phase="closing"
			player:Kick("Обмен ещё восстанавливается. Предметы сохранены в журнале; повторите вход позже.")
			closeSession(session); return
		end
	end
	local ok, report = pcall(Factory.advance, profile, os.time(), true)
	if not ok or report.ok == false then
		warn("Offline simulation failed", player.UserId, report)
		-- Never overwrite a profile after a simulation failure.
		store:invalidate(userId)
		session.quarantined, session.phase = true, "blocked"
		player:Kick("Ошибка расчёта фабрики. Прогресс не перезаписан.")
		closeSession(session)
		return
	end
	-- Persist the catch-up timestamp and rewards BEFORE allowing actions or showing the report.
	local saved, saveError = store:save(player.UserId)
	if not saved then
		warn("Offline save failed", player.UserId, saveError)
		session.phase = "closing"
		player:Kick("Не удалось сохранить офлайн-прогресс. Повторите вход позже.")
		closeSession(session)
		return
	end
	if closing or session.cancelled or player.Parent ~= Players then
		session.phase = "closing"
		closeSession(session)
		return
	end
	session.phase = "active"
	task.spawn(function() local ok=pcall(purchases.refresh,player); if not ok then warn("Purchase rights refresh pending",userId) end end)
	task.spawn(function()
		policy.get(player)
		if sessions[userId] == session and active(player) then snapshot(player) end
	end)
	offlineReports[player.UserId] = report
	world:update(player, profile)
	snapshot(player)
end

local function safeJoin(player)
	local ok, err = pcall(onPlayer, player)
	if ok then return end
	warn("Player initialization failed", player.UserId, err)
	local session = sessions[player.UserId]
	if session and session.player == player then
		if store:get(player.UserId) then
			store:invalidate(player.UserId)
			session.quarantined, session.phase = true, "blocked"
		else
			sessions[player.UserId] = nil
		end
		clearPresentation(session)
	end
	if player.Parent == Players then player:Kick("Не удалось безопасно запустить фабрику. Повторите вход позже.") end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) task.spawn(safeJoin, player) end)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(safeJoin, player) end

local function onLeave(player)
	local session = sessions[player.UserId]
	if session and session.player == player then closeSession(session) end
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onLeave)

task.spawn(function()
	while not closing do
		task.wait(1)
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if active(player) then
				if store:isWritable(player.UserId) and not sessions[player.UserId].collectionBusy and not trade.busy(player.UserId) then
					local ok, result = pcall(Factory.advance, store:get(player.UserId), os.time(), false)
					if not ok or result.ok == false then
						store:invalidate(player.UserId)
						sessions[player.UserId].quarantined = true
						sessions[player.UserId].phase = "blocked"
						warn("Simulation disabled", player.UserId, result)
						player:Kick("Ошибка фабрики. Выполните повторный вход.")
					else world:update(player, store:get(player.UserId)) end
				end
				snapshot(player)
			end
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while not closing do
		task.wait(Settings.AutosaveSeconds)
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if active(player) and not closing then
				local session = sessions[player.UserId]
				task.spawn(function()
					if sessions[player.UserId] ~= session or not active(player) or closing then return end
					local saved, err = store:save(player.UserId)
					if not saved then
						warn("Autosave failed", player.UserId, err)
						notice(player, "Сохранение временно недоступно. Действия могут быть приостановлены.", "save_error")
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	task.wait(5 + math.random()*5)
	while not closing do
		local ok=pcall(trade.sweep)
		if not ok then warn("Trade recovery pass deferred") end
		task.wait(Config.trading.recoverySeconds + math.random()*3)
	end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	closing = true
	for _, session in pairs(sessions) do
		task.spawn(closeSession, session)
	end
	local deadline = os.clock() + 28
	while os.clock() < deadline do
		local pending = false
		for _, session in pairs(sessions) do
			if session.phase == "loading" or session.closeRunning then pending = true; break end
		end
		if not pending then break end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end)

--!nonstrict
-- A dependency-injected, session-locked adapter for ONE player's DataStore key.
-- This is not a multi-profile transaction/escrow implementation.
--
-- All gameplay writes use the live profile returned by load(), and must first
-- pass isWritable(). The caller persists offline catch-up before exposing it.
-- owner MUST be unique for each live server/adapter session (e.g. JobId + GUID).
-- validate and UpdateAsync transforms must not yield. sleep may yield.

local ProfileStore = {}
ProfileStore.__index = ProfileStore

local RECORD_VERSION = 1
local MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = 9007199254740991

local function finite(value)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
end

local function integer(value)
	return finite(value) and value % 1 == 0 and math.abs(value) <= MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
end

-- Reject values DataStore cannot faithfully persist, including cycles and NaN.
-- Aliased (but acyclic) tables are copied independently, like serialization.
local function clone(value, ancestors, depth)
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "nil" or kind == "boolean" or kind == "string" then
		return value
	elseif kind == "number" then
		assert(finite(value), "non_finite_number")
		return value
	end
	assert(kind == "table", "non_serializable_value")
	assert(depth < 64, "profile_too_deep")
	assert(not ancestors[value], "cyclic_profile")
	assert(getmetatable(value) == nil, "profile_metatable")
	ancestors[value] = true
	local result = {}
	local numericCount, maximumIndex, stringCount = 0, 0, 0
	for key, child in pairs(value) do
		assert(type(key) == "string" or (integer(key) and key >= 1), "invalid_profile_key")
		if type(key) == "number" then
			numericCount += 1
			maximumIndex = math.max(maximumIndex, key)
		else
			stringCount += 1
		end
		result[key] = clone(child, ancestors, depth + 1)
	end
	assert(numericCount == 0 or stringCount == 0, "mixed_profile_table")
	assert(numericCount == maximumIndex, "sparse_profile_array")
	ancestors[value] = nil
	return result
end

local function copy(value)
	return clone(value, {}, 0)
end

local function keyFor(userId)
	-- Studio's multi-player test users can have negative IDs.
	if not integer(userId) then
		return nil
	end
	return "p:" .. tostring(userId)
end

function ProfileStore.new(options)
	assert(type(options) == "table", "options_required")
	assert(options.dataStore ~= nil and type(options.dataStore.UpdateAsync) == "function", "data_store_required")
	assert(type(options.now) == "function", "clock_required")
	assert(type(options.sleep) == "function", "sleep_required")
	assert(type(options.validate) == "function", "validator_required")
	assert(options.migrate == nil or type(options.migrate) == "function", "invalid_migrator")
	assert(type(options.owner) == "string" and #options.owner > 0 and #options.owner <= 256, "unique_owner_required")
	local leaseSeconds = options.leaseSeconds or 120
	local margin = options.safetyMarginSeconds or math.min(15, leaseSeconds / 4)
	local retries = options.retries or 3
	local delay = options.retryDelaySeconds or 0.25
	local gateTimeout = options.gateTimeoutSeconds or 10
	assert(finite(leaseSeconds) and leaseSeconds >= 30 and leaseSeconds <= 3600, "invalid_lease_duration")
	assert(finite(margin) and margin >= 0 and margin < leaseSeconds, "invalid_safety_margin")
	assert(integer(retries) and retries >= 1 and retries <= 10, "invalid_retries")
	assert(finite(delay) and delay >= 0 and delay <= 5, "invalid_retry_delay")
	assert(finite(gateTimeout) and gateTimeout > 0 and gateTimeout <= 30, "invalid_gate_timeout")
	return setmetatable({
		_dataStore = options.dataStore,
		_nowFunction = options.now,
		_sleep = options.sleep,
		_validate = options.validate,
		_migrate = options.migrate,
		_owner = options.owner,
		_leaseSeconds = leaseSeconds,
		_safetyMargin = margin,
		_retries = retries,
		_retryDelay = delay,
		_gateTimeout = gateTimeout,
		_entries = {},
		_gates = {},
		_operationSequence = 0,
	}, ProfileStore)
end

function ProfileStore:_now()
	local ok, value = pcall(self._nowFunction)
	if not ok or not finite(value) or value < 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return value
end

function ProfileStore:_snapshot(profile, expectedUserId, allowMigration)
	if type(profile) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "invalid_profile"
	end
	local copied, snapshot = pcall(copy, profile)
	if not copied then
		return nil, "invalid_profile"
	end
	if expectedUserId ~= nil and snapshot.userId ~= nil and snapshot.userId ~= expectedUserId then
		return nil, "profile_user_mismatch"
	end
	if allowMigration and self._migrate then
		local migrated, result = pcall(self._migrate, snapshot)
		if not migrated or type(result) ~= "table" then return nil, "profile_migration_failed" end
		-- Recheck serialization and identity after migration; never trust its output.
		return self:_snapshot(result, expectedUserId, false)
	end
	local checked, valid, reason = pcall(self._validate, snapshot)
	if not checked or valid ~= true then
		return nil, "invalid_profile" .. (type(reason) == "string" and ":" .. reason or "")
	end
	return snapshot
end

function ProfileStore:_recordValid(record, expectedUserId, allowMigration)
	if type(record) ~= "table" or record.schemaVersion ~= RECORD_VERSION then
		return false, "unsupported_record_schema"
	end
	if not integer(record.revision) or record.revision < 1 or record.revision >= MAX_SAFE_INTEGER then
		return false, "invalid_record_revision"
	end
	if record.lastOperationId ~= nil and type(record.lastOperationId) ~= "string" then
		return false, "invalid_operation_id"
	end
	local lease = record.lease
	if lease ~= nil and (
		type(lease) ~= "table"
		or type(lease.owner) ~= "string"
		or #lease.owner == 0
		or not finite(lease.expiresAt)
		or lease.expiresAt < 0
	) then
		return false, "invalid_record_lease"
	end
	local snapshot, reason = self:_snapshot(record.profile, expectedUserId, allowMigration)
	if not snapshot then
		return false, reason
	end
	return true, nil, snapshot
end

function ProfileStore:_operationId(key, operation)
	self._operationSequence += 1
	return self._owner .. ":" .. key .. ":" .. operation .. ":" .. tostring(self._operationSequence)
end

function ProfileStore:_acquireGate(key)
	local startedAt = self:_now()
	if not startedAt then
		return false, "invalid_clock"
	end
	local interval = 0.05
	-- An attempt bound also handles a broken/frozen injected clock safely.
	local attempts = math.ceil(self._gateTimeout / interval)
	for _ = 0, attempts do
		if not self._gates[key] then
			self._gates[key] = true
			return true
		end
		local now = self:_now()
		if not now then
			return false, "invalid_clock"
		end
		if now - startedAt >= self._gateTimeout then
			break
		end
		self._sleep(interval)
	end
	return false, "profile_busy"
end

function ProfileStore:_guarded(key, operation)
	local acquired, reason = self:_acquireGate(key)
	if not acquired then
		return false, reason
	end
	local ok, first, second = pcall(operation)
	self._gates[key] = nil
	if not ok then
		local entry = self._entries[key]
		if entry then
			entry.readOnly = true
			if entry.transactionPending then entry.lost, entry.transactionPending = true, false end
		end
		return false, "adapter_error"
	end
	return true, first, second
end

-- Errors may have an unknown write outcome. Each operation's ID remains stable
-- across retries; its transform recognizes an already committed operation.
function ProfileStore:_update(key, transform)
	for attempt = 1, self._retries do
		local attemptNow = self:_now()
		if not attemptNow then
			return nil, "invalid_clock"
		end
		local rejection = nil
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return self._dataStore:UpdateAsync(key, function(current)
				-- The request may have waited in a platform queue or replayed its
				-- callback. Check lease expiry at callback time, not dispatch time.
				local callbackNow=self:_now()
				if not callbackNow then rejection="invalid_clock"; return nil end
				local replacement, reason = transform(current, callbackNow)
				rejection = reason
				return replacement
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			if result == nil then
				return nil, rejection or "update_cancelled"
			end
			local valid, reason = self:_recordValid(result)
			if not valid then
				return nil, reason
			end
			return result
		end
		if attempt < self._retries then
			self._sleep(self._retryDelay * (2 ^ (attempt - 1)))
		end
	end
	return nil, "data_store_unavailable"
end

function ProfileStore:load(userId, createProfileFn, existingOnly)
	local key = keyFor(userId)
	if not key then
		return nil, "invalid_user_id"
	end
	if type(createProfileFn) ~= "function" then
		return nil, "profile_factory_required"
	end
	local entered, profile, reason = self:_guarded(key, function()
		local existing = self._entries[key]
		if existing then
			if self:isWritable(userId) then
				return existing.profile
			end
			return nil, "profile_read_only"
		end
		local operationId = self:_operationId(key, "load")
		-- Construct outside UpdateAsync: callbacks must never create side effects.
		local created, candidate = pcall(createProfileFn)
		if not created then
			return nil, "profile_factory_failed"
		end
		local defaultProfile, defaultReason = self:_snapshot(candidate, userId)
		if not defaultProfile then
			return nil, defaultReason
		end
		local result, updateReason = self:_update(key, function(current, now)
			if current == nil then
				if existingOnly then return nil,"record_missing" end
				return {
					schemaVersion = RECORD_VERSION,
					profile = copy(defaultProfile),
					lease = { owner = self._owner, expiresAt = now + self._leaseSeconds },
					revision = 1,
					lastOperationId = operationId,
				}
			end
			local valid, recordReason, migratedProfile = self:_recordValid(current, userId, true)
			if not valid then
				return nil, recordReason
			end
			local lease = current.lease
			if lease and lease.owner ~= self._owner and lease.expiresAt > now then
				return nil, "session_locked"
			end
			if current.lastOperationId == operationId and lease and lease.expiresAt > now then
				return current
			end
			return {
				schemaVersion = RECORD_VERSION,
				profile = migratedProfile,
				lease = { owner = self._owner, expiresAt = now + self._leaseSeconds },
				revision = current.revision + 1,
				lastOperationId = operationId,
			}
		end)
		if not result then
			return nil, updateReason
		end
		local now = self:_now()
		if not now or not result.lease or result.lease.owner ~= self._owner
			or result.lastOperationId ~= operationId
			or now >= result.lease.expiresAt - self._safetyMargin then
			return nil, "lease_not_confirmed"
		end
		local loaded, loadReason = self:_snapshot(result.profile, userId)
		if not loaded then
			return nil, loadReason
		end
		self._entries[key] = {
			userId = userId,
			profile = loaded,
			revision = result.revision,
			leaseExpiresAt = result.lease.expiresAt,
			readOnly = false,
			lost = false,
			closing = false,
			invalidated = false,
		}
		return loaded
	end)
	if not entered then
		return nil, profile
	end
	return profile, reason
end

function ProfileStore:get(userId)
	local key = keyFor(userId)
	local entry = key and self._entries[key]
	return entry and entry.profile or nil
end

function ProfileStore:hasLease(userId)
	local key = keyFor(userId)
	local entry = key and self._entries[key]
	if not entry or entry.readOnly or entry.lost or entry.closing or entry.invalidated or entry.transactionPending then
		return false
	end
	local now = self:_now()
	return now ~= nil and now < entry.leaseExpiresAt - self._safetyMargin
end

function ProfileStore:isWritable(userId)
	local profile=self:get(userId)
	return self:hasLease(userId) and not (profile and profile.trade and profile.trade.pending)
end

-- Recovery can acquire an existing profile but must never create a missing one.
-- A valid placeholder is used only for adapter shape validation, never written.
function ProfileStore:loadExisting(userId, placeholder)
	return self:load(userId,placeholder,true)
end

-- Quarantine a possibly partially mutated profile after a simulation exception.
-- Do not persist it, release its lock, or restore writable defaults. A write
-- already in flight holds its own pre-invalidation snapshot and may complete;
-- it can never make this entry writable again. The saved lease expires normally.
function ProfileStore:invalidate(userId)
	local key = keyFor(userId)
	if not key then
		return false, "invalid_user_id"
	end
	local entry = self._entries[key]
	if not entry then
		return false, "profile_not_loaded"
	end
	entry.invalidated = true
	entry.readOnly = true
	entry.lost = true
	entry.closing = true
	return true
end

local function equal(a,b)
	if type(a)~=type(b) then return false end
	if type(a)~="table" then return a==b end
	for k,v in pairs(a) do if not equal(v,b[k]) then return false end end
	for k in pairs(b) do if a[k]==nil then return false end end
	return true
end

function ProfileStore:_saveLocked(key, releasing, candidate, tradeWrite)
	local entry = self._entries[key]
	if not entry then
		if releasing then
			return true -- Idempotent duplicate PlayerRemoving/BindToClose release.
		end
		return false, "profile_not_loaded"
	end
	if releasing then
		entry.closing = true
	end
	if entry.invalidated then
		return false, "profile_invalidated"
	end
	if entry.lost then
		return false, "lease_lost"
	end
	if entry.closing and not releasing then
		return false, "profile_closing"
	end
	local now = self:_now()
	if not now then
		entry.readOnly = true
		return false, "invalid_clock"
	end
	if now >= entry.leaseExpiresAt then
		entry.readOnly = true
		entry.lost = true
		return false, "lease_expired"
	end
	-- Capture AFTER acquiring the per-key gate, so release cannot queue an older
	-- snapshot behind an autosave while gameplay advances the in-memory profile.
	local snapshot, reason = self:_snapshot(candidate or entry.profile, entry.userId)
	if not snapshot then
		entry.readOnly = true
		return false, reason
	end
	local expectedRevision = entry.revision
	local operationId = self:_operationId(key, releasing and "release" or "save")
	local result, updateReason = self:_update(key, function(current, attemptNow)
		if current == nil then
			return nil, "record_missing"
		end
		local valid, recordReason = self:_recordValid(current, entry.userId)
		if not valid then
			return nil, recordReason
		end
		-- A release may have committed before its response was lost.
		if releasing and current.lastOperationId == operationId and current.lease == nil then
			return current
		end
		local lease = current.lease
		if not lease or lease.owner ~= self._owner then
			return nil, "lease_lost"
		end
		if lease.expiresAt <= attemptNow then
			return nil, "lease_expired"
		end
		if current.lastOperationId == operationId then
			return current
		end
		if current.revision ~= expectedRevision then
			return nil, "revision_conflict"
		end
		if not tradeWrite and ((current.profile.trade and current.profile.trade.pending) or (snapshot.trade and snapshot.trade.pending))
			and not equal(snapshot,current.profile) then return nil,"trade_pending" end
		return {
			schemaVersion = RECORD_VERSION,
			profile = copy(snapshot),
			lease = not releasing and { owner = self._owner, expiresAt = attemptNow + self._leaseSeconds } or nil,
			revision = current.revision + 1,
			lastOperationId = operationId,
		}
	end)
	if not result then
		entry.readOnly = true
		if updateReason == "lease_lost" or updateReason == "lease_expired"
			or updateReason == "revision_conflict" or updateReason == "record_missing" then
			entry.lost = true
		end
		return false, updateReason
	end
	if result.lastOperationId ~= operationId then
		entry.readOnly = true
		entry.lost = true
		return false, "write_not_confirmed"
	end
	if releasing then
		if result.lease ~= nil then
			entry.readOnly = true
			entry.lost = true
			return false, "release_not_confirmed"
		end
		self._entries[key] = nil
		return true
	end
	local confirmedNow = self:_now()
	if not confirmedNow or not result.lease or result.lease.owner ~= self._owner
		or confirmedNow >= result.lease.expiresAt then
		entry.readOnly = true
		entry.lost = true
		return false, "lease_not_confirmed"
	end
	entry.revision = result.revision
	entry.leaseExpiresAt = result.lease.expiresAt
	entry.readOnly = entry.invalidated
	if candidate and not entry.invalidated then entry.profile = snapshot end
	return true
end

-- Freeze an isolated candidate, commit with the same lease/revision fencing, and
-- only then replace live state. transform must not yield or perform external I/O.
function ProfileStore:_transact(userId, transform, allowTrade)
	local key = keyFor(userId)
	if not key or type(transform) ~= "function" then return false, "invalid_transaction" end
	local entered, success, result = self:_guarded(key, function()
		if not (allowTrade and self:hasLease(userId) or not allowTrade and self:isWritable(userId)) then return false, "profile_read_only" end
		local entry = self._entries[key]
		local candidate, reason = self:_snapshot(entry.profile, userId)
		if not candidate then return false, reason end
		entry.transactionPending = true
		local called, accepted, response, replayed = pcall(transform, candidate)
		if not called or accepted ~= true then
			entry.transactionPending = false
			return false, called and response or "transaction_failed"
		end
		if replayed then
			entry.transactionPending = false
			return true, response -- A receipt from previously confirmed live state.
		end
		local saved, failure = self:_saveLocked(key, false, candidate, allowTrade)
		entry.transactionPending = false
		if not saved or entry.invalidated then
			-- An unknown write outcome must never be followed by saving the old live
			-- snapshot or generating another candidate. A new lease/load reconciles it.
			entry.readOnly, entry.lost = true, true
			return false, failure or "profile_invalidated"
		end
		return true, response
	end)
	if not entered then return false, success end
	return success, result
end

function ProfileStore:transact(userId, transform)
	return self:_transact(userId,transform,false)
end

-- Server-only recovery port. Never exposed through a client transform/payload.
function ProfileStore:transactTrade(userId, transform)
	return self:_transact(userId,transform,true)
end

function ProfileStore:save(userId)
	local key = keyFor(userId)
	if not key then
		return false, "invalid_user_id"
	end
	local entered, ok, reason = self:_guarded(key, function()
		return self:_saveLocked(key, false)
	end)
	if not entered then
		return false, ok
	end
	return ok, reason
end

function ProfileStore:release(userId)
	local key = keyFor(userId)
	if not key then
		return false, "invalid_user_id"
	end
	local entry = self._entries[key]
	if entry then
		-- Freeze gameplay immediately, even while waiting for an autosave's gate.
		entry.closing = true
	end
	local entered, ok, reason = self:_guarded(key, function()
		return self:_saveLocked(key, true)
	end)
	if not entered then
		return false, ok
	end
	return ok, reason
end

return ProfileStore

--!nonstrict
-- Trusted platform port; never callable by a client Remote. Each store has its own CAS boundary.
local runtimeScript=rawget(getfenv(),"script")
local Journal=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.ReceiptJournal or "./ReceiptJournal")
local Coordinator={}
function Coordinator.new(options)
	local service={}; local catalog,model=options.catalog,options.model
	function service.process(receipt)
		if not Journal.validReceipt(receipt) then return false,"Invalid receipt" end
		local offerId=catalog.resolve("product",receipt.ProductId); if not offerId then return false,"Unknown ProductId; investigate mapping" end
		local binding,why=options.journal.bind("product",receipt.ProductId,offerId,catalog.fingerprint(offerId)); if not binding then return false,why end
		local record,err=options.journal.record(receipt,offerId,binding.grantHash); if not record then return false,err end
		if record.state=="APPLIED" then return true,"already_processed" end
		local ok,result=options.transact(receipt.PlayerId,function(p,context)
			return model.acceptReceipt(p,receipt,offerId,options.engine,context)
		end)
		if not ok then return false,result end
		local committed,failure=options.journal.applied(record)
		if not committed then return false,failure end
		return true,result.status
	end
	function service.syncPass(userId,offerId)
		local passId=catalog.sku(offerId)
		if catalog.resolve("pass",passId)~=offerId then return false,"Pass unconfigured" end
		local identity=options.identity(userId); if not identity then return false,"Player unavailable" end
		local ok,owns=pcall(options.ownsPass,userId,passId)
		if not ok or owns~=true then return false,"Pass ownership unverified" end
		if options.identity(userId)~=identity then return false,"Player session changed" end
		local bound,err=options.journal.bind("pass",passId,offerId,catalog.fingerprint(offerId)); if not bound then return false,err end
		if options.identity(userId)~=identity then return false,"Player session changed" end
		return options.transact(userId,function(p,context)
			if options.identity(userId)~=identity then return false,"Player session changed" end
			context.verifiedOwned=true; return model.acceptPass(p,offerId,passId,options.engine,context)
		end)
	end
	return service
end
return Coordinator

--!nonstrict
-- The only platform receipt registration. No client callback can grant payment rights.
local MarketplaceService=game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local DataStoreService=game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Shared=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PotionTycoon.Shared
local Catalog=require(Shared.OfferCatalog)
local Journal=require(script.Parent.ReceiptJournal)
local Coordinator=require(script.Parent.PurchaseCoordinator)
local Runtime={}
function Runtime.new(options)
	local settings,config=options.settings,options.config
	local catalog=Catalog.new(config,settings.PurchaseSkus); local service={}; local prompting,lastPrompt,lastRefresh,warnings={},{},{},{}
	local backend=options.memoryMode and options.backend or DataStoreService:GetDataStore(settings.ReceiptJournalName)
	local journal=Journal.new({backend=backend,sleep=task.wait})
	local function identity(userId)
		local p=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId); return p and options.active(p) and p or nil
	end
	local coordinator=Coordinator.new({catalog=catalog,model=options.model,journal=journal,engine=options.engine,transact=options.transact,
		identity=identity,ownsPass=function(userId,id) return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(userId,id) end})
	local function enabled()
		return settings.MonetizationEnabled==true and settings.PurchaseQAApproved==true and not options.memoryMode
			and (RunService:IsStudio() or settings.PurchaseQAPlaceId>0 and game.PlaceId==settings.PurchaseQAPlaceId)
	end
	local function diagnostic(code,sku)
		local key=tostring(sku)..":"..tostring(code); local now=os.clock()
		if now-(warnings[key] or -60)>=60 then warnings[key]=now; warn("Purchase reconciliation pending",sku,code) end
	end
	MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt=function(receipt)
		-- Studio-memory sessions may never acknowledge a real financial transaction.
		if options.memoryMode then return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet end
		local ok,accepted,result=pcall(coordinator.process,receipt)
		if ok and accepted then return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted end
		diagnostic(ok and result or "processing_error",receipt.ProductId)
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	function service.decorate(p,state)
		for _,card in ipairs(state.cards) do
			local def=config.monetization.offers[card.offerId]; local id=catalog.sku(card.offerId)
			card.platformKind=def.platformKind
			card.robuxAvailable=enabled() and id>0 and card.available and card.room and not options.busy(p.userId)
				and state.receiptCount<config.monetization.maxReceipts and state.queued<config.monetization.maxQueued
			card.sku=card.robuxAvailable and id or 0
		end
		state.paidEnabled=enabled(); return state
	end
	function service.prompt(player,offerId)
		local uid=player.UserId; local def=config.monetization.offers[offerId]; local sku=catalog.sku(offerId)
		if not def or not enabled() or sku<=0 or prompting[player] or os.clock()-(lastPrompt[player] or -10)<5 then return false,"Покупки за Robux недоступны" end
		local function allowed()
			local p=options.profile(uid)
			return enabled() and identity(uid)==player and not options.busy(uid) and options.inRange(player) and p
				and options.writable(uid) and catalog.available(p,offerId,os.time()) and options.model.room(p,catalog.grant(offerId))
				and options.model.queued(p)<config.monetization.maxQueued and options.model.state(p,os.time()).receiptCount<config.monetization.maxReceipts
		end
		if not allowed() then return false,"Предложение, место или сессия недоступны" end
		prompting[player]=true; lastPrompt[player]=os.clock()
		local success,accepted,reason=pcall(function()
			local info=MarketplaceService:GetProductInfoAsync(sku,def.platformKind=="product" and Enum.InfoType.Product or Enum.InfoType.GamePass)
			if not info or info.IsForSale~=true or type(info.PriceInRobux)~="number" or not allowed() then return false,"Платформа не подтвердила доступность" end
			local bound,err=journal.bind(def.platformKind,sku,offerId,catalog.fingerprint(offerId)); if not bound then return false,err end
			if not allowed() then return false,"Условия изменились; открой магазин снова" end
			options.promptRemote:FireClient(player,{offerId=offerId,sku=sku,kind=def.platformKind})
			return true,"Проверь цену в нативном окне Roblox"
		end)
		prompting[player]=nil
		return success and accepted,success and reason or "Покупка сейчас недоступна"
	end
	function service.refresh(player,platformHint)
		if identity(player.UserId)~=player then return end
		local now=os.clock()
		if not platformHint and now-(lastRefresh[player] or -10)<10 then return end
		lastRefresh[player]=now
		for _,offerId in ipairs(config.monetization.offerOrder) do
			local def=config.monetization.offers[offerId]
			if def.platformKind=="pass" and catalog.sku(offerId)>0 and not options.memoryMode then coordinator.syncPass(player.UserId,offerId) end
		end
		if identity(player.UserId)~=player then return end
		local p=options.profile(player.UserId)
		if p and options.model.queued(p)>0 then
			options.transact(player.UserId,function(candidate,ctx)
				return options.model.apply(candidate,"deliverPurchases",{requestId=candidate.monetization.sequence+1},options.engine,ctx)
			end)
		end
	end
	MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player,passId)
		if catalog.resolve("pass",passId) then task.spawn(function() service.refresh(player,true) end) end -- Completion is a lookup hint, never evidence.
	end)
	function service.leave(player) prompting[player],lastPrompt[player],lastRefresh[player]=nil,nil,nil end
	return service
end
return Runtime

--!nonstrict
-- Immutable SKU binding + monotonic receipt evidence. No profile rewards in callbacks.
local runtimeScript=rawget(getfenv(),"script")
local Shared=runtimeScript and runtimeScript:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("DataModel").ReplicatedStorage.PotionTycoon.Shared
local C=require(Shared and Shared.TradeCodec or "../shared/TradeCodec")
local Catalog=require(Shared and Shared.OfferCatalog or "../shared/OfferCatalog")
local Journal={}
local function plain(v) return type(v)=="table" and getmetatable(v)==nil end
function Journal.validReceipt(r)
	return plain(r) and type(r.PurchaseId)=="string" and #r.PurchaseId>0 and #r.PurchaseId<=128
		and string.match(r.PurchaseId,"^[%w_:%-%.]+$")~=nil and Catalog.integer(r.PlayerId,1,9007199254740991)
		and Catalog.integer(r.ProductId,1,9007199254740991)
end
function Journal.key(purchaseId) return "r:"..string.sub(C.sha256(purchaseId),1,48) end -- DataStore keys <=50 bytes; full identity verified inside.
local function valid(r)
	return plain(r) and r.schemaVersion==1 and Journal.validReceipt({PurchaseId=r.purchaseId,PlayerId=r.userId,ProductId=r.productId})
		and r.keyHash==C.sha256(r.purchaseId) and Catalog.hash(r.grantHash) and type(r.offerId)=="string" and #r.offerId>0 and #r.offerId<=64
		and (r.state=="RECORDED" or r.state=="APPLIED")
end
function Journal.new(options)
	local service={}
	local function cas(key,transform,verify)
		for attempt=1,3 do
			local ok,result=pcall(function() return options.backend:UpdateAsync(key,transform) end)
			if ok then if result~=nil and verify(result) then return C.copy(result) end; return nil,"Journal conflict or invalid state" end
			if attempt<3 then options.sleep(0.25*2^(attempt-1)) end
		end
		return nil,"Journal outcome unconfirmed"
	end
	function service.bind(kind,sku,offerId,grantHash)
		if (kind~="product" and kind~="pass") or not Catalog.integer(sku,1,9007199254740991) or not Catalog.hash(grantHash) then return nil,"Invalid SKU binding" end
		local wanted={schemaVersion=1,kind=kind,sku=sku,offerId=offerId,grantHash=grantHash}
		local function same(r) return plain(r) and C.encode(r)==C.encode(wanted) end
		return cas("sku:"..kind..":"..string.format("%.0f",sku),function(old)
			if old==nil then return C.copy(wanted) end
			return same(old) and old or nil
		end,same)
	end
	function service.record(receipt,offerId,grantHash)
		if not Journal.validReceipt(receipt) or not Catalog.hash(grantHash) then return nil,"Invalid platform receipt" end
		local wanted={schemaVersion=1,purchaseId=receipt.PurchaseId,keyHash=C.sha256(receipt.PurchaseId),userId=receipt.PlayerId,
			productId=receipt.ProductId,offerId=offerId,grantHash=grantHash,state="RECORDED"}
		local function same(r)
			return valid(r) and r.purchaseId==wanted.purchaseId and r.keyHash==wanted.keyHash and r.userId==wanted.userId
				and r.productId==wanted.productId and r.offerId==wanted.offerId and r.grantHash==wanted.grantHash
		end
		return cas(Journal.key(receipt.PurchaseId),function(old) if old==nil then return C.copy(wanted) end; return same(old) and old or nil end,same)
	end
	function service.applied(record)
		if not valid(record) then return nil,"Invalid receipt evidence" end
		local function same(r)
			return valid(r) and r.purchaseId==record.purchaseId and r.userId==record.userId and r.productId==record.productId
				and r.offerId==record.offerId and r.grantHash==record.grantHash
		end
		return cas(Journal.key(record.purchaseId),function(old)
			if not same(old) then return nil end
			local result=C.copy(old); result.state="APPLIED"; return result
		end,function(r) return same(r) and r.state=="APPLIED" end)
	end
	return service
end
return Journal

--!nonstrict
-- Crash-safe orchestration; profiles.mutate must use normal lease/revision fencing.
local runtimeScript=rawget(getfenv(),"script")
local C=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("DataModel").ReplicatedStorage.PotionTycoon.Shared.TradeCodec or "../shared/TradeCodec")
local Coordinator={}
function Coordinator.new(options)
	local service={}; local journal,model=options.journal,options.model
	function service.recover(id,abortOwner)
		local j,reason=journal.read(id); if not j then return false,reason end
		if j.state=="PREPARING" then
			if not abortOwner and options.now()<j.deadline then return false,"Waiting for coordinator" end
			j,reason=journal.decide(id,"ABORT",abortOwner); if not j then return false,reason end
		end
		if j.state=="COMPLETE" then return true,j end
		for index,side in ipairs(j.sides) do
			if not j.applied[tostring(index)] then
				local ok,err=options.profiles.mutate(side.userId,function(p) return model.apply(p,j,index) end)
				if not ok then return false,err end
				j,reason=journal.ack(id,"applied",index); if not j then return false,reason end
			end
		end
		for index,side in ipairs(j.sides) do
			if not j.cleared[tostring(index)] then
				local ok,err=options.profiles.mutate(side.userId,function(p) return model.clear(p,j,index) end)
				if not ok then return false,err end
				j,reason=journal.ack(id,"cleared",index); if not j then return false,reason end
			end
		end
		return j.state=="COMPLETE",j
	end
	function service.start(id,proposal,refreshGuard)
		local now=options.now()
		local record={schemaVersion=1,id=id,coordinator=options.owner,version=proposal.version,sides=C.copy(proposal.sides),
			hash=C.hash(proposal),createdAt=now,deadline=now+options.prepareSeconds,state="PREPARING",prepared={},applied={},cleared={}}
		local j,reason=journal.create(record); if not j then return false,reason end
		if j.state~="PREPARING" then return service.recover(id) end
		for index,side in ipairs(j.sides) do
			if not j.prepared[tostring(index)] then
				local ok,err=options.profiles.mutate(side.userId,function(p) return model.reserve(p,j,index,options.now()) end)
				if not ok then service.recover(id,options.owner); return false,err end
				j,reason=journal.prepared(id,index); if not j then return false,reason end
				if j.state~="PREPARING" then return service.recover(id) end
			end
		end
		-- This may yield for policy. The returned guard must be non-yielding and
		-- recheck identity/proximity/fresh policy inside the journal's CAS callback.
		local ok,guard=pcall(refreshGuard)
		if not ok or not guard then return service.recover(id,options.owner) end
		local decided,err=journal.decide(id,"COMMIT",options.owner,guard)
		if not decided then
			-- Could be a lost COMMIT reply: read the journal, never assume ABORT.
			local recovered,result=service.recover(id,options.owner)
			return recovered,result or err
		end
		return service.recover(id)
	end
	return service
end
return Coordinator

--!nonstrict
-- Durable single-key decisions. Injected backend; no Roblox APIs in this module.
local runtimeScript=rawget(getfenv(),"script")
local C=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("DataModel").ReplicatedStorage.PotionTycoon.Shared.TradeCodec or "../shared/TradeCodec")
local Journal={}
function Journal.new(options)
	local service={}; local keys,index,nextShard={},1,0
	local shards,capacity=options.shards or 16,options.capacity or 128
	local function validId(id) return type(id)=="string" and #id>0 and #id<=80 and string.match(id,"^[%w_:%-%.]+$")~=nil end
	local function bucket(id) return tonumber(string.sub(C.sha256(id),1,8),16)%shards end
	local function validRegistry(r)
		if type(r)~="table" or r.schemaVersion~=1 or type(r.entries)~="table" then return false end
		local count=0
		for id,entry in pairs(r.entries) do
			count+=1
			if not validId(id) or type(entry)~="table" or type(entry.hash)~="string" or #entry.hash~=64
				or not string.match(entry.hash,"^[a-f0-9]+$") or type(entry.deadline)~="number" or entry.deadline~=entry.deadline
				or entry.deadline<0 or entry.deadline>1000000000000 or entry.deadline%1~=0 then return false end
		end
		return count<=capacity
	end
	local function registry(shard,transform)
		for attempt=1,2 do
			if options.budget and not options.budget() then return nil,"Trade request budget unavailable" end
			local rejection
			local ok,result=pcall(function()
				return options.backend:UpdateAsync("r:"..string.format("%02d",shard),function(current)
					current=current or {schemaVersion=1,entries={}}
					if not validRegistry(current) then rejection="Invalid recovery registry"; return nil end
					local replacement,reason=transform(C.copy(current)); rejection=reason
					if replacement and not validRegistry(replacement) then rejection="Invalid registry transition"; return nil end
					return replacement
				end)
			end)
			if ok then
				if result and validRegistry(result) then return result end
				return nil,rejection or (result and "Invalid registry result" or "Registry missing")
			end
			if attempt<2 then options.sleep(0.25) end
		end
		return nil,"Registry outcome unknown"
	end
	local function untrack(id,expected)
		return registry(bucket(id),function(r)
			local entry=r.entries[id]
			if entry and (entry.hash~=expected.hash or entry.deadline~=expected.deadline) then return nil,"Registry identity conflict" end
			r.entries[id]=nil; return r
		end)
	end
	function service.update(id,transform)
		if not validId(id) then return nil,"Invalid journal ID" end
		for attempt=1,2 do
			if options.budget and not options.budget() then return nil,"Trade request budget unavailable" end
			local rejection
			local ok,result=pcall(function()
				return options.backend:UpdateAsync("t:"..id,function(current)
					if current and (not options.validate(current) or current.id~=id) then rejection="Invalid journal"; return nil end
					local nextValue,reason=transform(C.copy(current),options.now()); rejection=reason
					if nextValue and (not options.validate(nextValue) or nextValue.id~=id) then rejection="Invalid journal transition"; return nil end
					return nextValue
				end)
			end)
			if ok then
				if result and options.validate(result) and result.id==id then return result end
				return nil,rejection or "Journal missing"
			end
			if attempt<2 then options.sleep(0.25) end
		end
		return nil,"Journal outcome unknown"
	end
	function service.read(id) return service.update(id,function(current) return current end) end
	function service.create(record)
		if not options.validate(record) or record.state~="PREPARING" then return nil,"Invalid new journal" end
		local tracked,reason=registry(bucket(record.id),function(r)
			if options.now()>=record.deadline then return nil,"Expired journal creation" end
			local old=r.entries[record.id]
			if old then
				if old.hash~=record.hash or old.deadline~=record.deadline then return nil,"Registry identity conflict" end
				return r
			end
			local count=0; for _ in pairs(r.entries) do count+=1 end
			if count>=capacity then return nil,"Recovery registry full; new trades paused" end
			r.entries[record.id]={hash=record.hash,deadline=record.deadline}; return r
		end)
		if not tracked then return nil,reason end
		return service.update(record.id,function(current,now)
			if current then
				if current.hash==record.hash and current.coordinator==record.coordinator then return current end
				return nil,"Journal ID collision"
			end
			if now>=record.deadline then return nil,"Expired journal creation" end
			return C.copy(record)
		end)
	end
	function service.prepared(id,side)
		return service.update(id,function(j)
			if not j then return nil end
			if j.state=="PREPARING" then j.prepared[tostring(side)]=true end
			return j
		end)
	end
	function service.decide(id,decision,coordinator,guard)
		return service.update(id,function(j,now)
			if not j then return nil end
			if j.state~="PREPARING" then return j end
			if decision=="COMMIT" then
				if j.coordinator~=coordinator or now>=j.deadline or not j.prepared["1"] or not j.prepared["2"] or not guard or not guard(now) then return nil,"Commit prerequisites changed" end
			elseif decision~="ABORT" or (coordinator~=j.coordinator and now<j.deadline) then return nil,"Abort not authorized yet" end
			j.state,j.decision=decision,decision; return j
		end)
	end
	function service.ack(id,field,side)
		return service.update(id,function(j,now)
			if not j then return nil end
			if j.state=="COMPLETE" then return j end
			if field=="applied" and j.decision then j.applied[tostring(side)]=true
			elseif field=="cleared" and j.state=="SETTLED" then j.cleared[tostring(side)]=true
			else return nil,"Invalid acknowledgment stage" end
			if j.applied["1"] and j.applied["2"] then j.state="SETTLED" end
			if j.cleared["1"] and j.cleared["2"] then
				j.state,j.completedAt="COMPLETE",now
				for _,participant in ipairs(j.sides) do participant.items=nil end
			end
			return j
		end)
	end
	function service.collect(id)
		local j,reason=service.read(id); if not j then return false,reason end
		if j.state~="COMPLETE" or options.now()<math.max(j.deadline,j.completedAt)+options.retentionSeconds then return false,"Retained" end
		if options.budget and not options.budget() then return false,"Trade request budget unavailable" end
		-- COMPLETE is immutable and creation has expired. A late worker cannot
		-- replace this ID with a new transaction after the conditional read.
		local ok=pcall(function() options.backend:RemoveAsync("t:"..id) end)
		if not ok then return false,"GC pending" end
		local removed,err=untrack(id,j); return removed~=nil,err or "Collected"
	end
	function service.cleanMissing(id,entry)
		if not entry or options.now()<=entry.deadline then return false,"Creation still possible" end
		local j,reason=service.read(id)
		if j or reason~="Journal missing" then return false,reason or "Journal exists" end
		local removed,err=untrack(id,entry); return removed~=nil,err
	end
	function service.nextKey()
		if index<=#keys then local key=keys[index]; index+=1; return key.id,key.entry end
		for _=1,shards do
			local shard=nextShard; nextShard=(nextShard+1)%shards
			local r,reason=registry(shard,function(current) return current end)
			if not r then return nil,reason end
			keys={}; index=1
			for id,entry in pairs(r.entries) do table.insert(keys,{id=id,entry=entry}) end
			table.sort(keys,function(a,b) return a.id<b.id end)
			if #keys>0 then local key=keys[index]; index+=1; return key.id,key.entry end
		end
		return nil
	end
	return service
end
return Journal

--!nonstrict
-- Roblox adapter. Admission is private-QA-only; recovery never depends on UI or login.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService=game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local HttpService=game:GetService("HttpService")
local Shared=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PotionTycoon.Shared
local C=require(Shared.TradeCodec)
local Trading=require(Shared.Trading)
local TradeSession=require(Shared.TradeSession)
local Journal=require(script.Parent.TradeJournal)
local Coordinator=require(script.Parent.TradeCoordinator)
local ProfileStore=require(script.Parent.ProfileStore)
local Runtime={}
function Runtime.new(options)
	local config,settings,store=options.config,options.settings,options.store
	local model=Trading.new(config); local service={}; local tokens,peers,outcomes,lastSnapshots={},{},{},{}
	local owner="trade:"..HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local function enabled()
		return settings.TradingEnabled==true and (RunService:IsStudio() or (settings.TradingQAPlaceId>0 and game.PlaceId==settings.TradingQAPlaceId))
	end
	local function budget(minimum)
		return options.memoryMode or DataStoreService:GetRequestBudgetForRequestType(Enum.DataStoreRequestType.UpdateAsync)>=(minimum or 1)
	end
	local journalBackend=options.memoryMode and options.backend or DataStoreService:GetDataStore(settings.TradeJournalName)
	local journal=Journal.new({backend=journalBackend,now=os.time,sleep=task.wait,validate=model.validateJournal,
		retentionSeconds=config.trading.retentionSeconds,shards=config.trading.journalShards,capacity=config.trading.journalCapacity,budget=budget})
	local port={}
	function port.mutate(userId,transform)
		if not budget(3) then return false,"Recovery request budget low" end
		if store:get(userId) and store:hasLease(userId) then return store:transactTrade(userId,transform) end
		-- A fresh recovery owner acquires the ordinary lease; an existing live
		-- foreign lease blocks it. Never mutate another server's active profile.
		local recovery=ProfileStore.new({dataStore=options.backend,now=os.time,sleep=task.wait,
			owner="recovery:"..HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),validate=options.engine.validate,migrate=options.engine.migrate,leaseSeconds=settings.LeaseSeconds})
		local p,reason=recovery:loadExisting(userId,function() return options.engine.newProfile(userId,os.time()) end)
		if not p then return false,reason end
		local ok,result=recovery:transactTrade(userId,transform)
		local released=recovery:release(userId)
		return ok and released,result
	end
	local coordinator=Coordinator.new({journal=journal,model=model,profiles=port,now=os.time,owner=owner,prepareSeconds=config.trading.prepareSeconds})
	local function playerFor(userId)
		for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if player.UserId==userId then return player end end
		return nil
	end
	local function identity(userId)
		local player=playerFor(userId); return player and options.active(player) and player or nil
	end
	local manager
	local function decorate(items,p)
		local caps={Farming=0,Hauling=0,Brewing=0}
		for id,station in pairs(p.stations) do
			local def=config.stations[id]
			if station.level>0 then caps[def.skill]=math.max(caps[def.skill],def.statCaps[station.level]) end
		end
		for _,entry in ipairs(items) do
			if entry.kind=="pet" then entry.effective={}; for skill,base in pairs(entry.data.stats) do entry.effective[skill]=math.min(base,caps[skill]) end end
		end
	end
	function service.send(player,terminalTrade)
		if player.Parent~=Players then return end
		local p=store:get(player.UserId)
		local t=terminalTrade or manager.current(player.UserId)
		if terminalTrade and (t.state=="settled" or t.state=="aborted" or t.state=="cancelled" or t.state=="declined") then outcomes[player]=manager.view(t,player.UserId) end
		local value={enabled=enabled(),session=manager.view(t,player.UserId) or C.copy(outcomes[player]),peers={},inventory={},blocked=p and Trading.frozen(p) or false}
		if not p or not options.active(player) or Trading.frozen(p) then
			value.message="Обмен восстанавливается. Предметы временно недоступны."
		else
			if value.session then for _,side in ipairs(value.session.sides) do decorate(side.items,p) end end
			if enabled() and options.inBazaar(player) then
				for _,other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					if other~=player and options.active(other) and options.inBazaar(other) then
						if not tokens[other] then local token="peer:"..HttpService:GenerateGUID(false); tokens[other]=token; peers[token]=other end
						table.insert(value.peers,{token=tokens[other],name=other.DisplayName})
					end
				end
				for _,kind in ipairs({"pet","cauldron"}) do
					for id,item in pairs(kind=="pet" and p.pets or p.cauldrons) do
						local eligible,reason=model.item(p,kind,id)
						table.insert(value.inventory,{id=id,kind=kind,data=C.copy(item),available=eligible~=nil,reason=reason})
					end
				end
				decorate(value.inventory,p); table.sort(value.inventory,function(a,b) return a.id<b.id end)
			end
		end
		local encoded=C.encode(value)
		if lastSnapshots[player]~=encoded then lastSnapshots[player]=encoded; options.remote:FireClient(player,value) end
	end
	manager=TradeSession.new({config=config,model=model,enabled=enabled,now=os.time,identity=identity,
		name=function(uid) local p=playerFor(uid); return p and p.DisplayName or "Player" end,
		resolve=function(token) local p=peers[token]; return p and p.Parent==Players and options.active(p) and p.UserId or nil end,
		uuid=function() return HttpService:GenerateGUID(false) end,
		profile=function(uid) return store:get(uid) end,
		inBazaar=function(uid) local p=playerFor(uid); return p and options.inBazaar(p) or false end,
		writable=function(uid) local p=playerFor(uid); return p and store:isWritable(uid) and not options.valueBusy(p) end,
		leaseActive=function(uid) local p=playerFor(uid); return p and options.active(p) and store:hasLease(uid) and not options.closing() end,
		policy=function(uid,force) local p=playerFor(uid); return p and options.policy.get(p,force) or {} end,
		canStart=function() return budget(30) end,
		commit=coordinator.start,recover=function(id,cancel) return coordinator.recover(id,cancel and owner or nil) end,
		changed=function(t)
			for _,side in ipairs(t.sides) do
				local player=playerFor(side.userId)
				if player then
					service.send(player,t)
					if t.state=="settled" or t.state=="aborted" then
						if store:isWritable(player.UserId) then options.updated(player)
						elseif options.active(player) then player:Kick("Обмен обработан. Войдите снова, чтобы загрузить подтверждённый инвентарь.") end
					end
				end
			end
		end,
	})
	function service.busy(userId) return manager.busy(userId) end
	function service.activeTrade(userId) return manager.current(userId)~=nil end
	function service.handle(player,action,payload)
		if not enabled() then return false,"Торговля выключена до живой приёмки." end
		if not options.active(player) or options.closing() then return false,"Player session unavailable" end
		return manager.handle(player.UserId,action,payload)
	end
	function service.leave(player)
		manager.leave(player.UserId)
		outcomes[player],lastSnapshots[player]=nil,nil
		if tokens[player] then peers[tokens[player]]=nil; tokens[player]=nil end
	end
	function service.recoverPlayer(player)
		local p=store:get(player.UserId)
		if not p or not Trading.frozen(p) then return true end
		service.send(player)
		local ok,reason=coordinator.recover(p.trade.pending.id)
		local current=store:get(player.UserId)
		return ok and current~=nil and not Trading.frozen(current),reason
	end
	function service.sweep()
		manager.poll()
		if not budget(20) then return end
		for _=1,config.trading.scanPerPass do
			local id,entry=journal.nextKey(); if not id then break end
			local j,reason=journal.read(id)
			if j then
				if j.state=="COMPLETE" then journal.collect(id)
				elseif j.state~="PREPARING" or os.time()>=j.deadline then coordinator.recover(id) end
			elseif reason=="Journal missing" then journal.cleanMissing(id,entry) end
		end
	end
	return service
end
return Runtime
