	root.Name, root.Parent = "PotionTycoonWorld", workspace
	self.root = root
	self.environmentArtEnabled=environmentArtEnabled==true
	root:SetAttribute("EnvironmentArtEnabled",false)
	part(root, "ForestFloor", Vector3.new(420, 1, 250), Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), Color3.fromRGB(40, 51, 44))
	local bazaar = part(root, "Bazaar", Vector3.new(350, 0.3, 24), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(91, 87, 97))
	billboard(bazaar, "МАГИЧЕСКИЙ БАЗАР · M4\nПрямой обмен · закрытая QA-проверка", Vector3.new(0, 8, 0))
	self.tradePost=part(root,"TradePost",Vector3.new(5,2,5),Vector3.new(0,2,0),Color3.fromRGB(121,98,171))
	prompt(self.tradePost,"Trade / Обмен","Магический базар",function(player)
		if self:inBazaar(player) then callbacks.focus(player,"bazaar") end
	end)
	for index = 1, count do
		local column = (index - 1) % 4
		local row = math.floor((index - 1) / 4)
		local origin = Vector3.new((column - 1.5) * 95, 0, row == 0 and -65 or 85)
		local model = Instance.new("Model")
		model.Name = "Plot_" .. index
		model:SetAttribute("PlotIndex", index)
		model.Parent = root
		part(model, "Floor", Vector3.new(77, 1, 75), origin + Vector3.new(0, 0, -8), Color3.fromRGB(65, 70, 68))
		local sign = part(model, "Sign", Vector3.new(11, 1, 1), origin + Vector3.new(0, 7, 27), Color3.fromRGB(65, 70, 68))
		local ownerLabel = billboard(sign, "Свободный участок", Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
		local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
		spawn.Name, spawn.Size = "Spawn", Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
		spawn.Position, spawn.Anchored, spawn.Neutral = origin + Vector3.new(0, 1, 20), true, true
		spawn.Duration, spawn.Transparency, spawn.Parent = 0, 0.5, model
		local plot = { index = index, model = model, origin = origin, spawn = spawn,
			anchors = {}, labels = {}, pads = {}, padLabels = {}, architecture = {}, ownerLabel = ownerLabel }
		self.plots[index] = plot
		-- Replaceable non-colliding greybox modules; no economic state in geometry.
		for phase=2,4 do
			local color=phase==2 and Color3.fromRGB(115,92,69) or (phase==3 and Color3.fromRGB(128,133,141) or Color3.fromRGB(84,166,181))
			for _,x in ipairs({-36,36}) do
				local frame=part(model,"Phase"..phase.."Frame",Vector3.new(1,phase*3,58),origin+Vector3.new(x,phase*1.5,-10),color)
				frame.CanCollide,frame.CanTouch,frame.CanQuery,frame.Transparency=false,false,false,1
				frame.Material=phase==2 and Enum.Material.Wood or (phase==3 and Enum.Material.Concrete or Enum.Material.Neon)
				table.insert(plot.architecture,{phase=phase,part=frame})
			end
			local canopy=part(model,"Phase"..phase.."Canopy",Vector3.new(72,0.4,12),origin+Vector3.new(0,phase*3,-37),color)
			canopy.CanCollide,canopy.CanTouch,canopy.CanQuery,canopy.Transparency=false,false,false,1
			table.insert(plot.architecture,{phase=phase,part=canopy})
		end
		for id, offset in pairs(OFFSETS) do
			local station = config.stations[id]
			local title = station and station.name or (id == "warehouse" and "Склад" or (id == "altar" and "Алтарь · фамильяры" or (id == "blueprint" and "Развитие / Rebirth / Daily" or "Доска заказов")))
			local size = id == "crystal" and Vector3.new(4, 6, 4) or Vector3.new(8, 3, 7)
			local anchor = part(model, id, size, origin + offset, COLORS[id] or COLORS[station and station.archetype] or Color3.fromRGB(140,140,150))
			anchor:SetAttribute("StationId", id)
			if station then
				anchor:SetAttribute("InputWaypoint",origin+Vector3.new(table.unpack(station.waypoints.input)))
				anchor:SetAttribute("OutputWaypoint",origin+Vector3.new(table.unpack(station.waypoints.output)))
			end
			if id == "crystal" then
				anchor.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
				anchor.CFrame *= CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), math.rad(10))
			end
			plot.anchors[id] = anchor
			plot.labels[id] = billboard(anchor, title)
			prompt(anchor, id == "crystal" and "+1 эссенция" or "Управление", title, function(player)
				if plot.owner ~= player then return end
				if id == "crystal" then callbacks.action(player, "click", {})
				else callbacks.focus(player, id) end
			end)
			if station or id == "warehouse" or id == "blueprint" then
				local pad = part(model, "Buy_" .. id, Vector3.new(5, 0.25, 4), origin + offset + Vector3.new(0, -offset.Y + 0.8, 7), Color3.fromRGB(182, 157, 70))
				pad.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
				pad.CanCollide = false
				plot.pads[id], plot.padLabels[id] = pad, billboard(pad, "Улучшить", Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
				-- Body-part contacts can recur while a player stays on a pad.
				-- Spend Gold only after an explicit keyboard/gamepad/touch activation.
				local purchasePrompt = prompt(pad, "Купить улучшение", title, function(player)
					if plot.owner ~= player then return end
					local level, requestId = pad:GetAttribute("ExpectedLevel"), pad:GetAttribute("ExpectedRequestId")
					if level ~= nil and requestId then
						if id=="blueprint" then callbacks.action(player,"advancePhase",{expectedPhase=level,requestId=requestId})
						else callbacks.action(player,"build",{upgradeId=id,expectedLevel=level,requestId=requestId}) end
					end
				end)
				purchasePrompt.MaxActivationDistance = 8
				purchasePrompt.HoldDuration = 0.5
				purchasePrompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.F
			end
		end
	end
	if self.environmentArtEnabled then EnvironmentArt.attach(self) end
	return self
end

function World:claim(player)
	for _, plot in ipairs(self.plots) do
		if not plot.owner then
			plot.owner = player
			plot.model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", player.UserId)
			plot.ownerLabel.Text = player.DisplayName .. " · Лаборатория"
			self.owners[player.UserId] = plot
			player.RespawnLocation = plot.spawn
			player:SetAttribute("PotionPlotIndex", plot.index)
			return plot
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function World:release(player)
	local plot = self.owners[player.UserId]
	if not plot or plot.owner ~= player then return end
	plot.owner, self.owners[player.UserId] = nil, nil
	plot.model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", nil)
	plot.ownerLabel.Text = "Свободный участок"
	for _, anchor in pairs(plot.anchors) do
		anchor:SetAttribute("WorkerId", nil)
		anchor:SetAttribute("WorkerName", nil)
		anchor:SetAttribute("Working", false)
		anchor:SetAttribute("HaulFrom", nil)
		anchor:SetAttribute("HaulTo", nil)
		anchor:SetAttribute("HaulProgress", nil)
		anchor:SetAttribute("CargoAmount", nil)
		anchor:SetAttribute("CargoItem", nil)
		anchor:SetAttribute("QueuedCrates", nil)
	end
	for _, pad in pairs(plot.pads) do pad:SetAttribute("ExpectedLevel", nil); pad:SetAttribute("ExpectedRequestId",nil) end
	for _,module in ipairs(plot.architecture) do module.part.Transparency=1 end
end

function World:inBazaar(player)
	local character=player.Character
	local hrp=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hrp or not humanoid then return false end
	return math.abs(hrp.Position.Z)<=12 and Access.allowed(true,humanoid.Health>0,(hrp.Position-self.tradePost.Position).Magnitude,20)
end

function World:inRange(player, action, payload, maxDistance)
	local plot = self.owners[player.UserId]
	if not plot or plot.owner ~= player then return false end
	local character = player.Character
	local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hrp or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	local id = Access.target(action, payload)
	local anchor = plot.anchors[id]
	return anchor ~= nil and Access.allowed(plot.owner == player, humanoid.Health > 0, (hrp.Position - anchor.Position).Magnitude, maxDistance)
end

function World:update(player, profile)
	local plot = self.owners[player.UserId]
	if not plot or plot.owner ~= player then return end
	local phase=self.callbacks.phaseState(profile)
	local epoch=self.config.epochRules[profile.rebirths%3]; local color=Color3.fromRGB(table.unpack(epoch.color))
	plot.model.Floor.Color=color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(45,45,50),0.55)
	plot.model.Floor.Material=profile.entitlements.aurora_theme and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.Grass
	if profile.entitlements.aurora_theme then plot.model.Floor.Color=Color3.fromRGB(96,116,168) end
	local title=profile.entitlements.chrononaut and " · Хрононавт" or (profile.entitlements.chronicler and " · Летописец" or "")
	plot.ownerLabel.Text = player.DisplayName .. title.." · "..epoch.name.."\n"..phase.name.." · цикл "..profile.rebirths
	for _,module in ipairs(plot.architecture) do module.part.Transparency=module.phase==profile.phase and 0.35 or 1; module.part.Color=color end
	for _,pad in pairs(plot.pads) do pad:SetAttribute("ExpectedRequestId",profile.progression.sequence+1) end
	plot.pads.blueprint:SetAttribute("ExpectedLevel",profile.phase)
	plot.padLabels.blueprint.Text=phase.cost and ("Фаза "..(profile.phase+1)..": "..phase.cost.." Gold\n"..table.concat(phase.reasons,"; ")) or phase.message
	plot.labels.blueprint.Text=phase.name.."\n"..phase.message
	local production = self.callbacks.production(profile)
	for id, station in pairs(profile.stations) do
		local anchor = plot.anchors[id]
		if anchor then
			local definition = self.config.stations[id]
			anchor.Transparency = station.level > 0 and 0 or 0.78
			anchor:SetAttribute("Tier", station.level)
			anchor:SetAttribute("CauldronId", station.cauldronId)
			if definition.archetype=="cauldron" then
				anchor.Material=station.level>=3 and Enum.Material.Metal or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				anchor.Color=station.level>=3 and Color3.fromRGB(115,192,204) or (station.level==2 and Color3.fromRGB(178,119,75) or COLORS.cauldron)
				local item=station.cauldronId and profile.cauldrons[station.cauldronId]
				if item and item.type=="spectral" then anchor.Color=Color3.fromRGB(119,225,237); anchor.Material=Enum.Material.Neon end
				local glow=anchor:FindFirstChild("SpectralGlow")
				if not glow then glow=Instance.new("PointLight"); glow.Name="SpectralGlow"; glow.Color=Color3.fromRGB(119,225,237); glow.Range=8; glow.Brightness=1.2; glow.Parent=anchor end
				glow.Enabled=item~=nil and item.type=="spectral" and station.job~=nil
			end
			anchor:SetAttribute("WorkerId", station.workerId)
			local pet = station.workerId and profile.pets[station.workerId]
			anchor:SetAttribute("WorkerName", pet and pet.name)
			anchor:SetAttribute("WorkerSpecies", pet and pet.species)
			anchor:SetAttribute("WorkerRarity", pet and pet.rarity)
			local state = production[id]
			anchor:SetAttribute("Working", state.code == "working")
			anchor:SetAttribute("ProductionStatus", state.code)
			anchor:SetAttribute("Essence", station.essence)
			anchor:SetAttribute("QueuedCrates", state.queued)
			if id == "logistics" then
				local job = station.job
				if job and job.kind == "haul" then
					local from = job.sourceKind == "inventory" and plot.anchors.warehouse or plot.anchors[job.sourceStationId]
					local target = job.destinationKind == "questStock" and plot.anchors.orders
						or (job.destinationKind == "inventory" and plot.anchors.warehouse or plot.anchors[job.destinationStationId])
					anchor:SetAttribute("CargoAmount", job.amount)
					anchor:SetAttribute("CargoItem", job.itemId)
					anchor:SetAttribute("HaulFrom", from and (from:GetAttribute("OutputWaypoint") or from.Position))
					anchor:SetAttribute("HaulTo", target and (target:GetAttribute("InputWaypoint") or target.Position))
					anchor:SetAttribute("HaulProgress", math.clamp(station.progress / job.duration, 0, 1))
				else
					anchor:SetAttribute("HaulFrom", nil)
					anchor:SetAttribute("HaulTo", nil)
					anchor:SetAttribute("HaulProgress", nil)
					anchor:SetAttribute("CargoAmount", nil)
					anchor:SetAttribute("CargoItem", nil)
				end
			end
			local name=definition.outputItem and epoch.resourceNames[definition.outputItem] or definition.name
			plot.labels[id].Text = name .. " · ур. " .. station.level .. "\n" .. state.text
			plot.pads[id]:SetAttribute("ExpectedLevel", station.level)
			local build=self.callbacks.buildState(profile,id)
			plot.padLabels[id].Text = build.cost and ("Купить: " .. build.cost .. " Gold\n" .. build.reason) or "Максимальный уровень"
		end
	end
	local warehouseCost = self.callbacks.buildState(profile,"warehouse").cost
	plot.pads.warehouse:SetAttribute("ExpectedLevel", profile.warehouseLevel)
	plot.padLabels.warehouse.Text = warehouseCost and ("Склад: " .. warehouseCost .. " Gold") or "Склад MAX"
	local order = self.callbacks.orderProgress(profile)
	plot.labels.orders.Text = profile.order and ("Заказ NPC: " .. order.delivered .. "/" .. profile.order.count
		.. "\nУ котла: " .. order.queued .. " · В пути: " .. order.travelling .. " · " .. order.remainingSeconds .. " сек.") or "Доска заказов · выбери контракт"
	if self.environmentArtEnabled then EnvironmentArt.update(plot,profile.rebirths,profile.entitlements.aurora_theme==true) end
end

return World

--!strict
-- Pure authorization checks used by World with server-owned identity/positions.
local Access = {}

function Access.target(action: string, payload: any): string?
	if action=="buyEventGold" or action=="deliverPurchases" or action=="requestPurchase" or action=="refreshPurchases" then return "altar" end
	if action=="rebirth" or action=="buyRebirthPerk" or action=="chooseRebirthPet" or action=="claimDaily" or action=="claimCalendar" or action=="deliverCalendarPet" then return "blueprint" end
	if action == "advancePhase" then return "blueprint" end
	if action == "equipCauldron" then return payload.slotId end
	if action == "lockCauldron" then return "altar" end
	if action == "prioritize" then return payload.stationId end
	if action == "summon" or action == "shopFamiliar" or action == "petLock" or action == "previewFuse" or action == "fuse" or action == "refreshPolicy" then return "altar" end
	if action == "click" then return "crystal" end
	if action == "buy" or action == "build" then return payload.upgradeId == "pipes" and "warehouse" or payload.upgradeId end
	if action == "hire" or action == "discard" then return "warehouse" end
	if action == "acceptOrder" or action == "claimOrder" then return "orders" end
	if action == "assign" or action == "harvest" or action == "collect" or action == "load"
		or action == "brew" or action == "setRecipe" or action == "setAuto" then return payload.stationId end
	return nil
end

function Access.allowed(ownerMatches: boolean, alive: boolean, distance: number, maximum: number): boolean
	return ownerMatches == true and alive == true and distance == distance and distance >= 0
		and maximum == maximum and maximum > 0 and maximum < math.huge and distance <= maximum
end

return Access
src/shared/Collection.luau:
--!nonstrict
-- Pure commands on a transaction candidate. Runtime MUST commit before acknowledgement.
local runtimeScript = rawget(getfenv(), "script")
local Familiars = require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.Familiars or "./Familiars")
local Protocol = require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.Protocol or "./Protocol")
local Policy = require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.Policy or "./Policy")
local Collection = {}
local actions = { summon = true, shopFamiliar = true, hire = true, fuse = true, petLock = true }
local function copy(v)
	if type(v) ~= "table" then return v end
	local result = {}; for k, child in pairs(v) do result[k] = copy(child) end; return result
end
local function fingerprint(action, payload)
	local parts = { action }
	local fields = {}; for key in pairs(payload) do table.insert(fields, key) end; table.sort(fields)
	for _, key in ipairs(fields) do
		local value = payload[key]
		if type(value) == "table" then value = copy(value); table.sort(value); value = table.concat(value, ",") end
		table.insert(parts, key .. "=" .. tostring(value))
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "|")
end
local function count(map) local n = 0; for _ in pairs(map) do n += 1 end; return n end
local function samePreview(a, b)
	if not a or not b or a.species ~= b.species or a.paidDerived ~= b.paidDerived or a.tradeKnown~=b.tradeKnown then return false end
	for index, id in ipairs(a.parentIds) do if b.parentIds[index] ~= id then return false end end
	for skill, value in pairs(a.stats) do if b.stats[skill] ~= value then return false end end
	return true
end

function Collection.isAction(action) return actions[action] == true end
function Collection.new(config)
	local model = Familiars.new(config)
	local service = { preview = model.preview, details = model.details }
	function service.apply(p, action, payload, context)
		if p.trade and p.trade.pending then return false,"Trade recovery pending" end
		local valid, reason = Protocol.validate(action, payload)
		if not actions[action] or not valid then return false, reason or "Unknown collection action" end
		local key = fingerprint(action, payload)
		local progress = p.collection
		if payload.requestId == progress.sequence and progress.last then
			if progress.last.fingerprint ~= key then return false, "Request ID already used for another intent" end
			return true, copy(progress.last.result), true
		end
		if payload.requestId ~= progress.sequence + 1 or progress.sequence >= config.maxBalance then return false, "Stale collection request; refresh inventory" end
		if progress.last and context.now - progress.last.at < config.collection.cooldownSeconds then return false, "Collection action is on cooldown" end
		local pending, consumed, currency, cost = {}, {}, nil, 0
		local message = "Collection updated"
		local function create(species, stats, source, paid, parents, tradeKnown)
			local serial = p.nextPetSerial + #pending
			if serial >= config.maxCount then return false end
			local id = string.format("%.0f", p.userId) .. ":pet:" .. serial
			if p.pets[id] then return false end
			table.insert(pending, model.create(id, species, stats, source, paid, parents, tradeKnown))
			return true
		end
		if action == "summon" then
			if not Policy.allowed(context.policy, context.now) then return false, "Random summon unavailable; use the guaranteed shop" end
			local pool = config.summonPools[payload.poolId]
			if not pool or not table.find(pool.counts, payload.count) then return false, "Unknown summon pool or count" end
			currency, cost = "essence", pool.essenceCost * payload.count
			if count(p.pets) + payload.count > config.maxPets then return false, "Familiar inventory is full" end
			if p.essence < cost then return false, "Not enough Essence" end
			if p.nextPetSerial + payload.count > config.maxCount then return false, "Familiar identity limit" end
			for _ = 1, payload.count do
				local species = model.pick(payload.poolId, context.nextInteger(1, pool.totalWeight))
				local stats = model.rollStats(species, context.nextInteger)
				if not create(species, stats, "gacha", p.currencyPaid.essence) then return false, "Familiar identity conflict" end
			end
			message = "Summoned " .. payload.count .. " familiar(s)"
		elseif action == "shopFamiliar" or action == "hire" then
			local offer = config.familiarShop[action == "hire" and payload.speciesId or payload.offerId]
			if not offer or (action == "hire" and not config.hires[payload.speciesId]) then return false, "Unknown fixed offer" end
			if count(p.pets) >= config.maxPets then return false, "Familiar inventory is full" end
			currency, cost = offer.currency, offer.cost
			if p[currency] < cost then return false, "Not enough " .. currency end
			if not create(offer.species, offer.stats, action == "hire" and "hire" or "shop", p.currencyPaid[currency]) then return false, "Familiar identity conflict" end
			message = "Purchased fixed " .. config.petSpecies[offer.species].name
		elseif action == "fuse" then
			local preview, err = model.preview(p, payload.petIds)
			if not preview then return false, err end
			if not context.preview or context.preview.token ~= payload.previewToken or context.preview.expiresAt <= context.now
				or not samePreview(preview, context.preview) then return false, "Preview changed; review the five inputs again" end
			consumed = preview.parentIds
			if not create(preview.species, preview.stats, "fuse", preview.paidDerived, consumed, preview.tradeKnown) then return false, "Familiar identity conflict" end
			message = "Evolved into " .. preview.name
		elseif action == "petLock" then
			if not p.pets[payload.petId] then return false, "Unknown familiar" end
			message = payload.locked and "Familiar locked" or "Familiar unlocked"
		end
		-- Commit the complete, prevalidated candidate in one non-yielding section.
		if currency then p[currency] -= cost end
		for _, id in ipairs(consumed) do p.pets[id], p.slimeWorkSeconds[id] = nil, nil end
		local result = { createdIds = {}, consumedIds = copy(consumed), message = message }
		for _, pet in ipairs(pending) do p.pets[pet.id] = pet; table.insert(result.createdIds, pet.id) end
		p.nextPetSerial += #pending
		if action == "petLock" then p.pets[payload.petId].locked = payload.locked end
		p.collection = { sequence = payload.requestId, last = { requestId = payload.requestId, action = action, fingerprint = key, at = context.now, result = copy(result) } }
		return true, result, false
	end
	return service
end
return Collection

--!nonstrict
-- Pure presentation decisions. Server Access/World remain authoritative.
local UI={}
function UI.candidates(entries,userId,width,height,blocked)
	local result={}
	for _,e in ipairs(entries) do
		local overlaps=false
		for _,r in ipairs(blocked or {}) do
			if e.x+120>r.x and e.x-120<r.x+r.w and e.y+50>r.y and e.y-50<r.y+r.h then overlaps=true; break end
		end
		if e.enabled and e.visible and e.clear and (e.public or e.owner==userId)
			and not overlaps
			and e.distance>=0 and e.distance<=e.maximum and e.z>0
			and e.x>=80 and e.x<=width-80 and e.y>=80 and e.y<=height-100 then
			table.insert(result,e)
		end
	end
	table.sort(result,function(a,b)
		local sa=a.distance+(a.aim or 0)*4
		local sb=b.distance+(b.aim or 0)*4
		if math.abs(sa-sb)<.001 then return a.id<b.id end
		return sa<sb
	end)
	return result
end
function UI.choose(candidates,previous,cycle)
	if #candidates==0 then return nil end
	for i,e in ipairs(candidates) do
		if e.id==previous then
			if cycle then return candidates[i%#candidates+1] end
			-- Hysteresis avoids oscillating between two adjacent stations.
			if e.distance<=candidates[1].distance+2 then return e end
		end
	end
	return candidates[1]
end
function UI.layout(width,height,touch,chatRight)
	local compact=touch or width<900
	local portrait=height>width
	local panelWidth=compact and (portrait and width-24 or math.min(400,width*.51)) or math.min(420,width-32)
	local panelHeight=compact and (portrait and math.min(height*.52,height-270,510) or height-132) or math.min(height-132,660)
	local left=chatRight and math.max(12,chatRight+12) or 12
	local chatModal=chatRight~=nil and (compact or left+panelWidth>width-12)
	return {compact=compact,portrait=portrait,left=left,chatModal=chatModal,width=math.max(240,panelWidth),height=math.max(180,panelHeight),
		factory={x=(width-104)/2,y=height-124,w=104,h=44},
		hudWidth=math.min(width-24,360),railWidth=math.min(width-24,300),bottom=touch and portrait and 150 or 20}
end
function UI.description(entry,config)
	if not entry then return "" end
	if entry.public then return "Магический базар" end
	local id=entry.station
	return (config.stations[id] and config.stations[id].name) or ({warehouse="Склад",orders="Заказы",altar="Фамильяры",blueprint="Развитие"})[id] or "Фабрика"
end
function UI.upgradeDetails(state,id)
	local phase=id=="blueprint"
	local offer=phase and state.phase or state.builds[id]
	local cost=offer and offer.cost
	local reason=phase and table.concat(state.phase.reasons,"; ") or (offer and offer.reason or "")
	local balance="У вас: "..math.floor(state.gold).." Gold"
	if not cost then return "Максимальный уровень\n"..balance,nil end
	local missing=math.max(0,cost-state.gold)
	return balance.."\n"..(missing>0 and ("Не хватает "..math.ceil(missing).." Gold") or "Gold достаточно")..(reason~="" and ("\n"..reason) or ""),cost
end
return UI

--!nonstrict
-- UTC days and real server events only; neither method awards a claim reward.
local Dailies={}
function Dailies.day(now) return math.floor(now/86400) end
function Dailies.empty() return {day=-1,progress={essence=0,brew=0,orders=0},claimed={}} end
function Dailies.sync(p,now)
	local day=Dailies.day(now); local d=p.longTerm.daily
	if day<d.day then return false,"Server day moved backwards" end
	if day>d.day then d=Dailies.empty(); d.day=day; p.longTerm.daily=d end
	return true,d
end
function Dailies.record(config,p,event,amount,now)
	if not p.longTerm or not config.longTerm.daily[event] then return end
	local ok,d=Dailies.sync(p,now); if not ok then return end
	local target=config.longTerm.daily[event].targets[d.day%3+1]
	d.progress[event]=math.min(target,d.progress[event]+amount)
end
return Dailies

--!nonstrict
-- Screen-space presentation only. Prompts and interactive objects are never hidden.
local Labels={}
function Labels.select(entries,width,height)
	local candidates={}
	for _,e in ipairs(entries) do
		if e.enabled and e.z>0 and e.distance<=115 and e.x>=0 and e.x<=width and e.y>=0 and e.y<=height then
			table.insert(candidates,e)
		end
	end
	table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
		if a.distance==b.distance then return a.id<b.id end
		return a.distance<b.distance
	end)
	local chosen,rects={},{}
	local cap=width<700 and 3 or 6
	for _,e in ipairs(candidates) do
		local r={x1=e.x-e.w/2-8,x2=e.x+e.w/2+8,y1=e.y-e.h/2-8,y2=e.y+e.h/2+8}
		local overlaps=false
		for _,a in ipairs(rects) do
			if r.x1<a.x2 and r.x2>a.x1 and r.y1<a.y2 and r.y2>a.y1 then overlaps=true; break end
		end
		if not overlaps then chosen[e.id]=true; table.insert(rects,r); if #rects>=cap then break end end
	end
	return chosen
end
return Labels

--!nonstrict

local runtimeScript=rawget(getfenv(),"script")

local FactoryConfig=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.Config or "./Config")
local Plan={catalog={CommonTree_1={1866,2},CommonTree_3={1866,2},CommonTree_5={1866,2},Pine_2={1486,2},TwistedTree_1={1866,2},
	Bush_Common_Flowers={423,2},Clover_2={427,1},Fern_1={288,1},Flower_3_Group={422,2},Grass_Common_Short={155,1},
	Grass_Wispy_Tall={428,1},Pebble_Round_1={136,1},RockPath_Round_Small_1={428,1},Rock_Medium_1={342,1}}}
function Plan.origin(index) return {((index-1)%4-1.5)*95,0,index<=4 and -65 or 85} end
function Plan.build(config,index)
	assert(index==config.pilotPlot,"Gate B requires owner visual approval")
	local o=Plan.origin(index); local parts={}
	local pads={{0,17},{-8,-23}} -- Blueprint and warehouse; other pads use station offsets.
	for _,station in pairs(FactoryConfig.stations) do if station.offset then
		table.insert(pads,{station.offset[1],station.offset[3]+7})
	end end
	local function add(kind,size,pos,color,detail,rotation,extra,world)
		local d={id="Decor_"..(#parts+1),kind=kind,size=size,position=world and pos or {o[1]+pos[1],pos[2],o[3]+pos[3]},color=color,
			detail=detail or 1,rotation=rotation or {0,0,0},material="Wood"}
		for k,v in pairs(extra or {}) do d[k]=v end; table.insert(parts,d); return d
	end
	local function mesh(name,x,z,scale,angle,detail,y)
		assert(Plan.catalog[name],"Unreviewed template")
		if name=="RockPath_Round_Small_1" then
			-- Imported footprint (1.128 x 1.571 studs) plus original 5 x 4 pads.
			local a=math.rad(angle or 0)
			local rx=scale*(1.128*math.abs(math.cos(a))+1.571*math.abs(math.sin(a)))/2
			local rz=scale*(1.128*math.abs(math.sin(a))+1.571*math.abs(math.cos(a)))/2
			for _,pad in ipairs(pads) do
				if math.abs(x-pad[1])<rx+2.7 and math.abs(z-pad[2])<rz+2.2 then return end
			end
		end
		return add("mesh",{scale,scale,scale},{x,y or Terrain.height(o[1]+x,o[3]+z)-.08,z},"cream",detail,{0,angle or 0,0},{template=name,scale=scale,flatten=name=="RockPath_Round_Small_1" and .3 or 1})
	end
	-- Layered groups frame the clearing; every station and the entrance stay open.
	for _,t in ipairs({
		{"CommonTree_1",-49,-25,1.06,25},{"CommonTree_3",-57,-47,.95,105},{"CommonTree_5",-43,-57,1.12,220},
		{"CommonTree_1",-24,-64,1.20,140},{"Pine_2",-45,-83,.94,35},{"Pine_2",-10,-91,1.18,75},
		{"CommonTree_3",3,-70,1.15,215},{"CommonTree_5",24,-64,1.2,310},{"CommonTree_1",43,-54,1.02,280},
		{"Pine_2",36,-86,1.16,115},{"TwistedTree_1",-66,-7,.92,55},{"CommonTree_5",-47,16,.90,80},

	}) do mesh(t[1],t[2],t[3],t[4],t[5],1) end
	-- Thin stone ribbons follow the unchanged floor and never act as colliders.
	for i=0,10 do mesh("RockPath_Round_Small_1",math.sin(i*.65)*1.1,28-i*5.3,5,i*23,1,.515) end
	for i=0,4 do mesh("RockPath_Round_Small_1",0,33+i*4.4,5,15+i*19,1,.49) end
	for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do for i=1,5 do mesh("RockPath_Round_Small_1",side*i*5,-7-math.sin(i)*.8,4.4,i*27,1,.515) end end
	for i=0,5 do mesh("RockPath_Round_Small_1",-7+i*5,-30,4.2,i*21,1,.515) end
	for i,p in ipairs({{-44,-36},{-56,-13},{-42,24},{-29,-53},{17,-58},{43,-43},{44,19},{-69,-48},{29,-72}}) do
		mesh("Rock_Medium_1",p[1],p[2],.8+(i%3)*.23,i*47,2)
		mesh("Pebble_Round_1",p[1]+2,p[2]+2,1.1,i*31,2)
	end
	-- Grass/flowers remain outside the working floor, including future purchase pads.
	for i=1,208 do
		local x,z
		if i<=144 then local side=i%2==0 and -1 or 1; x=side*(40+(i*11%17)*.65); z=-46+(i*17%76)
		else x=-55+(i*19%99); z=-51-(i*7%22) end
		local detail=i%8==0 and 1 or (i%3==0 and 2 or 3)
		mesh(i%4==0 and "Grass_Wispy_Tall" or "Grass_Common_Short",x,z,1.8+(i%5)*.2,i*137.5,detail)
		if i%5==0 then mesh(i%10==0 and "Fern_1" or "Clover_2",x+1.4,z-1,1,i*57,2) end
		if i%7==0 then mesh("Flower_3_Group",x-1,z+1,1,i*39,3) end
	end
	for i,p in ipairs({{-40,18},{-42,-17},{-32,-50},{12,-53},{41,-34},{41,22},{-62,-37}}) do mesh("Bush_Common_Flowers",p[1],p[2],.85+(i%3)*.12,i*70,2) end
	local function lantern(x,z,world)
		add("beam",{.45,6,.45},{x,3,z},"wood",1,nil,nil,world)
		add("beam",{1.9,.3,.4},{x+.7,6,z},"wood",1,nil,nil,world)
		add("block",{.9,1.3,.9},{x+1.3,5.1,z},"amber",1,nil,{material="Neon",light=true},world)
		add("block",{1.35,.25,1.35},{x+1.3,5.9,z},"bark",1,nil,nil,world)
	end
	lantern(-7,29); lantern(7,29); lantern(-34,-30); lantern(33,-30)
	for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do for i=0,2 do
		add("beam",{.5,3,.5},{side*(13+i*7),1.7,28},"wood",1,nil,{barrier=true})
		if i<2 then add("beam",{7,.35,.35},{side*(16.5+i*7),2.5,28},"wood",1,{0,0,side*3},{barrier=true}) end
	end end
	-- Adjacent Bazaar sample; original road and trade post are unchanged.
	for _,x in ipairs({-12,12}) do
		lantern(x,-15,true)
		for _,z in ipairs({-18,-23}) do add("beam",{.55,7,.55},{x,3.5,z},"wood",1,nil,nil,true) end
		add("block",{11,.25,7},{x,7,-20.5},"cream",1,{0,0,x<0 and 5 or -5},nil,true)
		add("beam",{9,2,3},{x,1,-22},"wood",1,nil,nil,true)
	end
	local metrics={parts=0,triangles=0,lights=0,motion=0,palette=0,externalTextures=12,textureMiB=27.96,serverParticles=0,decoratedPlots=1}
	local colors={}
	for _,d in ipairs(parts) do
		local entry=d.template and Plan.catalog[d.template]
		metrics.parts+=entry and entry[2] or 1; metrics.triangles+=entry and entry[1] or 12
		colors[d.color]=true; if d.light then metrics.lights+=1 end
	end
	for _ in pairs(colors) do metrics.palette+=1 end
	return {version=config.version,pilot=index,parts=parts,metrics=metrics}
end

src/shared/EnvironmentState.luau:
--!nonstrict
local State={}
local function smooth(x) x=math.clamp(x,0,1); return x*x*(3-2*x) end
local function lerp(a:any,b:any,t:number):any
	if type(a)=="table" then return {a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*t,a[2]+(b[2]-a[2])*t,a[3]+(b[3]-a[3])*t} end
	return a+(b-a)*t
end
-- Independent weather envelope. Each overlay has zero slope at stage boundaries.
-- Stages: clear, buildup, rain, clearing, after-rain, clear. Labels are diagnostic
-- only; the renderer consumes continuous channels, never switches on a stage.
function State.weather(config,time)
	local w=config.weather; local t=time%config.weatherSeconds
	local buildup=w.buildup or 0; local clearing=w.clearing or 0; local after=w.afterRain or 0
	local endRain=w.finish+w.fall; local endClear=endRain+clearing
	local rain=smooth((t-w.start)/w.rise)*(1-smooth((t-w.finish)/w.fall))
	local cloud=(buildup>0 and smooth((t-w.start+buildup)/buildup) or rain)
		*(clearing>0 and (1-smooth((t-endRain)/clearing)) or (1-smooth((t-w.finish)/w.fall)))
	local wet=smooth((t-w.start)/w.rise)*(1-smooth((t-endRain)/math.max(1,clearing+after)))
	local afterRain=clearing>0 and smooth((t-endRain)/clearing)*(1-smooth((t-endClear)/math.max(1,after))) or 0
	return {rain=rain,cloud=cloud,wet=wet,afterRain=afterRain}
end
function State.weatherStage(config,time)
	local w=config.weather; local t=time%config.weatherSeconds
	if t<w.start-(w.buildup or 0) then return "clear" end
	if t<w.start then return "buildup" end
	if t<w.finish+w.fall then return "rain" end
	if t<w.finish+w.fall+(w.clearing or 0) then return "clearing" end
	if t<w.finish+w.fall+(w.clearing or 0)+(w.afterRain or 0) then return "after-rain" end
	return "clear"
end
function State.at(config:any,phase:number,rain:number,weather:any?):any
	assert(phase==phase and rain==rain and phase>=0 and phase<1 and rain>=0 and rain<=1,"Invalid environment sample")
	local a,b=config.keys[1],config.keys[2]
	for i=1,#config.keys-1 do if phase>=config.keys[i].phase and phase<config.keys[i+1].phase then a,b=config.keys[i],config.keys[i+1]; break end end
	local t=smooth((phase-a.phase)/(b.phase-a.phase)); local r:any={phase=phase,rain=rain}
	for key,value in pairs(a) do if key~="phase" then r[key]=lerp(value,b[key],t) end end
	local w=weather or {cloud=rain,wet=rain,afterRain=0}
	r.cloud=w.cloud or rain; r.wet=w.wet or rain; r.afterRain=w.afterRain or 0
	r.clock%=24; r.brightness*=1-.16*r.cloud-.16*rain; r.density+=.045*rain-.025*r.afterRain; r.haze+=.45*rain-.25*r.afterRain
	r.cover=.12+.72*r.cloud; r.cloudDensity=.22+.5*r.cloud
	r.tint=lerp(r.tint,{218,235,246},r.cloud*.32); r.sky=lerp(r.sky,{163,186,204},r.cloud*.6)
	r.sun=lerp(r.sun,{182,199,215},r.cloud*.82); r.cloudColor=lerp({240,237,229},{145,167,189},r.cloud)
	r.fog=math.max(r.dawn,rain*.22); r.glint=math.max(r.dawn*.7,r.wet*(1-rain))*(1-r.night)
	r.celestial=smooth((r.night-.22)/.55)*(1-smooth(r.cloud/.85))
	r.wetStone=r.wet*(1-rain*.2)
	r.wind=.25+.5*r.cloud+.25*rain
	-- Eligibility only: renderer also checks actual sun elevation/view direction.
	r.rainbow=r.afterRain*(1-r.night)*(1-r.cloud)
	return r
end
-- Art-directed celestial path, deliberately lower than the engine's zenith moon.
-- World-oriented, never locked to camera rotation. Smooth/periodic at the cycle seam.
function State.moon(phase)
	local az=math.rad(15+12*math.sin(phase*math.pi*2)); local el=math.rad(20+3*math.cos(phase*math.pi*2))
	return {math.sin(az)*math.cos(el),math.sin(el),-math.cos(az)*math.cos(el)}
end
function State.star(index)
	local az=index<=16 and (-60+(index*37%120)) or (index*137.507764%360)
	local el=12+(index*23%59)
	local a,e=math.rad(az),math.rad(el)
	return {x=math.sin(a)*math.cos(e),y=math.sin(e),z=-math.cos(a)*math.cos(e),size=1.5+(index%4)*.6,alpha=.6+(index%3)*.15}
end
function State.sample(config:any,serverSeconds:number,pose:string?):any
	assert(type(serverSeconds)=="number" and serverSeconds==serverSeconds and math.abs(serverSeconds)<1e13,"Invalid environment clock")
	local preview=pose and config.poses[pose]
	local phase=preview and preview.phase or (serverSeconds%config.cycleSeconds)/config.cycleSeconds
	local w=preview and {rain=preview.rain,cloud=preview.cloud or preview.rain,wet=preview.wet or preview.rain,afterRain=preview.afterRain or 0} or State.weather(config,serverSeconds)
	return State.at(config,phase,w.rain,w)
end
function State.preview(config,elapsed)
	assert(elapsed==elapsed and math.abs(elapsed)<1e13,"Invalid preview time")
	local phase=(elapsed%config.previewSeconds)/config.previewSeconds
	local rain=smooth((phase-.72)/.06)*(1-smooth((phase-.87)/.04))
	local cloud=smooth((phase-.65)/.07)*(1-smooth((phase-.89)/.06))
	local wet=smooth((phase-.72)/.06)*(1-smooth((phase-.96)/.04))
	local afterRain=smooth((phase-.91)/.04)*(1-smooth((phase-.97)/.03))
	return State.at(config,phase,rain,{cloud=cloud,wet=wet,afterRain=afterRain})
end
function State.quality(config,name,reduceMotion)
	local q=config.quality[name] or config.quality.reduced; local result={}
	for k,v in pairs(q) do result[k]=v end
	if reduceMotion then result.motion=0; result.rain=0; result.motes=0 end
	return result
end
-- Bounded deterministic local motes, never rewards or simulation inputs.
function State.mote(index,time,night,rain)
	local firefly=index%3~=0
	local x=-142.5+(index%2==0 and -1 or 1)*(30+(index*7%13))
	local z=-65-43+(index*19%66)
	return {x=x+math.sin(time*.27+index)*1.2,y=2.7+(index%5)*.7+math.sin(time*.38+index)*.5,
		z=z+math.cos(time*.23+index)*1.1,firefly=firefly,
		alpha=(firefly and night*.65 or (1-night)*.24)*(1-rain*.9)*(.85+.15*math.sin(time*.55+index))}
end
function State.surface(config,rebirths,aurora)
	if aurora then return {color={96,116,168},material="Neon"} end -- Existing M6 entitlement semantics.
	local colors={config.palette.grass,{148,153,108},{113,146,131}}
	return {color=colors[rebirths%3+1],material="Grass"}
end
return State

--!nonstrict
-- Presentation height field for the first farm only. No ownership/economy state.
local Terrain={bounds={min={-244,-24,-184},max={-88,36,-16}},resolution=4}
local function smooth(v) v=math.clamp(v,0,1); return v*v*(3-2*v) end
function Terrain.reserved(x,z)
	local u,v=x+142.5,z+65
	return (math.abs(u)<=42.5 and v>=-49.5 and v<=33.5) or (math.abs(u)<=7 and v>=29 and v<=53)
end
function Terrain.height(x,z)
	local u,v=x+142.5,z+65
	-- A flat clearing extends beyond every original station/pad and the entrance.
	local dx=math.max(math.abs(u)-40,0)
	local dz=math.max(-47-v,v-53,0)
	local edge=smooth(math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)/17)
	local hills=0
	for _,h in ipairs({{-57,-62,10,31},{-16,-78,15,38},{39,-77,11,30},{-66,-9,7,25}}) do
		hills+=h[3]*math.exp(-((u-h[1])^2+(v-h[2])^2)/(h[4]^2))
	end
	local shore=smooth((math.sqrt(((u+6)/101)^2+((v+14)/105)^2)-.78)/.22)
	return .45+edge*(hills+.45*math.sin(u*.11)*math.cos(v*.09))-shore*21
end
function Terrain.contains(x,z)
	return x>=Terrain.bounds.min[1] and x<Terrain.bounds.max[1] and z>=Terrain.bounds.min[3] and z<Terrain.bounds.max[3]
end
return Terrain

	return (a+delta*t)%period

	if progress<=0 then return a end
	if progress>=1 then return b end
	local t=math.clamp(progress,0,1); t=t*t*(3-2*t)
	local result={}
	for key,value in pairs(b) do
		if type(value)=="table" then
			result[key]={}
			for i,v in ipairs(value) do result[key][i]=a[key][i]+(v-a[key][i])*t end
		elseif key=="clock" or key=="phase" then
			result[key]=wrap(a[key],value,t,key=="clock" and 24 or 1)
		else result[key]=a[key]+(value-a[key])*t end
	end
	return result
end
function Transition.new()
	local self={last=nil,from=nil,started=0}
	function self.begin(now)
		self.from=self.last; self.started=now
	end
	function self.sample(target,now)
		local elapsed=now-self.started
		self.last=self.from and Transition.blend(self.from,target,elapsed/Transition.seconds) or target
		if elapsed>=Transition.seconds then self.from=nil end
		return self.last
	end
	return self
end
return Transition
