--!nonstrict
-- Pure candidate commands. The runtime persists the candidate before presenting success.
local runtimeScript=rawget(getfenv(),"script")
local Protocol=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.Protocol or "./Protocol")
local C=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.TradeCodec or "./TradeCodec")
local Epochs=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.Epochs or "./Epochs")
local Dailies=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.Dailies or "./Dailies")
local Familiars=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.Familiars or "./Familiars")
local LongTerm={}
local actions={rebirth=true,buyRebirthPerk=true,chooseRebirthPet=true,claimDaily=true,claimCalendar=true,deliverCalendarPet=true}
local function plain(v) return type(v)=="table" and getmetatable(v)==nil end
local function integer(v,lo,hi) return type(v)=="number" and v==v and v%1==0 and v>=lo and v<=hi end
local function count(t) local n=0; for _ in pairs(t) do n+=1 end; return n end
function LongTerm.isAction(action) return actions[action]==true end
function LongTerm.new(config)
	local service={}; local familiars=Familiars.new(config); local rules=config.longTerm
	function service.initial(p)
		return {sequence=0,shards=0,earned=0,spent=0,shardsPaid=false,perks={industry=0,essence=0,title=0},
			cycle={id=p.rebirths,finalProduced=false},milestoneClaimed=p.phase>=3 or p.nextCauldronSerial>1,
			daily=Dailies.empty(),calendar={lastDay=-1,step=0,series=0,uniqueAwarded=false,pendingPet=false,delivered=false}}
	end
	function service.validate(p)
		local t=p.longTerm
		if not plain(t) or not integer(t.sequence,0,config.maxBalance) or not integer(t.shards,0,config.maxBalance)
			or not integer(t.earned,0,p.rebirths) or not integer(t.spent,0,t.earned) or t.shards+t.spent~=t.earned
			or type(t.shardsPaid)~="boolean" or not plain(t.perks) or count(t.perks)~=#rules.perkOrder
			or not plain(t.cycle) or t.cycle.id~=p.rebirths or type(t.cycle.finalProduced)~="boolean"
			or type(t.milestoneClaimed)~="boolean" then return false end
		if t.cycle.finalProduced and (p.phase~=4 or not p.discoveredRecipes[Epochs.rules(config,p).finalRecipe]) then return false end
		local perkSpend=0
		for key,def in pairs(rules.perks) do
			if not integer(t.perks[key],0,def.max) then return false end
			perkSpend+=t.perks[key]*def.cost
		end
		if perkSpend>t.spent or (t.perks.title>0 and p.entitlements.chrononaut~=true) then return false end
		local last=t.last
		if t.sequence==0 then if last~=nil then return false end
		elseif not plain(last) or last.requestId~=t.sequence or not actions[last.action]
			or type(last.fingerprint)~="string" or #last.fingerprint>1024 or #last.fingerprint<1
			or not plain(last.result) or type(last.result.message)~="string" or #last.result.message>256 then return false end
		local d,cal=t.daily,t.calendar; local maxDay=math.floor(config.maxTimestamp/86400)
		if not plain(d) or not integer(d.day,-1,maxDay) or not plain(d.progress) or count(d.progress)~=3 or not plain(d.claimed) then return false end
		for key,def in pairs(rules.daily) do
			if not integer(d.progress[key],0,d.day<0 and 0 or def.targets[d.day%3+1]) then return false end
		end
		for key,value in pairs(d.claimed) do
			if not rules.daily[key] or value~=true or d.day<0 or d.progress[key]<rules.daily[key].targets[d.day%3+1] then return false end
		end
		if not plain(cal) or not integer(cal.lastDay,-1,maxDay) or not integer(cal.step,0,7) or not integer(cal.series,0,config.maxCount)
			or type(cal.uniqueAwarded)~="boolean" or type(cal.pendingPet)~="boolean" or type(cal.delivered)~="boolean"
			or (cal.lastDay==-1)~=(cal.step==0) or cal.uniqueAwarded~=(cal.series>0)
			or (cal.pendingPet and cal.delivered) or (cal.uniqueAwarded~=(cal.pendingPet or cal.delivered))
			or (cal.uniqueAwarded and p.entitlements.chronicler~=true) then return false end
		return true
	end
	function service.state(p,now)
		local t=p.longTerm; local epoch=Epochs.rules(config,p); local reasons={}
		if p.phase~=4 then table.insert(reasons,"Построй фазу 4") end
		if not t.cycle.finalProduced then table.insert(reasons,"Произведи "..config.recipes[epoch.finalRecipe].name.." в этом цикле") end
		if p.trade.pending then table.insert(reasons,"Дождись восстановления обмена") end
		if (p.currencyPaid.gold and p.gold>0) or (p.currencyPaid.essence and p.essence>0) then table.insert(reasons,"Баланс с платным происхождением: Rebirth недоступен до правил M6") end
		if p.rebirths>=config.maxCount then table.insert(reasons,"Достигнут предел циклов") end
		local preview={longTerm={daily=C.copy(t.daily)}}; local synced,d=Dailies.sync(preview,now); d=synced and d or preview.longTerm.daily
		local daily={}; for _,key in ipairs(rules.dailyOrder) do local def=rules.daily[key]; table.insert(daily,{id=key,name=def.name,target=def.targets[math.max(0,d.day)%3+1],progress=d.progress[key],claimed=d.claimed[key]==true,reward=C.copy(def.reward)}) end
		local day=Dailies.day(now); local cal=t.calendar
		local step=day<=cal.lastDay and cal.step or ((day==cal.lastDay+1 and cal.step<7) and cal.step+1 or 1)
		return {rebirths=p.rebirths,epoch=epoch.name,epochId=Epochs.id(p),nextEpoch=config.epochRules[(p.rebirths+1)%3].name,
			finalRecipe=epoch.finalRecipe,available=#reasons==0,reasons=reasons,shards=t.shards,perks=C.copy(t.perks),requestId=t.sequence+1,
			manualClickEssence=config.manualClickEssence+Epochs.essence(p),
			daily=daily,day=day,calendarStep=step,calendarClaimed=cal.lastDay>=day,calendarPending=cal.pendingPet,
			calendarSpecial=step==7 and (not cal.uniqueAwarded or (day==cal.lastDay and cal.series==1)),
			calendarUnique=cal.uniqueAwarded,calendarReward=C.copy(rules.calendar[step]),last=t.last and {requestId=t.last.requestId,action=t.last.action,result=C.copy(t.last.result)}}
	end
	local function reward(p,value)
		for key,amount in pairs(value) do if p[key]+amount>config.maxBalance then return false,"Сначала освободи место в балансе" end end
		for key,amount in pairs(value) do p[key]+=amount end
		return true
	end
	local function pet(p,species,source,paid)
		if count(p.pets)>=config.maxPets then return nil,"Коллекция заполнена: Fuse освобождает места; право на награду сохранено" end
		local id=string.format("%.0f",p.userId)..":pet:"..p.nextPetSerial
		if p.nextPetSerial>=config.maxCount or p.pets[id] then return nil,"Pet identity conflict" end
		p.pets[id]=familiars.create(id,species,config.familiarShop[species].stats,source,paid)
		p.nextPetSerial+=1; return id
	end
	function service.apply(profile,action,payload,engine,context)
		if not actions[action] or not Protocol.validate(action,payload) then return false,"Invalid long-term intent" end
		if profile.trade.pending or context.tradeActive then return false,"Finish the active trade first" end
		local now=context.now
		if not integer(now,0,config.maxTimestamp) or now<profile.lastSimulatedAt then return false,"Invalid server clock" end
		if context.guard and not context.guard() then return false,"Player session or location changed" end
		local key=C.encode({action=action,payload=payload}); local old=profile.longTerm
		if payload.requestId==old.sequence and old.last then
			if old.last.fingerprint~=key then return false,"Request ID conflict" end
			return true,C.copy(old.last.result),true
		end
		if payload.requestId~=old.sequence+1 or old.sequence>=config.maxBalance then return false,"Stale long-term request" end
		local p=C.copy(profile); local t=p.longTerm; local result={message="Прогресс сохранён"}
		local report=engine.advance(p,now,false); if not report.ok then return false,report.error end
		if action=="rebirth" then
			if payload.expectedRebirthCount~=p.rebirths then return false,"Cycle changed; review again" end
			local state=service.state(p,now); if not state.available then return false,table.concat(state.reasons,"; ") end
			local reset=engine.newProfile(p.userId,now)
			for _,field in ipairs({"gold","essence","inventory","questStock","order","phase","stations","warehouseLevel","pipes","manualReadyAt","slimeWorkSeconds","pipeCursor","inputCursors","lastSimulatedAt"}) do p[field]=reset[field] end
			p.rebirths+=1; t.cycle={id=p.rebirths,finalProduced=false}; t.shards+=1; t.earned+=1
			p.rngState=(p.rngState*48271+p.rebirths)%2147483647; if p.rngState==0 then p.rngState=1 end
			result={message="Перерождение сохранено: +1 Time Shard",rebirths=p.rebirths,epoch=Epochs.rules(config,p).name,shards=t.shards,petsKept=count(p.pets),cauldronsKept=count(p.cauldrons)}
		elseif action=="buyRebirthPerk" then
			local def=rules.perks[payload.perkId]; if not def then return false,"Unknown perk" end
			if t.perks[payload.perkId]~=payload.expectedLevel then return false,"Perk level changed" end
			if t.perks[payload.perkId]>=def.max or (payload.perkId=="title" and p.entitlements.chrononaut) then return false,"Уже приобретено" end
			if t.shards<def.cost then return false,"Недостаточно Time Shards" end
			t.shards-=def.cost; t.spent+=def.cost; t.perks[payload.perkId]+=1
			if payload.perkId=="title" then p.entitlements.chrononaut=true end
			result.message="Постоянное улучшение: "..def.name
		elseif action=="chooseRebirthPet" then
			if not table.find(rules.choiceOrder,payload.offerId) then return false,"Unknown direct choice" end
			if t.shards<rules.choiceCost then return false,"Недостаточно Time Shards" end
			local id,reason=pet(p,payload.offerId,"rebirth_shop",t.shardsPaid); if not id then return false,reason end
			t.shards-=rules.choiceCost; t.spent+=rules.choiceCost; result.petId=id; result.message="Выбранный фамильяр получен"
		elseif action=="claimDaily" then
			if payload.expectedDay~=Dailies.day(now) then return false,"UTC day changed" end
			local ok,d=Dailies.sync(p,now); if not ok then return false,d end
			local def=rules.daily[payload.questId]; if not def then return false,"Unknown daily quest" end
			if d.claimed[payload.questId] then return false,"Уже получено сегодня" end
			if d.progress[payload.questId]<def.targets[d.day%3+1] then return false,"Задание ещё не выполнено" end
			local granted,reason=reward(p,def.reward); if not granted then return false,reason end
			d.claimed[payload.questId]=true; result.message="Награда ежедневного задания сохранена"
		elseif action=="claimCalendar" then
			local day=Dailies.day(now); local cal=t.calendar
			if payload.expectedDay~=day or day<=cal.lastDay then return false,"Calendar already claimed or UTC day changed" end
			local step=(day==cal.lastDay+1 and cal.step<7) and cal.step+1 or 1
			if step==7 and cal.series>=config.maxCount then return false,"Calendar series limit" end
			if step==7 and not cal.uniqueAwarded then
				cal.uniqueAwarded=true; cal.pendingPet=true; p.entitlements.chronicler=true
				result.message="Серия завершена: титул Летописец и право получить Moon Cat"
			else local ok,reason=reward(p,rules.calendar[step]); if not ok then return false,reason end; result.message="Награда календаря: день "..step end
			cal.lastDay,cal.step=day,step; if step==7 then cal.series+=1 end
		elseif action=="deliverCalendarPet" then
			local cal=t.calendar; if not cal.pendingPet then return false,"Нет неполученной награды" end
			local id,reason=pet(p,rules.calendarPet,"calendar",false); if not id then return false,reason end
			cal.pendingPet=false; cal.delivered=true; result.petId=id; result.message="Moon Cat из календаря получен"
		end
		t.sequence=payload.requestId; t.last={requestId=payload.requestId,action=action,fingerprint=key,result=C.copy(result)}
		if not engine.validate(p) then return false,"Invalid long-term candidate" end
		table.clear(profile); for field,value in pairs(p) do profile[field]=value end
		return true,result,false
	end
	return service
end
return LongTerm

--!nonstrict
-- Pure candidates; only the trusted receipt coordinator may call paid/pass methods.
local runtimeScript=rawget(getfenv(),"script")
local C=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.TradeCodec or "./TradeCodec")
local Catalog=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.OfferCatalog or "./OfferCatalog")
local Familiars=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.Familiars or "./Familiars")
local Protocol=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.Protocol or "./Protocol")
local Monetization={}
local actions={buyEventGold=true,deliverPurchases=true}
local function plain(v) return type(v)=="table" and getmetatable(v)==nil end
local function count(t) local n=0; for _ in pairs(t) do n+=1 end; return n end
function Monetization.initial() return {sequence=0,receipts={},passes={}} end
function Monetization.isAction(action) return actions[action]==true end
function Monetization.new(config)
	local service={}; local catalog=Catalog.new(config); local familiars=Familiars.new(config)
	function service.queued(p) local n=0; for _,r in pairs(p.monetization.receipts) do if plain(r) and r.status=="queued" then n+=1 end end; return n end
	function service.room(p,grant)
		if grant.kind=="pet" then return count(p.pets)<config.maxPets and p.nextPetSerial<config.maxCount end
		if grant.kind=="cauldron" then return count(p.cauldrons)<config.trading.maxCauldrons and p.nextCauldronSerial<config.maxCount end
		return true
	end
	local function insert(p,grant,paid,purchaseHash,productId)
		if not service.room(p,grant) then return nil,"Inventory full; delivery right retained" end
		if grant.kind=="cosmetic" then p.entitlements[grant.entitlement]=true; return grant.entitlement end
		local pet=grant.kind=="pet"; local serial=pet and p.nextPetSerial or p.nextCauldronSerial
		local id=string.format("%.0f",p.userId)..(pet and ":pet:" or ":cauldron:")..serial
		if p.pets[id] or p.cauldrons[id] then return nil,"Instance identity conflict" end
		local source=purchaseHash and "developer_product" or "event_gold"
		local origin={source=source,paidDerived=paid,offerId=grant.offerId,eventId=grant.eventId,version=grant.version,purchaseHash=purchaseHash,productId=productId}
		if pet then
			local value=familiars.create(id,grant.species,grant.stats,source,paid)
			for k,v in pairs(origin) do value.provenance[k]=v end
			p.pets[id]=value; p.nextPetSerial+=1
		else
			p.cauldrons[id]={id=id,ownerId=p.userId,type=grant.cauldronType,bonus=grant.bonus,brewSpeedBonus=grant.brewSpeedBonus,locked=false,provenance=origin}
			p.nextCauldronSerial+=1
		end
		return id
	end
	function service.validate(p)
		local m=p.monetization
		if not plain(m) or not Catalog.integer(m.sequence,0,config.maxBalance) or not plain(m.receipts) or not plain(m.passes)
			or count(m.receipts)>config.monetization.maxReceipts or count(m.passes)>64 or service.queued(p)>config.monetization.maxQueued then return false end
		if m.sequence==0 then if m.last~=nil then return false end
		elseif not plain(m.last) or m.last.requestId~=m.sequence or not actions[m.last.action] or type(m.last.fingerprint)~="string"
			or #m.last.fingerprint>1024 or not plain(m.last.result) or type(m.last.result.message)~="string" or #m.last.result.message>256 then return false end
		local instances={}
		for key,r in pairs(m.receipts) do
			if not Catalog.hash(key) or not plain(r) or not Catalog.integer(r.productId,1,9007199254740991) or r.grantHash~=catalog.fingerprint(r.offerId)
				or not Catalog.hash(r.grantHash) or config.monetization.offers[r.offerId].platformKind~="product"
				or (r.status~="queued" and r.status~="delivered") or not Catalog.integer(r.acceptedAt,0,config.maxTimestamp) then return false end
			if r.status=="queued" and r.instanceId~=nil then return false end
			if r.status=="delivered" and (type(r.instanceId)~="string" or #r.instanceId<1 or #r.instanceId>80) then return false end
			if r.instanceId then
				if instances[r.instanceId] then return false end; instances[r.instanceId]=true
				local item=p.pets[r.instanceId] or p.cauldrons[r.instanceId]
				if item and (item.provenance.purchaseHash~=key or item.provenance.productId~=r.productId or item.provenance.offerId~=r.offerId) then return false end
			end
		end
		local purchaseItems={}
		for _,inventory in ipairs({p.pets,p.cauldrons}) do for _,item in pairs(inventory) do
			local key=item.provenance.purchaseHash
			if key then
				if purchaseItems[key] then return false end; purchaseItems[key]=true
				local proof=m.receipts[key]
				if proof and (proof.status~="delivered" or proof.instanceId~=item.id) then return false end
			end
		end end
		for key,proof in pairs(m.passes) do
			if type(key)~="string" or not Catalog.integer(tonumber(key),1,9007199254740991) or not plain(proof)
				or proof.grantHash~=catalog.fingerprint(proof.offerId) or not Catalog.hash(proof.grantHash) then return false end
			local def=config.monetization.offers[proof.offerId]
			if def.platformKind~="pass" or p.entitlements[def.entitlement]~=true then return false end
		end
		return true
	end
	local function allowed(p,engine,ctx)
		if p.trade.pending or ctx.tradeActive then return false,"Finish trade recovery first" end
		if not Catalog.integer(ctx.now,0,config.maxTimestamp) or ctx.now<p.lastSimulatedAt then return false,"Invalid server clock" end
		if ctx.guard and not ctx.guard() then return false,"Player session changed" end
		local result=engine.advance(p,ctx.now,false); return result.ok,result.error
	end
	local function publish(profile,p,engine,result)
		local ok,reason=engine.validate(p); if not ok then return false,reason end
		table.clear(profile); for k,v in pairs(p) do profile[k]=v end; return true,result,false
	end
	function service.acceptReceipt(profile,receipt,offerId,engine,ctx)
		if profile.userId~=receipt.PlayerId then return false,"Receipt player mismatch" end
		local grant=catalog.grant(offerId); if not grant or grant.platformKind~="product" then return false,"Unknown product grant" end
		local key=C.sha256(receipt.PurchaseId); local proof=profile.monetization.receipts[key]
		if proof then
			if proof.productId~=receipt.ProductId or proof.grantHash~=catalog.fingerprint(offerId) then return false,"Receipt identity conflict" end
			return true,{status=proof.status,instanceId=proof.instanceId},true
		end
		if count(profile.monetization.receipts)>=config.monetization.maxReceipts or service.queued(profile)>=config.monetization.maxQueued then return false,"Receipt history/queue limit; payment remains unacknowledged" end
		local p=C.copy(profile); local ok,why=allowed(p,engine,ctx); if not ok then return false,why end
		local id=insert(p,grant,true,key,receipt.ProductId)
		p.monetization.receipts[key]={offerId=offerId,productId=receipt.ProductId,grantHash=catalog.fingerprint(offerId),acceptedAt=ctx.now,status=id and "delivered" or "queued",instanceId=id}
		return publish(profile,p,engine,{status=id and "delivered" or "queued",instanceId=id})
	end
	function service.acceptPass(profile,offerId,passId,engine,ctx)
		local def=config.monetization.offers[offerId]
		if not def or def.platformKind~="pass" or ctx.verifiedOwned~=true or not Catalog.integer(passId,1,9007199254740991) then return false,"Pass ownership unverified" end
		local key=string.format("%.0f",passId); local proof=profile.monetization.passes[key]
		if proof then return proof.offerId==offerId and proof.grantHash==catalog.fingerprint(offerId),{message="Право уже подтверждено"},true end
		local p=C.copy(profile); local ok,why=allowed(p,engine,ctx); if not ok then return false,why end
		p.entitlements[def.entitlement]=true; p.monetization.passes[key]={offerId=offerId,grantHash=catalog.fingerprint(offerId)}
		return publish(profile,p,engine,{message="Постоянное оформление сохранено"})
	end
	function service.apply(profile,action,payload,engine,ctx)
		if not actions[action] or not Protocol.validate(action,payload) then return false,"Invalid shop intent" end
		local old=profile.monetization; local fingerprint=C.encode({action=action,payload=payload})
		if payload.requestId==old.sequence and old.last then
			if old.last.fingerprint~=fingerprint then return false,"Request ID conflict" end
			return true,C.copy(old.last.result),true
		end
		if payload.requestId~=old.sequence+1 or old.sequence>=config.maxBalance then return false,"Stale shop request" end
		local p=C.copy(profile); local ok,why=allowed(p,engine,ctx); if not ok then return false,why end
		local result={message="Покупка сохранена"}
		if action=="buyEventGold" then
			local available,reason=catalog.available(p,payload.offerId,ctx.now); if not available then return false,reason end
			local def=config.monetization.offers[payload.offerId]; if p.gold<def.goldCost then return false,"Недостаточно заработанного Gold" end
			local id,err=insert(p,catalog.grant(payload.offerId),p.currencyPaid.gold); if not id then return false,err end
			p.gold-=def.goldCost; result.instanceId=id
		else
			local keys={}; for key,r in pairs(p.monetization.receipts) do if r.status=="queued" then table.insert(keys,key) end end; table.sort(keys)
			local delivered=0
			for _,key in ipairs(keys) do
				local r=p.monetization.receipts[key]; local id=insert(p,catalog.grant(r.offerId),true,key,r.productId)
				if id then r.status,r.instanceId="delivered",id; delivered+=1 end
			end
			if delivered==0 then return false,"Нет доступной доставки: освободи место, оплаченные права сохранены" end
			result.message="Доставлено предметов: "..delivered; result.delivered=delivered
		end
		p.monetization.sequence=payload.requestId; p.monetization.last={requestId=payload.requestId,action=action,fingerprint=fingerprint,result=C.copy(result)}
		return publish(profile,p,engine,result)
	end
	function service.state(p,now)
		local cards={}
		for _,id in ipairs(config.monetization.offerOrder) do
			local def=config.monetization.offers[id]; local available,status=catalog.available(p,id,now)
			local owned,queued,delivered=0,0,0
			if def.kind=="cosmetic" then owned=p.entitlements[def.entitlement] and 1 or 0
			else for _,item in pairs(def.kind=="pet" and p.pets or p.cauldrons) do if item.provenance.offerId==id then owned+=1 end end end
			for _,r in pairs(p.monetization.receipts) do if r.offerId==id then if r.status=="queued" then queued+=1 else delivered+=1 end end end
			table.insert(cards,{offerId=id,name=def.name,kind=def.kind,visual=def.visual,effect=def.effect,stats=def.stats and C.copy(def.stats),goldCost=def.goldCost,
				available=available,status=status,owned=owned,queued=queued,delivered=delivered,room=service.room(p,catalog.grant(id)),event=config.events[def.eventId] and C.copy(config.events[def.eventId])})
		end
		return {sequence=p.monetization.sequence,cards=cards,queued=service.queued(p),receiptCount=count(p.monetization.receipts),last=p.monetization.last and C.copy(p.monetization.last.result)}
	end
	return service
end
return Monetization

--!nonstrict
-- Pure fixed outcomes. Sale admission can expire; released grants never do.
local runtimeScript=rawget(getfenv(),"script")
local C=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.TradeCodec or "./TradeCodec")
local Catalog={}
function Catalog.integer(n,lo,hi) return type(n)=="number" and n==n and n%1==0 and n>=lo and n<=hi end
function Catalog.hash(s) return type(s)=="string" and #s==64 and string.match(s,"^[a-f0-9]+$")~=nil end
function Catalog.new(config,skus)
	local service={}; local grants,products,passes={},{},{}
	for id,def in pairs(config.monetization.offers) do
		assert(Catalog.integer(def.version,1,1000) and Catalog.integer(def.goldCost,1,config.maxBalance),"Invalid offer version/cost")
		assert(type(def.enabled)=="boolean" and type(def.supportedEpochs)=="table" and #def.supportedEpochs==3,"Invalid availability")
		assert(def.eventId=="permanent" or config.events[def.eventId],"Unknown event")
		local event=config.events[def.eventId]
		if event then assert(Catalog.integer(event.startAtUtc,0,config.maxTimestamp) and Catalog.integer(event.endAtUtc,event.startAtUtc+1,config.maxTimestamp),"Invalid event interval") end
		assert((def.kind=="pet" or def.kind=="cauldron") and def.platformKind=="product" or def.kind=="cosmetic" and def.platformKind=="pass","Invalid fixed product kind")
		if def.kind=="pet" then
			local species=config.petSpecies[def.species]; assert(species and def.stats,"Invalid pet grant")
			for _,skill in ipairs({"Farming","Hauling","Brewing"}) do assert(Catalog.integer(def.stats[skill],species.ranges[skill][1],species.ranges[skill][2]),"Invalid fixed stat") end
		elseif def.kind=="cauldron" then
			local item=config.cauldronTypes[def.cauldronType]; assert(item and def.bonus==0 and item.bonus==def.bonus and def.brewSpeedBonus==item.brewSpeedBonus and def.brewSpeedBonus<=0.05,"Invalid fixed cauldron")
		else assert(type(def.entitlement)=="string" and #def.entitlement>0,"Invalid cosmetic entitlement") end
		local grant={offerId=id,version=def.version,eventId=def.eventId,kind=def.kind,platformKind=def.platformKind,visual=def.visual,
			species=def.species,stats=def.stats and C.copy(def.stats),cauldronType=def.cauldronType,bonus=def.bonus,brewSpeedBonus=def.brewSpeedBonus,entitlement=def.entitlement}
		grants[id]={data=grant,hash=C.hash(grant)}
		local sku=skus and skus[id] or 0; assert(Catalog.integer(sku,0,9007199254740991),"Invalid SKU")
		if sku>0 then local map=def.platformKind=="product" and products or passes; assert(not map[sku],"Duplicate SKU mapping"); map[sku]=id end
	end
	if skus then for id in pairs(skus) do assert(grants[id],"Unknown SKU offer") end end
	function service.grant(id) return grants[id] and C.copy(grants[id].data) end
	function service.fingerprint(id) return grants[id] and grants[id].hash end
	function service.resolve(kind,id) return (kind=="product" and products or kind=="pass" and passes or {})[id] end
	function service.sku(id) return skus and skus[id] or 0 end
	function service.available(p,id,now)
		local def=config.monetization.offers[id]
		if not def or not def.enabled or not Catalog.integer(now,0,config.maxTimestamp) then return false,"unavailable" end
		local event=config.events[def.eventId]
		if event and now<event.startAtUtc then return false,"upcoming" end
		if event and now>=event.endAtUtc then return false,"ended" end
		if not def.supportedEpochs[p.rebirths%3+1] then return false,"epoch_unavailable" end
		if def.kind=="cosmetic" and p.entitlements[def.entitlement] then return false,"owned" end
		return true,"available"
	end
	return service
end
return Catalog

--!nonstrict
-- Server service adapter injects lookup/clock; tests inject deterministic results.
local Policy = {}
function Policy.allowed(state, now)
	return type(state) == "table" and state.status == "unrestricted" and state.randomAllowed == true
		and type(state.expiresAt) == "number" and state.expiresAt > now
end
function Policy.new(options)
	local cache, generations = {}, {}
	local nextGeneration = 0
	local service = {}
	function service.peek(key)
		local current = cache[key]
		if current and current.expiresAt > options.now() then return current end
		return { status = "unavailable", randomAllowed = false, tradingAllowed = false, expiresAt = 0 }
	end
	function service.get(key, force)
		local cached = cache[key]
		if not force and cached and cached.expiresAt > options.now() then return cached end
		nextGeneration += 1
		local generation = nextGeneration
		generations[key] = generation
		local ok, result = pcall(options.lookup, key)
		local state = { status = "unavailable", randomAllowed = false, tradingAllowed = false, expiresAt = options.now() + options.ttl }
		if ok and type(result) == "table" and type(result.ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted) == "boolean" then
			state.status = result.ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted and "restricted" or "unrestricted"
			state.randomAllowed = not result.ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted
			state.tradingAllowed = result.IsPaidItemTradingAllowed == true
			state.tradingKnown = type(result.IsPaidItemTradingAllowed)=="boolean"
		end
		if generations[key] ~= generation then
			if force then return {status="unavailable",randomAllowed=false,tradingAllowed=false,expiresAt=0} end
			return service.peek(key)
		end
		cache[key] = state
		return state
	end
	function service.forget(key)
		cache[key] = nil
		generations[key] = nil -- Late lookup cannot revive a departed Player or retain its reference.
	end
	return service
end
return Policy

--!nonstrict
-- Pure construction/equipment rules. Runtime commits this candidate before acknowledgement.
local runtimeScript=rawget(getfenv(),"script")
local Protocol=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.Protocol or "./Protocol")
local Epochs=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.Epochs or "./Epochs")
local Origin=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.ItemOrigin or "./ItemOrigin")
local Progression={}
local actions={build=true,advancePhase=true,equipCauldron=true,lockCauldron=true}
local function integer(v,lo,hi) return type(v)=="number" and v==v and v%1==0 and v>=lo and v<=hi end
local function plain(v) return type(v)=="table" and getmetatable(v)==nil end
local function id(v) return type(v)=="string" and #v>0 and #v<=80 end
local function fingerprint(action,payload)
	local keys={}; for k in pairs(payload) do table.insert(keys,k) end; table.sort(keys)
	local parts={action}; for _,k in ipairs(keys) do table.insert(parts,k.."="..tostring(payload[k])) end
	return table.concat(parts,"|")
end
function Progression.isAction(action) return actions[action]==true end
function Progression.new(config)
	local service={}
	function service.buildState(p,slotId)
		if slotId=="pipes" then return {available=not p.pipes,cost=Epochs.cost(config,p,config.pipesCost),reason=p.pipes and "Pipes already built" or "",level=p.pipes and 1 or 0} end
		local def=slotId=="warehouse" and config.warehouse or config.stations[slotId]
		if not def then return {available=false,reason="Unknown fixed slot"} end
		local level=slotId=="warehouse" and p.warehouseLevel or p.stations[slotId].level
		local cost=Epochs.cost(config,p,def.upgradeCosts[level+1])
		local phase=def.tierPhases and def.tierPhases[level+1] or def.phase or 1
		local reason=not cost and "Maximum tier" or (p.phase<phase and ("Requires phase "..phase) or "")
		return {available=reason=="",reason=reason,cost=cost,level=level,requiredPhase=phase}
	end
	function service.phaseState(p)
		local epoch=Epochs.rules(config,p); local nextPhase=config.phases[p.phase+1]; local reasons={}
		local price=nextPhase and Epochs.cost(config,p,nextPhase.cost)
		if nextPhase then
			for _,recipe in ipairs(epoch.phaseRecipes[p.phase+1]) do if not p.discoveredRecipes[recipe] then table.insert(reasons,"Discover "..config.recipes[recipe].name) end end
			for station,level in pairs(nextPhase.stations) do if p.stations[station].level<level then table.insert(reasons,config.stations[station].name.." tier "..level) end end
			if nextPhase.pipes and not p.pipes then table.insert(reasons,"Build pipes") end
			if nextPhase.warehouse and p.warehouseLevel<nextPhase.warehouse then table.insert(reasons,"Warehouse level "..nextPhase.warehouse) end
			if p.gold<price then table.insert(reasons,"Need "..price.." Gold") end
		end
		table.sort(reasons)
		local completed=p.phase==4 and (p.longTerm and p.longTerm.cycle.finalProduced or not p.longTerm and p.discoveredRecipes.ascension==true)
		return {phase=p.phase,name=config.phases[p.phase].name,epoch=epoch.name,nextName=nextPhase and nextPhase.name,cost=price,
			available=nextPhase~=nil and #reasons==0,reasons=reasons,complete=completed,
			message=completed and "Цикл завершён: открой Rebirth для проверки условий" or (p.phase==4 and "Изготовь "..config.recipes[epoch.finalRecipe].name.." в этом цикле" or "Открой следующую фазу")}
	end
	function service.validate(p)
		if not integer(p.phase,1,4) or not plain(p.progression) or not integer(p.progression.sequence,0,config.maxBalance)
			or not plain(p.cauldrons) or not integer(p.nextCauldronSerial,1,config.maxCount) then return false end
		local last=p.progression.last
		if p.progression.sequence==0 then if last~=nil then return false end
		elseif not plain(last) or last.requestId~=p.progression.sequence or not id(last.action) or not actions[last.action]
			or type(last.fingerprint)~="string" or #last.fingerprint>512 or #last.fingerprint<1
			or not plain(last.result) or type(last.result.message)~="string" or #last.result.message>256 then return false end
		local count=0
		for key,item in pairs(p.cauldrons) do
			count+=1; local def=plain(item) and config.cauldronTypes[item.type]
			if not id(key) or not def or item.id~=key or item.ownerId~=p.userId or item.bonus~=def.bonus
				or type(item.locked)~="boolean" or not Origin.cauldron(config,item) then return false end
		end
		if count>16 then return false end
		local equipped={}
		for slotId,station in pairs(p.stations) do
			local itemId=station.cauldronId
			if itemId~=nil then
				if not p.cauldrons[itemId] or equipped[itemId] or config.stations[slotId].archetype~="cauldron" or station.level==0 then return false end
				equipped[itemId]=true
			end
			local def=config.stations[slotId]
			if station.level>0 and def.tierPhases and p.phase<def.tierPhases[station.level] then return false end
		end
		return true
	end
	function service.apply(p,action,payload,engine,now)
		if p.trade and p.trade.pending then return false,"Trade recovery pending" end
		if not actions[action] or not Protocol.validate(action,payload) then return false,"Invalid progression intent" end
		local progress=p.progression; local key=fingerprint(action,payload)
		if payload.requestId==progress.sequence and progress.last then
			if progress.last.fingerprint~=key then return false,"Request ID conflict" end
			return true,{message=progress.last.result.message,cauldronId=progress.last.result.cauldronId},true
		end
		if payload.requestId~=progress.sequence+1 or progress.sequence>=config.maxBalance then return false,"Stale progression request" end
		local result={message="Factory updated"}
		if action=="build" then
			local state=service.buildState(p,payload.upgradeId)
			if not state.available then return false,state.reason end
			if state.level~=payload.expectedLevel then return false,"Upgrade already changed" end
			local ok,reason=engine.act(p,"buy",{upgradeId=payload.upgradeId,expectedLevel=payload.expectedLevel},now)
			if not ok then return false,reason end
			result.message="Built/upgraded "..payload.upgradeId
		elseif action=="advancePhase" then
			if payload.expectedPhase~=p.phase then return false,"Phase already changed" end
			local state=service.phaseState(p)
			if not state.available then return false,#state.reasons>0 and table.concat(state.reasons,"; ") or "Final phase already built" end
			local nextPhase=p.phase+1
			local item
			if nextPhase==3 and not (p.longTerm and p.longTerm.milestoneClaimed) then
				local itemId=string.format("%.0f",p.userId)..":cauldron:"..p.nextCauldronSerial
				local amount=0; for _ in pairs(p.cauldrons) do amount+=1 end
				if amount>=16 then return false,"Cauldron inventory full" end
				if p.nextCauldronSerial>=config.maxCount or p.cauldrons[itemId] then return false,"Cauldron identity conflict" end
				item={id=itemId,ownerId=p.userId,type="resonant",bonus=config.cauldronTypes.resonant.bonus,locked=false,provenance={source="phase3",paidDerived=false}}
			end
			p.gold-=state.cost; p.phase=nextPhase
			if item then p.cauldrons[item.id]=item; p.nextCauldronSerial+=1; result.cauldronId=item.id; if p.longTerm then p.longTerm.milestoneClaimed=true end end
			result.message="Opened "..config.phases[nextPhase].name
		elseif action=="equipCauldron" then
			local slot=p.stations[payload.slotId]
			if not slot or config.stations[payload.slotId].archetype~="cauldron" or slot.level==0 then return false,"Choose a built cauldron slot" end
			if slot.job then return false,"Finish the paid batch before changing equipment" end
			if payload.cauldronId~="" then
				local item=p.cauldrons[payload.cauldronId]
				if not item or item.ownerId~=p.userId then return false,"Cauldron not owned" end
				for _,other in pairs(p.stations) do if other.cauldronId==item.id then return false,"Unequip this cauldron from its current slot first" end end
			end
			slot.cauldronId=payload.cauldronId~="" and payload.cauldronId or nil
			result.message="Cauldron equipment updated"
		elseif action=="lockCauldron" then
			local item=p.cauldrons[payload.cauldronId]
			if not item or item.ownerId~=p.userId then return false,"Cauldron not owned" end
			item.locked=payload.locked; result.message="Cauldron lock updated"
		end
		p.progression={sequence=payload.requestId,last={requestId=payload.requestId,action=action,fingerprint=key,result=result}}
		return true,result,false
	end
	return service
end
return Progression

--!strict
-- Shape/rate gate only. The server still owns authorization, ranges and economics.
-- No Roblox APIs: the exact module is exercised by the standalone Luau tests.

export type Config = {
	aggregateRate: number?,
	aggregateBurst: number?,
	clickRate: number?,
	clickBurst: number?,
	controlRate: number?,
	controlBurst: number?,
}

type Limits = {
	aggregateRate: number,
	aggregateBurst: number,
	clickRate: number,
	clickBurst: number,
	controlRate: number,
	controlBurst: number,
}

type Bucket = {
	lastTime: number,
	aggregate: number,
	click: number,
	control: number,
}

local Protocol = {}
Protocol.__index = Protocol

type GateData = {
	_limits: Limits,
	_buckets: { [number]: Bucket? },
}

export type Gate = typeof(setmetatable({} :: GateData, Protocol))

local SCHEMAS: { [string]: { [string]: string } } = {
	buyEventGold = { offerId="id",confirmed="true",requestId="sequence" },
	deliverPurchases = { requestId="sequence" },
	requestPurchase = { offerId="id" },
	refreshPurchases = {},
	rebirth = { expectedRebirthCount="level",confirmed="true",requestId="sequence" },
	buyRebirthPerk = { perkId="id",expectedLevel="level",requestId="sequence" },
	chooseRebirthPet = { offerId="id",confirmed="true",requestId="sequence" },
	claimDaily = { questId="id",expectedDay="day",requestId="sequence" },
	claimCalendar = { expectedDay="day",requestId="sequence" },
	deliverCalendarPet = { requestId="sequence" },
	tradeInvite = { targetToken="id" },
	tradeAccept = { tradeId="id",version="sequence" },
	tradeCancel = { tradeId="id",version="sequence" },
	tradeOffer = { tradeId="id",version="sequence",items="trade-items" },
	tradeReady = { tradeId="id",version="sequence",ready="boolean" },
	tradeConfirm = { tradeId="id",version="sequence",offerHash="id" },
	click = {},
	assign = { stationId = "id", petId = "id-or-empty" },
	harvest = { stationId = "id" },
	collect = { stationId = "id" },
	load = { stationId = "id" },
	brew = { stationId = "id" },
	setRecipe = { stationId = "id", recipeId = "id" },
	setAuto = { stationId = "id", enabled = "boolean" },
	buy = { upgradeId = "id", expectedLevel = "level" },
	build = { upgradeId = "id", expectedLevel = "level", requestId = "sequence" },
	advancePhase = { expectedPhase = "phase", requestId = "sequence" },
	equipCauldron = { slotId = "id", cauldronId = "id-or-empty", requestId = "sequence" },
	lockCauldron = { cauldronId = "id", locked = "boolean", requestId = "sequence" },
	prioritize = { stationId = "id" },
	hire = { speciesId = "id", requestId = "sequence" },
	summon = { poolId = "id", count = "count", requestId = "sequence" },
	shopFamiliar = { offerId = "id", requestId = "sequence" },
	petLock = { petId = "id", locked = "boolean", requestId = "sequence" },
	previewFuse = { petIds = "five-ids" },
	refreshPolicy = {},
	fuse = { petIds = "five-ids", previewToken = "id", confirmed = "true", requestId = "sequence" },
	discard = { itemId = "id", amount = "count" },
	acceptOrder = { orderId = "id" },
	claimOrder = {},
}

local DEFAULTS: Limits = {
	aggregateRate = 20,
	aggregateBurst = 30,
	clickRate = 8,
	clickBurst = 8,
	controlRate = 5,
	controlBurst = 10,
}

local MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = 9007199254740991
local MAX_ID_LENGTH = 64

local function finite(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

local function validId(value: any, allowEmpty: boolean): boolean
	if type(value) ~= "string" or #value > MAX_ID_LENGTH then
		return false
	end
	if value == "" then
		return allowEmpty
	end
	-- These are opaque identifiers, not display names or arbitrary user text.
	return string.match(value, "^[%w_:%-%.]+$") ~= nil
end

local function validatePayload(action: any, payload: any): (boolean, string)
	if type(action) ~= "string" or #action > MAX_ID_LENGTH then
		return false, "invalid_action"
	end
	local schema = SCHEMAS[action]
	if schema == nil then
		return false, "invalid_action"
	end
	if type(payload) ~= "table" or getmetatable(payload) ~= nil then
		return false, "invalid_payload"
	end
	for key in pairs(payload) do
		if type(key) ~= "string" or schema[key] == nil then
			return false, "unexpected_field"
		end
	end
	for key, kind in pairs(schema) do
		local value = payload[key]
		if kind == "trade-items" then
			if type(value)~="table" or getmetatable(value)~=nil or #value>6 then return false,"invalid_payload" end
			local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}; local count=0
			for index,entry in pairs(value) do
				if type(index)~="number" or not finite(index) or index%1~=0 or index<1 or index>#value
					or type(entry)~="table" or getmetatable(entry)~=nil then return false,"invalid_payload" end
				for field in pairs(entry) do if field~="id" and field~="kind" then return false,"unexpected_field" end end
				local offeredId: any = (entry :: any).id
				if (entry.kind~="pet" and entry.kind~="cauldron") or type(offeredId)~="string" or not validId(offeredId,false) or seen[offeredId] then return false,"invalid_payload" end
				seen[offeredId]=true; count+=1
			end
			if count~=#value then return false,"invalid_payload" end
		elseif kind == "five-ids" then
			if type(value) ~= "table" or getmetatable(value) ~= nil or #value ~= 5 then return false, "invalid_payload" end
			local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
			local count = 0
			for index, id in pairs(value) do
				if type(index) ~= "number" or not finite(index) or index % 1 ~= 0 or index < 1 or index > 5
					or type(id) ~= "string" or not validId(id, false) or seen[id] then return false, "invalid_payload" end
				seen[id], count = true, count + 1
			end
			if count ~= 5 then return false, "invalid_payload" end
		elseif kind == "phase" then
			if not finite(value) or value % 1 ~= 0 or value < 1 or value > 4 then return false, "invalid_payload" end
		elseif kind == "day" then
			if not finite(value) or value%1~=0 or value<0 or value>11574074 then return false,"invalid_payload" end
		elseif kind == "sequence" then
			if not finite(value) or value % 1 ~= 0 or value < 1 or value > 1000000000000 then return false, "invalid_payload" end
		elseif kind == "true" then
			if value ~= true then return false, "invalid_payload" end
		elseif kind == "boolean" then
			if type(value) ~= "boolean" then
				return false, "invalid_payload"
			end
		elseif kind == "count" or kind == "level" then
			if not finite(value) or value % 1 ~= 0 or value < (kind == "level" and 0 or 1) or value > 1000000 then
				return false, "invalid_payload"
			end
		elseif not validId(value, kind == "id-or-empty") then
			return false, "invalid_payload"
		end
	end
	return true, "ok"
end

function Protocol.new(config: Config?): Gate
	local limits: Limits = table.clone(DEFAULTS)
	if config ~= nil then
		assert(type(config) == "table" and getmetatable(config) == nil, "Protocol config must be a plain table")
		for key, value in pairs(config :: any) do
			assert((DEFAULTS :: any)[key] ~= nil, "Unknown Protocol option: " .. tostring(key))
			assert(finite(value), "Protocol limits must be finite numbers")
			if string.find(key, "Burst", 1, true) then
				assert(value >= 1 and value % 1 == 0, "Protocol bursts must be positive integers")
			else
				assert(value >= 0, "Protocol rates cannot be negative")
			end
			(limits :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	return setmetatable({
		_limits = limits,
		_buckets = {} :: { [number]: Bucket? },
	}, Protocol)
end

-- nowMonotonic must come from the server, never the RemoteEvent payload.
function Protocol.check(self: Gate, userId: any, action: any, payload: any, nowMonotonic: any): (boolean, string)
	if not finite(userId) or userId % 1 ~= 0 or math.abs(userId) > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER then
		return false, "invalid_identity"
	end
	-- Negative/zero Studio user IDs are valid identities for local multiplayer tests.
	if not finite(nowMonotonic) or nowMonotonic < 0 then
		return false, "invalid_time"
	end
	local now: number = nowMonotonic
	local limits: Limits = self._limits
	local existing: Bucket? = self._buckets[userId]
	local bucket: Bucket
	if existing == nil then
		bucket = {
			lastTime = now,
			aggregate = limits.aggregateBurst,
			click = limits.clickBurst,
			control = limits.controlBurst,
		}
		self._buckets[userId] = bucket
	else
		bucket = existing
	end
	if now < bucket.lastTime then
		return false, "clock_rewind"
	end
	local elapsed = now - bucket.lastTime
	bucket.lastTime = now
	bucket.aggregate = math.min(limits.aggregateBurst, bucket.aggregate + elapsed * limits.aggregateRate)
	bucket.click = math.min(limits.clickBurst, bucket.click + elapsed * limits.clickRate)
	bucket.control = math.min(limits.controlBurst, bucket.control + elapsed * limits.controlRate)
	if bucket.aggregate < 1 then
		return false, "rate_limited"
	end
	-- Malformed and subtype-throttled requests also spend aggregate budget.
	bucket.aggregate -= 1
	local valid, reason = validatePayload(action, payload)
	if not valid then
		return false, reason
	end
	if action == "click" then
		if bucket.click < 1 then
			return false, "rate_limited"
		end
		bucket.click -= 1
	else
		if bucket.control < 1 then
			return false, "rate_limited"
		end
		bucket.control -= 1
	end
	return true, "ok"
end

function Protocol.forget(self: Gate, userId: number)
	self._buckets[userId] = nil
end

Protocol.validate = validatePayload

return Protocol

--!nonstrict
-- Canonical server snapshots and SHA-256 labels. Full canonical equality, not just
-- a client hash, is checked before reservation. No secret/client authority here.
local Codec={}
function Codec.copy(v: any): any
	if type(v)~="table" then return v end
	local r={}; for k,x in pairs(v) do r[k]=Codec.copy(x) end; return r
end
function Codec.encode(v: any): string
	local t=type(v)
	if t=="nil" then return "n" elseif t=="boolean" then return v and "t" or "f"
	elseif t=="number" then assert(v==v and math.abs(v)<math.huge); return "d"..string.format("%.17g",v)..";"
	elseif t=="string" then return "s"..#v..":"..v end
	assert(t=="table" and getmetatable(v)==nil,"invalid snapshot")
	local keys={}; for k in pairs(v) do assert(type(k)=="string" or type(k)=="number"); table.insert(keys,k) end
	table.sort(keys,function(a,b) return Codec.encode(a)<Codec.encode(b) end)
	local result={"{"}; for _,k in ipairs(keys) do table.insert(result,Codec.encode(k)..Codec.encode(v[k])) end
	table.insert(result,"}"); return table.concat(result)
end
local K={0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,
	0xd807aa98,0x12835b01,0x243185be,0x550c7dc3,0x72be5d74,0x80deb1fe,0x9bdc06a7,0xc19bf174,
	0xe49b69c1,0xefbe4786,0x0fc19dc6,0x240ca1cc,0x2de92c6f,0x4a7484aa,0x5cb0a9dc,0x76f988da,
	0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,
	0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85,
	0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070,
	0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,
	0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2}
local xor,band,ror,rshift=bit32.bxor,bit32.band,bit32.rrotate,bit32.rshift
local function bytes(n) return string.char(rshift(n,24),band(rshift(n,16),255),band(rshift(n,8),255),band(n,255)) end
function Codec.sha256(message)
	local length=#message*8
	message=message.."\128"..string.rep("\0",(55-#message)%64)..bytes(math.floor(length/2^32))..bytes(length%2^32)
	local h={0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19}
	for base=1,#message,64 do
		local w={}
		for i=0,15 do local a,b,c,d=string.byte(message,base+i*4,base+i*4+3); w[i+1]=a*2^24+b*2^16+c*256+d end
		for i=17,64 do
			local a,b=w[i-15],w[i-2]
			w[i]=(w[i-16]+xor(ror(a,7),ror(a,18),rshift(a,3))+w[i-7]+xor(ror(b,17),ror(b,19),rshift(b,10)))%2^32
		end
		local a,b,c,d,e,f,g,j=table.unpack(h)
		for i=1,64 do
			local t1=(j+xor(ror(e,6),ror(e,11),ror(e,25))+xor(band(e,f),band(bit32.bnot(e),g))+K[i]+w[i])%2^32
			local t2=(xor(ror(a,2),ror(a,13),ror(a,22))+xor(band(a,b),band(a,c),band(b,c)))%2^32
			j,g,f,e,d,c,b,a=g,f,e,(d+t1)%2^32,c,b,a,(t1+t2)%2^32
		end
		for i,v in ipairs({a,b,c,d,e,f,g,j}) do h[i]=(h[i]+v)%2^32 end
	end
	local result={}; for _,v in ipairs(h) do table.insert(result,string.format("%08x",v)) end; return table.concat(result)
end
function Codec.hash(v) return Codec.sha256(Codec.encode(v)) end
return Codec

--!nonstrict
-- Same-server negotiation; this RAM state never grants/transfers an item.
local runtimeScript=rawget(getfenv(),"script")
local C=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.TradeCodec or "./TradeCodec")
local Trading=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.Trading or "./Trading")
local Protocol=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.Protocol or "./Protocol")
local Session={}
function Session.isAction(action) return type(action)=="string" and string.sub(action,1,5)=="trade" end
function Session.new(options)
	local service={}; local trades,byUser,cooldown={},{},{}
	local config,model=options.config,options.model
	local terminal={settled=true,aborted=true,cancelled=true,declined=true}
	local function changed(t)
		if terminal[t.state] then
			for _,side in ipairs(t.sides) do if byUser[side.userId]==t.id then byUser[side.userId]=nil end end
			trades[t.id]=nil
		end
		-- Presentation failure must not interrupt the durable protocol or strand
		-- a frozen negotiation before its first journal write.
		if options.changed then pcall(options.changed,t) end
	end
	local function live(t,allowPending)
		for _,side in ipairs(t.sides) do
			if options.identity(side.userId)~=side.identity or not options.inBazaar(side.userId)
				or not (allowPending and options.leaseActive(side.userId) or not allowPending and options.writable(side.userId)) then return false end
		end
		return true
	end
	local function reset(t,reason)
		t.version+=1; t.ready={}; t.confirmed={}; t.state="negotiating"; t.reason=reason; t.proposal=nil
	end
	local function proposal(t)
		return model.proposal(options.profile(t.sides[1].userId),options.profile(t.sides[2].userId),t.sides[1].selection,t.sides[2].selection,t.version)
	end
	function service.busy(userId)
		local t=trades[byUser[userId]]
		return t~=nil and (t.state=="frozen" or t.state=="recovering")
	end
	function service.current(userId) return trades[byUser[userId]] end
	function service.view(t,userId)
		if not t then return nil end
		local result={id=t.id,version=t.version,state=t.state,reason=t.reason,hash=t.proposal and C.hash(t.proposal),ready=C.copy(t.ready),confirmed=C.copy(t.confirmed),sides={}}
		for i,side in ipairs(t.sides) do
			result.sides[i]={mine=side.userId==userId,name=side.name,items=t.proposal and C.copy(t.proposal.sides[i].items) or C.copy(side.items or {})}
		end
		return result
	end
	function service.handle(userId,action,payload)
		if not options.enabled() then return false,"Trading is disabled until live QA" end
		local valid,reason=Protocol.validate(action,payload)
		if not Session.isAction(action) or not valid then return false,reason end
		if action=="tradeInvite" then
			local target=options.resolve(payload.targetToken)
			if not target or target==userId then return false,"Choose another player on this server" end
			if byUser[userId] or byUser[target] then return false,"A participant already has a trade" end
			if options.now()<(cooldown[userId] or 0) then return false,"Invitation cooldown" end
			local t={id=options.uuid(),version=1,state="invited",ready={},confirmed={},createdAt=options.now(),expiresAt=options.now()+config.trading.inviteSeconds,sides={}}
			for _,uid in ipairs({userId,target}) do
				local identity=options.identity(uid); if not identity then return false,"Player unavailable" end
				table.insert(t.sides,{userId=uid,identity=identity,name=options.name(uid),selection={},items={}})
			end
			if not live(t,false) then return false,"Both players must be active in the Bazaar" end
			-- Reserve the one-negotiation slots before the policy lookup yields.
			trades[t.id]=t; byUser[userId],byUser[target]=t.id,t.id; cooldown[userId]=options.now()+config.trading.inviteCooldown
			for _,side in ipairs(t.sides) do
				local lookupOK,policy=pcall(options.policy,side.userId,false)
				if not lookupOK or not Trading.policyAllowed(policy,options.now()) or not live(t,false) or t.state~="invited" then
					t.state="cancelled"; t.reason="Trading permission unavailable"; changed(t); return false,t.reason
				end
			end
			changed(t); return true,"Invitation sent"
		end
		local t=trades[payload.tradeId]
		if not t or byUser[userId]~=t.id then return false,"Unknown trade or participant" end
		local index=t.sides[1].userId==userId and 1 or 2
		if options.identity(userId)~=t.sides[index].identity then return false,"Player session changed" end
		if payload.version~=t.version then return false,"Offer version changed; review again" end
		if action=="tradeCancel" then
			if t.state=="frozen" or t.state=="recovering" then
				t.cancelRequested=true; t.reason="Cancellation requested; checking durable decision"; changed(t)
				return true,t.reason
			end
			t.state=t.state=="invited" and index==2 and "declined" or "cancelled"; changed(t); return true,"Cancelled"
		end
		if t.state=="frozen" or t.state=="recovering" then return false,"Trade is recovering" end
		if options.now()>=t.expiresAt or not live(t,false) then t.state="cancelled"; t.reason="Expired or participant left Bazaar"; changed(t); return false,t.reason end
		if action=="tradeAccept" then
			if t.state~="invited" or index~=2 then return false,"Only the invitee may accept" end
			t.state="negotiating"; t.expiresAt=options.now()+config.trading.negotiateSeconds; changed(t); return true,"Choose items"
		end
		if t.state=="invited" then return false,"Accept invitation first" end
		if action=="tradeOffer" then
			local items,err=model.offer(options.profile(userId),payload.items); if not items then return false,err end
			t.sides[index].selection=C.copy(payload.items); t.sides[index].items=items; reset(t)
			t.proposal=proposal(t); changed(t); return true,"Both confirmations reset"
		end
		local current,err=proposal(t)
		if not current or (t.proposal and C.encode(current)~=C.encode(t.proposal)) then reset(t,err or "Offered item changed"); changed(t); return false,t.reason end
		t.proposal=current
		if action=="tradeReady" then
			t.ready[tostring(index)]=payload.ready or nil; t.confirmed={}
			t.state=t.ready["1"] and t.ready["2"] and "both_ready" or "negotiating"; changed(t); return true,"Readiness updated"
		end
		if action~="tradeConfirm" or t.state~="both_ready" or payload.offerHash~=C.hash(t.proposal) then return false,"Review the exact final offer first" end
		t.confirmed[tostring(index)]=true; changed(t)
		if not t.confirmed["1"] or not t.confirmed["2"] then return true,"Waiting for the other confirmation" end
		if options.canStart and not options.canStart() then t.confirmed={}; t.reason="Trade storage budget low; confirm again later"; changed(t); return false,t.reason end
		t.state="frozen"; t.frozenAt=options.now(); changed(t)
		local ok,settled,result=pcall(options.commit,t.id,t.proposal,function()
			local permissions={}
			for _,side in ipairs(t.sides) do permissions[side.userId]=options.policy(side.userId,true) end
			return function(now)
				if t.cancelRequested or not options.enabled() or not live(t,true) then return false end
				for _,side in ipairs(t.sides) do if not Trading.policyAllowed(permissions[side.userId],now) then return false end end
				return true
			end
		end)
		if ok and settled and type(result)=="table" and result.state=="COMPLETE" then
			t.state=result.decision=="COMMIT" and "settled" or "aborted"; t.reason=result.decision
		else t.state="recovering"; t.reason="Pending durable recovery; do not regrant items" end
		changed(t); return true,t.reason
	end
	function service.poll()
		for _,t in pairs(trades) do
			if t.state=="recovering" then
				local ok,result=options.recover(t.id,t.cancelRequested)
				if ok and type(result)=="table" and result.state=="COMPLETE" then t.state=result.decision=="COMMIT" and "settled" or "aborted"; t.reason=result.decision; changed(t) end
				if not ok and result=="Journal missing" and options.now()>t.frozenAt+config.trading.prepareSeconds then
					local clear=true
					for _,side in ipairs(t.sides) do local p=options.profile(side.userId); if not p or Trading.frozen(p) then clear=false end end
					if clear then t.state="aborted"; t.reason="No durable trade was created"; changed(t) end
				end
			elseif t.state~="frozen" and (options.now()>=t.expiresAt or not live(t,false)) then t.state="cancelled"; changed(t) end
		end
	end
	function service.leave(userId)
		local t=trades[byUser[userId]]; cooldown[userId]=nil
		if t then
			if t.state=="frozen" or t.state=="recovering" then t.cancelRequested=true
			else t.state="cancelled"; changed(t) end
		end
	end
	return service
end
return Session

--!nonstrict
-- Pure reserve/apply/clear protocol; only the server's journal coordinator calls it.
local runtimeScript=rawget(getfenv(),"script")
local C=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.TradeCodec or "./TradeCodec")
local Familiars=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.Familiars or "./Familiars")
local Origin=require(runtimeScript and runtimeScript.Parent.ItemOrigin or "./ItemOrigin")
local Trading={}
local function integer(n,lo,hi) return type(n)=="number" and n==n and n%1==0 and n>=lo and n<=hi end
local function plain(v) return type(v)=="table" and getmetatable(v)==nil end
local function id(v) return type(v)=="string" and #v>0 and #v<=80 and string.match(v,"^[%w_:%-%.]+$")~=nil end
local function hash(v) return type(v)=="string" and #v==64 and string.match(v,"^[a-f0-9]+$")~=nil end
local function count(t) local n=0; for _ in pairs(t) do n+=1 end; return n end
local function same(a,b) return C.encode(a)==C.encode(b) end
function Trading.frozen(p) return p.trade and p.trade.pending~=nil end
function Trading.validateProfile(p,maximum)
	local t=p.trade
	if not plain(t) or not integer(t.sequence,0,maximum) then return false end
	local last=t.last
	if last~=nil and (not plain(last) or not id(last.id) or not hash(last.hash) or not integer(last.sequence,1,t.sequence)
		or (last.decision~="COMMIT" and last.decision~="ABORT")) then return false end
	local pending=t.pending
	if pending and (not plain(pending) or not id(pending.id) or not hash(pending.hash) or pending.sequence~=t.sequence
		or not integer(pending.sequence,1,maximum)
		or (pending.stage~="prepared" and pending.stage~="applied")) then return false end
	if pending and pending.stage=="applied" and (not last or last.id~=pending.id or last.hash~=pending.hash or last.sequence~=pending.sequence) then return false end
	if t.sequence>0 and not pending and (not last or last.sequence~=t.sequence) then return false end
	return true
end
function Trading.policyAllowed(policy,now)
	return plain(policy) and policy.tradingKnown==true and policy.tradingAllowed==true
		and type(policy.expiresAt)=="number" and policy.expiresAt>now
end
function Trading.new(config)
	local model={}; local familiars=Familiars.new(config)
	function model.item(p,kind,itemId)
		if Trading.frozen(p) then return nil,"Trade recovery pending" end
		local item=(kind=="pet" and p.pets or kind=="cauldron" and p.cauldrons or {})[itemId]
		if not item or item.locked then return nil,"Item missing or locked" end
		if not plain(item.provenance) or type(item.provenance.paidDerived)~="boolean" or item.provenance.source=="legacy" then return nil,"Unknown historical provenance" end
		if kind=="pet" then
			if not familiars.validatePet(item) then return nil,"Invalid familiar" end
			if not Familiars.provenanceKnown(item) then return nil,"Unknown historical Fuse ancestry" end
			if item.provenance.source=="starter" then return nil,"Starter workers are protected" end
			for _,s in pairs(p.stations) do if s.workerId==itemId then return nil,"Unassign this familiar first" end end
		else
			if kind~="cauldron" or item.ownerId~=p.userId or not config.cauldronTypes[item.type]
				or not Origin.cauldron(config,item) then return nil,"Invalid cauldron owner/type" end
			for _,s in pairs(p.stations) do if s.cauldronId==itemId then return nil,"Unequip this cauldron first" end end
		end
		return {kind=kind,id=itemId,data=C.copy(item),timer=kind=="pet" and p.slimeWorkSeconds[itemId] or nil}
	end
	function model.offer(p,selection)
		if not plain(selection) or #selection>config.trading.maxItems then return nil,"Offer limit" end
		local items,seen={},{}
		for k,entry in pairs(selection) do
			if not integer(k,1,#selection) or not plain(entry) or not id(entry.id) or seen[entry.id] then return nil,"Invalid/duplicate offered ID" end
			seen[entry.id]=true
			local item,reason=model.item(p,entry.kind,entry.id); if not item then return nil,reason end
			table.insert(items,item)
		end
		if #items~=#selection then return nil,"Sparse offer" end
		table.sort(items,function(a,b) return a.id<b.id end); return items
	end
	local function capacity(p,outgoing,incoming)
		local pets,cauldrons=count(p.pets),count(p.cauldrons)
		for _,entry in ipairs(outgoing) do if entry.kind=="pet" then pets-=1 else cauldrons-=1 end end
		for _,entry in ipairs(incoming) do
			if p.pets[entry.id] or p.cauldrons[entry.id] then return false,"Incoming item ID collision" end
			if entry.kind=="pet" then pets+=1 else cauldrons+=1 end
		end
		return pets<=config.maxPets and cauldrons<=config.trading.maxCauldrons,"Incoming inventory is full"
	end
	function model.proposal(a,b,selectionA,selectionB,version)
		if a.userId==b.userId then return nil,"Self trade denied" end
		local x,why=model.offer(a,selectionA); if not x then return nil,why end
		local y,reason=model.offer(b,selectionB); if not y then return nil,reason end
		if #x+#y==0 then return nil,"Offer at least one item" end
		local ok,err=capacity(a,x,y); if not ok then return nil,err end
		ok,err=capacity(b,y,x); if not ok then return nil,err end
		return {version=version,sides={{userId=a.userId,sequence=a.trade.sequence+1,items=x},{userId=b.userId,sequence=b.trade.sequence+1,items=y}}}
	end
	function model.validateJournal(j)
		if not plain(j) or j.schemaVersion~=1 or not id(j.id) or not id(j.coordinator) or not hash(j.hash)
			or not integer(j.version,1,config.maxCount)
			or not integer(j.createdAt,0,config.maxTimestamp) or not integer(j.deadline,j.createdAt+1,config.maxTimestamp)
			or not ({PREPARING=true,COMMIT=true,ABORT=true,SETTLED=true,COMPLETE=true})[j.state]
			or not plain(j.sides) or #j.sides~=2 or count(j.sides)~=2 then return false end
		if not plain(j.prepared) or not plain(j.applied) or not plain(j.cleared) then return false end
		if j.state~="PREPARING" and j.decision~="COMMIT" and j.decision~="ABORT" then return false end
		if j.state=="PREPARING" and j.decision~=nil then return false end
		if j.state=="PREPARING" and (next(j.applied) or next(j.cleared)) then return false end
		if j.state~="SETTLED" and j.state~="COMPLETE" and next(j.cleared) then return false end
		if (j.state=="COMMIT" or j.state=="ABORT") and j.decision~=j.state then return false end
		local seen={}
		for index,side in ipairs(j.sides) do
			if not plain(side) or not integer(side.userId,-9007199254740991,9007199254740991)
				or not integer(side.sequence,1,config.maxBalance) then return false end
			for _,flags in ipairs({j.prepared,j.applied,j.cleared}) do
				for key,value in pairs(flags) do if (key~="1" and key~="2") or value~=true then return false end end
			end
			if j.state~="COMPLETE" then
				if not plain(side.items) or #side.items>config.trading.maxItems or count(side.items)~=#side.items then return false end
				for _,entry in ipairs(side.items) do
					if not plain(entry) or not id(entry.id) or seen[entry.id] or not plain(entry.data) or entry.data.id~=entry.id or entry.data.locked~=false then return false end
					seen[entry.id]=true
					if entry.kind=="pet" then
						if not familiars.validatePet(entry.data) or not Familiars.provenanceKnown(entry.data) or entry.data.provenance.source=="starter" then return false end
						if entry.timer~=nil and (not config.petSpecies[entry.data.species].slimeProducer or not integer(entry.timer,0,config.slimePeriod-1)) then return false end
					elseif entry.kind=="cauldron" then
						local item,def=entry.data,config.cauldronTypes[entry.data.type]
						if not def or item.ownerId~=side.userId or not Origin.cauldron(config,item) or entry.timer~=nil then return false end
					else return false end
				end
			elseif side.items~=nil then return false end
			if j.cleared[tostring(index)] and not j.applied[tostring(index)] then return false end
		end
		if j.sides[1].userId==j.sides[2].userId then return false end
		if j.decision=="COMMIT" and (not j.prepared["1"] or not j.prepared["2"]) then return false end
		if (j.state=="SETTLED" or j.state=="COMPLETE") and (not j.applied["1"] or not j.applied["2"]) then return false end
		if j.state=="COMPLETE" and (not j.cleared["1"] or not j.cleared["2"] or not integer(j.completedAt,j.createdAt,config.maxTimestamp)) then return false end
		if j.state~="COMPLETE" and C.hash({version=j.version,sides=j.sides})~=j.hash then return false end
		return true
	end
	function model.reserve(p,j,index,now)
		local side=j.sides[index]; local t=p.trade
		if p.userId~=side.userId then return false,"Participant mismatch" end
		if t.pending and t.pending.id==j.id and t.pending.hash==j.hash and t.pending.sequence==side.sequence then return true,"reserved",true end
		if j.state~="PREPARING" or now>=j.deadline or t.pending or t.sequence+1~=side.sequence then return false,"Stale reservation" end
		for _,entry in ipairs(side.items) do local item=model.item(p,entry.kind,entry.id); if not item or not same(item,entry) then return false,"Offered item changed" end end
		local ok,why=capacity(p,side.items,j.sides[3-index].items); if not ok then return false,why end
		t.sequence=side.sequence; t.pending={id=j.id,hash=j.hash,sequence=side.sequence,stage="prepared"}
		return true,"reserved"
	end
	function model.apply(p,j,index)
		if not j.decision or j.state=="PREPARING" or j.state=="COMPLETE" then return false,"No applicable decision" end
		local side=j.sides[index]; local t=p.trade; local pending=t.pending
		if p.userId~=side.userId then return false,"Participant mismatch" end
		if not pending or pending.id~=j.id then
			if j.decision=="COMMIT" then
				if t.sequence>=side.sequence and j.applied[tostring(index)] then return true,"already settled",true end
				return false,"Missing committed reservation"
			end
			if t.sequence>=side.sequence then return true,"abort fenced by later sequence",true end
			if pending or t.sequence+1~=side.sequence then return false,"Abort sequence conflict" end
			-- Fence a delayed prepare, even if this side was never reserved.
			t.sequence=side.sequence; t.last={id=j.id,hash=j.hash,sequence=side.sequence,decision="ABORT"}
			return true,"abort barrier"
		end
		if pending.hash~=j.hash or pending.sequence~=side.sequence then return false,"Reservation mismatch" end
		if pending.stage=="applied" then return true,"already applied",true end
		if j.decision=="COMMIT" then
			for _,entry in ipairs(side.items) do
				local actual=(entry.kind=="pet" and p.pets or p.cauldrons)[entry.id]
				if not same(actual,entry.data) or (entry.kind=="pet" and p.slimeWorkSeconds[entry.id]~=entry.timer) then return false,"Reserved item changed" end
			end
			local incoming=j.sides[3-index].items
			local ok,why=capacity(p,side.items,incoming); if not ok then return false,why end
			for _,entry in ipairs(side.items) do
				if entry.kind=="pet" then p.pets[entry.id]=nil; p.slimeWorkSeconds[entry.id]=nil else p.cauldrons[entry.id]=nil end
			end
			for _,entry in ipairs(incoming) do
				local item=C.copy(entry.data)
				if entry.kind=="pet" then p.pets[item.id]=item; p.slimeWorkSeconds[item.id]=entry.timer
				else item.ownerId=p.userId; p.cauldrons[item.id]=item end
			end
		end
		pending.stage="applied"; t.last={id=j.id,hash=j.hash,sequence=side.sequence,decision=j.decision}
		return true,"applied"
	end
	function model.clear(p,j,index)
		if j.state~="SETTLED" and j.state~="COMPLETE" then return false,"Both participants must settle" end
		local t=p.trade; local side=j.sides[index]
		if p.userId~=side.userId or t.sequence<side.sequence then return false,"Clear sequence mismatch" end
		if not t.pending or t.pending.id~=j.id then return true,"already cleared",true end
		if t.pending.stage~="applied" or t.pending.hash~=j.hash or not t.last or t.last.decision~=j.decision then return false,"Not applied" end
		t.pending=nil; return true,"cleared"
	end
	return model
end
return Trading
